TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A degree-d polynomial vector is represented by coefficients on padded tuples.
[GJLS21, §9, pp.57–58; Wee20, §3, p.6]. The representation uses ordered tuples
rather than monomials, with the padded constant accounting for smaller degrees.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev PolyTensor (p : ℕ+) (l n d : ℕ) : Type :=
  Fin n → (Fin d → Fin (l + 1)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A coefficient tensor has one residue for each output and padded monomial tuple.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem polyTensor_eq (p : ℕ+) (l n d : ℕ) :
    PolyTensor p l n d = (Fin n → (Fin d → Fin (l + 1)) → ZMod (p : ℕ))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The padded public input appends the constant 1, so tuples of fixed length d
can represent every smaller public degree. [GJLS21, §9, pp.57–58].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def xhat {p : ℕ+} {l : ℕ} (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    Fin (l + 1) → ZMod (p : ℕ) := Fin.snoc x 1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Public-input padding is exactly `Fin.snoc x 1`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem xhat_eq {p : ℕ+} {l : ℕ} (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    xhat x = Fin.snoc x 1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Padding preserves each public-input coordinate.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem xhat_castSucc {p : ℕ+} {l : ℕ} (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (i : Fin l) :
    xhat x i.castSucc = x i

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The final padded public-input coordinate equals 1.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem xhat_last {p : ℕ+} {l : ℕ} (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    xhat x (Fin.last l) = 1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Tensor evaluation sums each coefficient times its padded public monomial.
[GJLS21, §9, pp.57–58; Wee20, §3, p.6].
Tensor evaluation is the displayed sum over padded tuples.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem polyTensorEval_eq {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (C : PolyTensor p l n d)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (j : Fin n) :
    polyTensorEval C x j =
      ∑ tau : Fin d → Fin (l + 1), C j tau * ∏ i : Fin d, xhat x (tau i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Padded monomial tuples have the explicit base-(l+1) coordinate ordering
provided by `finFunctionFinEquiv`; no arbitrary finite-type enumeration is chosen.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def tupleCoord (l d : ℕ) : (Fin d → Fin (l + 1)) ≃ Fin ((l + 1) ^ d) :=
  finFunctionFinEquiv

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Tuple coordinates use the published finite-function equivalence.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem tupleCoord_eq (l d : ℕ) : tupleCoord l d = finFunctionFinEquiv

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Parse a fixed-length residue word at its word modulus and cast each resulting
integer into the supplied positive modulus. The explicit zero fallback is
unreachable by `decodeResidues_parse`. This is total modular decoding glue.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def decodeResidues (p : ℕ+) (count width : ℕ)
    (word : Fin (count * width) → Bool) : Fin count → ZMod (p : ℕ) :=
  fun i => ((((Encoding.Modular.decodeVector (q := 2 ^ width) (length := count)
    width (List.ofFn word)).getD 0) i).val : ZMod (p : ℕ))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Residue decoding is the word-modulus parser followed by representative casting,
with the displayed explicit fallback.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodeResidues_eq (p : ℕ+) (count width : ℕ)
    (word : Fin (count * width) → Bool) :
    decodeResidues p count width word = fun i =>
      ((((Encoding.Modular.decodeVector (q := 2 ^ width) (length := count)
        width (List.ofFn word)).getD 0) i).val : ZMod (p : ℕ))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Every fixed-length word passes the word-modulus parser: each width-bit block
is less than 2^width. In particular the decoding fallback is never used.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodeResidues_parse (count width : ℕ) (word : Fin (count * width) → Bool) :
    Encoding.Modular.decodeVector (q := 2 ^ width) (length := count) width
        (List.ofFn word) =
      some (fun i : Fin count =>
        (listToNat (((List.ofFn word).drop (i.val * width)).take width) : ZMod (2 ^ width)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Each decoded residue is the integer represented by its block, reduced modulo
p. This reader explicitly rules out rejection of representatives at least p.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodeResidues_apply (p : ℕ+) (count width : ℕ)
    (word : Fin (count * width) → Bool) (i : Fin count) :
    decodeResidues p count width word i =
      (listToNat (((List.ofFn word).drop (i.val * width)).take width) : ZMod (p : ℕ))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Equal modulus values give the same decoded residues after the natural cast.
This is the reader used when replacing a drawn order by a fixed prime schedule.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodeResidues_modulus (p q : ℕ+) (hpq : (p : ℕ) = (q : ℕ)) (count width : ℕ)
    (word : Fin (count * width) → Bool) :
    (fun i => ((decodeResidues p count width word i).val : ZMod (q : ℕ))) =
      decodeResidues q count width word

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Total decoding inverts a canonical vector encoding when its residues fit.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodeResidues_encodeVector (p : ℕ+) (count width : ℕ)
    (hwidth : (p : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ width) (v : Fin count → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (word : Fin (count * width) → Bool)
    (hword : List.ofFn word = Encoding.Modular.encodeVector width v) :
    decodeResidues p count width word = v

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Encode a coefficient tensor as a row-major modular matrix using the explicit
padded-tuple ordering. This reuses the published modular matrix encoder.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def encodeTensor {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (width : ℕ) (C : PolyTensor p l n d) : List Bool :=
  Encoding.Modular.encodeMatrix width (fun j k => C j ((tupleCoord l d).symm k))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Tensor encoding is the displayed row-major matrix encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encodeTensor_eq {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (width : ℕ) (C : PolyTensor p l n d) :
    encodeTensor width C =
      Encoding.Modular.encodeMatrix width (fun j k => C j ((tupleCoord l d).symm k))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A tensor encoding has exactly n(l+1)^d residue blocks of the supplied width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encodeTensor_length {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (width : ℕ) (C : PolyTensor p l n d) :
    (encodeTensor width C).length = n * (l + 1) ^ d * width

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: View the tensor's canonical encoding as a fixed-width bit vector.
Tensor bit encoding reads the corresponding position of the canonical word.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encodeTensorBits_eq {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (width : ℕ) (C : PolyTensor p l n d) :
    encodeTensorBits width C = fun i => (encodeTensor width C).getD i.val false

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Writing the fixed-width tensor bits gives exactly its canonical word.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem ofFn_encodeTensorBits {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (width : ℕ)
    (C : PolyTensor p l n d) : List.ofFn (encodeTensorBits width C) = encodeTensor width C

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Decode a coefficient tensor by total modular vector decoding and the explicit
row/tuple finite-product coordinates. This is wire-representation glue.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def decodeTensor (p : ℕ+) (l n d width : ℕ)
    (word : Fin (n * (l + 1) ^ d * width) → Bool) : PolyTensor p l n d :=
  fun j tau => decodeResidues p (n * (l + 1) ^ d) width word
    (finProdFinEquiv (j, tupleCoord l d tau))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Tensor decoding reads the residue at the output/tuple product coordinate.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodeTensor_eq (p : ℕ+) (l n d width : ℕ)
    (word : Fin (n * (l + 1) ^ d * width) → Bool) :
    decodeTensor p l n d width word = fun j tau =>
      decodeResidues p (n * (l + 1) ^ d) width word
        (finProdFinEquiv (j, tupleCoord l d tau))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Tensor decoding inverts its canonical encoding under width coverage.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodeTensor_encodeTensorBits {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (width : ℕ)
    (hwidth : (p : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ width) (C : PolyTensor p l n d) :
    decodeTensor p l n d width (encodeTensorBits width C) = C

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Fixed-width coefficient descriptions are injective when every residue fits.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encodeTensorBits_injective {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (width : ℕ)
    (hwidth : (p : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ width) :
    Function.Injective (encodeTensorBits (p := p) (l := l) (n := n) (d := d) width)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The private tensor is the Kronecker product z1 ⊗ z2 in row-major pair order.
[Wee20, §3, p.6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def privateTensor {p : ℕ+} {n1 n2 : ℕ} (z1 : Fin n1 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : Fin (n1 * n2) → ZMod (p : ℕ) :=
  fun i => Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a * b)
    (fun (_ : Fin 1) j => z1 j) (fun (_ : Fin 1) j => z2 j)
    (0, 0) (finProdFinEquiv.symm i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The private tensor is the displayed flattened Kronecker product.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem privateTensor_eq {p : ℕ+} {n1 n2 : ℕ} (z1 : Fin n1 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    privateTensor z1 z2 = fun i => Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a * b)
      (fun (_ : Fin 1) j => z1 j) (fun (_ : Fin 1) j => z2 j)
      (0, 0) (finProdFinEquiv.symm i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The quadratic class evaluates the private tensor against the polynomial vector.
[Wee20, §3, p.6]. Polynomial vectors are the fixed-degree subclass used here.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def quadEval {p : ℕ+} {l n1 n2 d : ℕ} (C : PolyTensor p l (n1 * n2) d)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z1 : Fin n1 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : ZMod (p : ℕ) :=
  dotProduct (privateTensor z1 z2) (polyTensorEval C x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Quadratic evaluation is the displayed dot product.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadEval_eq {p : ℕ+} {l n1 n2 d : ℕ} (C : PolyTensor p l (n1 * n2) d)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z1 : Fin n1 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    quadEval C x z1 z2 = dotProduct (privateTensor z1 z2) (polyTensorEval C x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The PHFE class is the quadratic class restricted to the diagonal private input.
[GJLS21, §9, pp.57–58; Wee20, §3, p.6].
PHFE evaluation is quadratic evaluation at the duplicated private input.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeEval_eq {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (C : PolyTensor p l (n * n) d)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (y : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    phfeEval C x y = quadEval C x y y

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
PHFE evaluation has exactly the sum-of-quadratic-terms form required in §9.
[GJLS21, §9, pp.57–58].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeEval_sum {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (C : PolyTensor p l (n * n) d)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (y : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    phfeEval C x y = ∑ j : Fin n, ∑ k : Fin n,
      polyTensorEval C x (finProdFinEquiv (j, k)) * y j * y k

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The tensor-description width is n(l+1)^d residue blocks of width w.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def tensorFnLen (l n w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) : PolyExpr :=
  .mul (.mul n (.pow (.add l (PolyExpr.const 1)) d)) w

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The tensor-description width is the displayed polynomial expression.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem tensorFnLen_eq (l n w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) :
    tensorFnLen l n w d = .mul (.mul n (.pow (.add l (PolyExpr.const 1)) d)) w

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The coefficient-description polynomial evaluates to its numeric block width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem tensorFnLen_eval (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) :
    (tensorFnLen l n w d).eval kappa =
      n.eval kappa * (l.eval kappa + 1) ^ d * w.eval kappa

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Encode a scalar allowed value as a singleton modular vector at the binary
width of the supplied modulus. This preserves the scalar simulator input.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def encodeScalar (p : ℕ+) (a : ZMod (p : ℕ)) : List Bool :=
  Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (Nat.size (p : ℕ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => a)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Scalar encoding is the published modular singleton-vector encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encodeScalar_eq (p : ℕ+) (a : ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    encodeScalar p a =
      Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (Nat.size (p : ℕ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => a)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Scalar-value encoding is injective because Nat.size p covers every residue.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem encodeScalar_injective (p : ℕ+) : Function.Injective (encodeScalar p)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The PHFE wire class uses the positive modulus as parameter and returns scalar
values for later embedding into the target group. [GJLS21, §9, pp.57–58].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def phfeClass (l n w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) : FnClass where
  pubLen := .mul l w
  privLen := .mul n w
  fnLen := tensorFnLen l (.mul n n) w d
  Prm := fun _ => ℕ+
  Out := fun _ p => ZMod (p : ℕ)
  encValue := fun _ p => encodeScalar p
  encValue_injective := fun _ p => encodeScalar_injective p
  eval := fun kappa p f x y =>
    phfeEval (decodeTensor p (l.eval kappa) (n.eval kappa * n.eval kappa) d (w.eval kappa) f)
      (decodeResidues p (l.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) x)
      (decodeResidues p (n.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) y)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The PHFE class has the displayed polynomial wire widths.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_pubLen (l n w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).pubLen = .mul l w

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The PHFE private input contains n residue blocks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_privLen (l n w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).privLen = .mul n w

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The PHFE function description has one tensor coefficient for each private pair.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_fnLen (l n w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).fnLen = tensorFnLen l (.mul n n) w d

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The PHFE class parameter is any positive modulus.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_Prm (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).Prm kappa = ℕ+

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The PHFE class returns residues at the supplied modulus.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_Out (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).Out kappa p = ZMod (p : ℕ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: PHFE scalar simulator values use the lossless modulus-dependent scalar encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_encValue (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (a : ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).encValue kappa p a = encodeScalar p a

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The PHFE wire evaluation is the displayed tensor evaluation of decoded words.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_eval (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (f : Fin ((tensorFnLen l (.mul n n) w d).eval kappa) → Bool)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (y : Fin (n.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).eval kappa p f x y =
      phfeEval (decodeTensor p (l.eval kappa) (n.eval kappa * n.eval kappa) d (w.eval kappa) f)
        (decodeResidues p (l.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) x)
        (decodeResidues p (n.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) y)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The PHFE class parameter is transported explicitly to its positive modulus.
This codec avoids unfolding the class bundle in foreign scheme constructions.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def phfeClassParamEquiv (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).Prm kappa ≃ ℕ+ := Equiv.refl _

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The PHFE parameter codec is internally the identity equivalence.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClassParamEquiv_eq (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) :
    phfeClassParamEquiv l n w d kappa = Equiv.refl ℕ+

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encoding then decoding a PHFE parameter recovers the supplied modulus.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClassParamEquiv_apply_symm (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) :
    phfeClassParamEquiv l n w d kappa ((phfeClassParamEquiv l n w d kappa).symm p) = p

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The PHFE value codec preserves the scalar at its explicitly encoded modulus.
The PHFE scalar-value codec is internally the identity equivalence.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClassValueEquiv_eq (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) :
    phfeClassValueEquiv l n w d kappa p = Equiv.refl (ZMod (p : ℕ))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encoding then decoding a PHFE scalar preserves the scalar value.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClassValueEquiv_apply_symm (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (a : ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    phfeClassValueEquiv l n w d kappa p
      ((phfeClassValueEquiv l n w d kappa p).symm a) = a

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encoding a packaged PHFE scalar gives the canonical residue encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_encValue_codec (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (a : ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).encValue kappa ((phfeClassParamEquiv l n w d kappa).symm p)
      ((phfeClassValueEquiv l n w d kappa p).symm a) = encodeScalar p a

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Canonical encoded inputs realize the intended typed PHFE evaluation whenever
every residue fits in the public word width. [GJLS21, §9, pp.57–58].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_eval_encoded (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (hwidth : (p : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ w.eval kappa)
    (C : PolyTensor p (l.eval kappa) (n.eval kappa * n.eval kappa) d)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (y : Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (xword : Fin (l.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (yword : Fin (n.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (hx : List.ofFn xword = Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (w.eval kappa) x)
    (hy : List.ofFn yword = Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (w.eval kappa) y) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).eval kappa p (encodeTensorBits (w.eval kappa) C) xword yword =
      phfeEval C x y

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The quadratic wire class permits two independently sized private vectors.
[Wee20, §3, p.6]. Scalar outputs remain unembedded at the function-class layer.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def quadClass (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) : FnClass where
  pubLen := .mul l w
  privLen := .mul (.add n1 n2) w
  fnLen := tensorFnLen l (.mul n1 n2) w d
  Prm := fun _ => ℕ+
  Out := fun _ p => ZMod (p : ℕ)
  encValue := fun _ p => encodeScalar p
  encValue_injective := fun _ p => encodeScalar_injective p
  eval := fun kappa p f x z =>
    let privateValues := decodeResidues p (n1.eval kappa + n2.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) z
    quadEval (decodeTensor p (l.eval kappa) (n1.eval kappa * n2.eval kappa) d (w.eval kappa) f)
      (decodeResidues p (l.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) x)
      (fun i => privateValues (Fin.castAdd (n2.eval kappa) i))
      (fun j => privateValues (Fin.natAdd (n1.eval kappa) j))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The quadratic public-input width is l residue blocks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClass_pubLen (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).pubLen = .mul l w

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The quadratic private-input width is n1+n2 residue blocks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClass_privLen (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).privLen = .mul (.add n1 n2) w

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The quadratic function description has one coefficient tensor for each private pair.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClass_fnLen (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).fnLen = tensorFnLen l (.mul n1 n2) w d

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The quadratic class parameter is any positive modulus.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClass_Prm (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).Prm kappa = ℕ+

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The quadratic class returns residues at the supplied modulus.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClass_Out (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).Out kappa p = ZMod (p : ℕ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Quadratic scalar simulator values use the lossless modulus-dependent encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClass_encValue (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (a : ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).encValue kappa p a = encodeScalar p a

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The quadratic wire evaluation uses the two blocks of the decoded private vector.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClass_eval (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (f : Fin ((tensorFnLen l (.mul n1 n2) w d).eval kappa) → Bool)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (z : Fin ((n1.eval kappa + n2.eval kappa) * w.eval kappa) → Bool) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).eval kappa p f x z =
      quadEval (decodeTensor p (l.eval kappa) (n1.eval kappa * n2.eval kappa) d (w.eval kappa) f)
        (decodeResidues p (l.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) x)
        (fun i => decodeResidues p (n1.eval kappa + n2.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) z
          (Fin.castAdd (n2.eval kappa) i))
        (fun j => decodeResidues p (n1.eval kappa + n2.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) z
          (Fin.natAdd (n1.eval kappa) j))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The quadratic class parameter is explicitly transported to its positive modulus.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def quadClassParamEquiv (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).Prm kappa ≃ ℕ+ := Equiv.refl _

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The quadratic parameter codec is internally the identity equivalence.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClassParamEquiv_eq (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) :
    quadClassParamEquiv l n1 n2 w d kappa = Equiv.refl ℕ+

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encoding then decoding a quadratic parameter recovers the supplied modulus.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClassParamEquiv_apply_symm (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) :
    quadClassParamEquiv l n1 n2 w d kappa
      ((quadClassParamEquiv l n1 n2 w d kappa).symm p) = p

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The quadratic value codec preserves the scalar at its explicitly encoded modulus.
The quadratic scalar-value codec is internally the identity equivalence.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClassValueEquiv_eq (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) :
    quadClassValueEquiv l n1 n2 w d kappa p = Equiv.refl (ZMod (p : ℕ))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encoding then decoding a quadratic scalar preserves the scalar value.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClassValueEquiv_apply_symm (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (a : ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    quadClassValueEquiv l n1 n2 w d kappa p
      ((quadClassValueEquiv l n1 n2 w d kappa p).symm a) = a

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encoding a packaged quadratic scalar gives the canonical residue encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadClass_encValue_codec (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (a : ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).encValue kappa ((quadClassParamEquiv l n1 n2 w d kappa).symm p)
      ((quadClassValueEquiv l n1 n2 w d kappa p).symm a) = encodeScalar p a

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Duplicate private residue words in block order, without decoding them. This is
the wire form of y↦(y,y) used to embed [GJLS21, §9] into [Wee20, §3].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def duplicatePrivateBits (n width : ℕ) (y : Fin (n * width) → Bool) :
    Fin ((n + n) * width) → Bool :=
  fun i => let jb := finProdFinEquiv.symm i
    y (finProdFinEquiv (Sum.elim id id (finSumFinEquiv.symm jb.1), jb.2))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Private-word duplication repeats the residue row selected by the finite-sum
coordinate while preserving its within-residue bit coordinate.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem duplicatePrivateBits_eq (n width : ℕ) (y : Fin (n * width) → Bool) :
    duplicatePrivateBits n width y = fun i =>
      let jb

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The PHFE class embeds into the quadratic class by the identity on coefficient
words and duplication of the private word. [GJLS21, §9; Wee20, §3, p.6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem phfeClass_eval_eq_quad (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (f : Fin ((tensorFnLen l (.mul n n) w d).eval kappa) → Bool)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (y : Fin (n.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).eval kappa p f x y =
      (quadClass l n n w d).eval kappa p f x
        (duplicatePrivateBits (n.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) y)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A multivariate polynomial has separate public/private degree bounds when
every nonzero monomial satisfies the corresponding sums of variable exponents.
This is representation glue for the class inclusion discussed in [GJLS21, §9, p.58].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def BidegreeAtMost {p : ℕ+} {l n : ℕ} (d e : ℕ)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin l ⊕ Fin n) (ZMod (p : ℕ))) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : (Fin l ⊕ Fin n) →₀ ℕ, MvPolynomial.coeff s P ≠ 0 →
    (∑ i : Fin l, s (Sum.inl i)) ≤ d ∧ (∑ j : Fin n, s (Sum.inr j)) ≤ e

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Separate degree bounds mean exactly the displayed monomial exponent bounds.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem bidegreeAtMost_iff {p : ℕ+} {l n : ℕ} (d e : ℕ)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin l ⊕ Fin n) (ZMod (p : ℕ))) :
    BidegreeAtMost d e P ↔
      ∀ s : (Fin l ⊕ Fin n) →₀ ℕ, MvPolynomial.coeff s P ≠ 0 →
        (∑ i : Fin l, s (Sum.inl i)) ≤ d ∧ (∑ j : Fin n, s (Sum.inr j)) ≤ e

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Every public-degree-d, private-degree-two polynomial is represented by the
PHFE class after appending 1 to the private input. [GJLS21, §9, p.58]. This spells
out the constant/linear-term padding bridge for the tuple representation.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pad_one {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ}
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin l ⊕ Fin n) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (hdeg : BidegreeAtMost d 2 P) :
    ∃ C : PolyTensor p l ((n + 1) * (n + 1)) d,
      ∀ (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (y : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)),
        MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim x y) P = phfeEval C x (Fin.snoc y 1)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Generate the group's public parameters, including its nonidentity generator
[GJLS21, Definition 4.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def pubGen (κ : ℕ) : ProbComp (PublicParams S.G κ) :=
  publicParamsGen S.G κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Public-parameter generation is the common exact group-parameter experiment.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem pubGen_eq (κ : ℕ) : S.pubGen κ = publicParamsGen S.G κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Setup applies its deterministic core to one uniform complete draw
[GJLS21, Definition 4.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def setup (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    ProbComp (S.MPK κ pp × S.MSK κ pp) :=
  S.setupCore κ pp <$> ProbComp.sample (S.SetupDraw κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Setup is the pushforward of its uniform draw by its deterministic core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setup_eq (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    S.setup κ pp = S.setupCore κ pp <$> ProbComp.sample (S.SetupDraw κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Encryption takes the public key and both input parts, then applies its core to one
uniform complete draw [GJLS21, Definition 4.1]. The public part is returned separately
to the adversary and decryption algorithm.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def enc (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (pk : S.MPK κ pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    ProbComp (S.CT κ pp) :=
  S.encCore κ pp pk x y <$> ProbComp.sample (S.EncDraw κ pp pk x y)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encryption is the pushforward of its uniform draw by its deterministic core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem enc_eq (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (pk : S.MPK κ pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    S.enc κ pp pk x y =
      S.encCore κ pp pk x y <$> ProbComp.sample (S.EncDraw κ pp pk x y)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Key generation takes the master secret key and function description, then applies
its core to one uniform complete draw [GJLS21, Definition 4.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def keyGen (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (msk : S.MSK κ pp)
    (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) : ProbComp (S.SK κ pp) :=
  S.keyCore κ pp msk f <$> ProbComp.sample (S.KeyDraw κ pp msk f)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Key generation is the pushforward of its uniform draw by its deterministic core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyGen_eq (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (msk : S.MSK κ pp)
    (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    S.keyGen κ pp msk f =
      S.keyCore κ pp msk f <$> ProbComp.sample (S.KeyDraw κ pp msk f)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
An honest outcome retains the public parameters, public key, function key and
ciphertext [GJLS21, Definition 4.2]. This record permits parameter-dependent group types
without installing an instance for a dependent-sum type.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure HonestOutcome (κ : ℕ) where
  /-- The public parameters drawn before setup. -/
  pp : PublicParams S.G κ
  /-- The master public key from setup. -/
  pk : S.MPK κ pp
  /-- The function key generated from the corresponding master secret key. -/
  sk : S.SK κ pp
  /-- The encryption of the public and private inputs. -/
  ct : S.CT κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
An honest experiment generates parameters and keys, encrypts the inputs, then produces
the function key [GJLS21, Definition 4.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def honestRun (κ : ℕ) (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    ProbComp (S.HonestOutcome κ) :=
  (S.pubGen κ).bind fun pp =>
  (S.setup κ pp).bind fun k =>
  (S.enc κ pp k.1 x y).bind fun ct =>
  (fun sk => ⟨pp, k.1, sk, ct⟩) <$> S.keyGen κ pp k.2 f

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The honest experiment is the displayed sequencing of its four algorithms.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem honestRun_eq (κ : ℕ) (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    S.honestRun κ f x y =
      (S.pubGen κ).bind fun pp =>
      (S.setup κ pp).bind fun k =>
      (S.enc κ pp k.1 x y).bind fun ct =>
      (fun sk => ⟨pp, k.1, sk, ct⟩) <$> S.keyGen κ pp k.2 f

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Perfect correctness means that every honest outcome decrypts to the embedded
function value [GJLS21, Definition 4.2], strengthened to zero error.
Perfect correctness is the displayed all-outcomes decryption identity.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem correct_iff : S.Correct ↔
    ∀ κ f x y, (S.honestRun κ f x y).AllOutputs fun o =>
      S.dec κ o.pp o.sk x o.ct =
        some (S.embed κ o.pp (C.eval κ (S.cprm κ o.pp) f x y))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Correctness with error at most `ε κ` bounds the probability of an incorrect or failed
decryption in every honest experiment [GJLS21, Definition 4.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def CorrectExcept (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ κ f x y, ProbComp.prob (S.honestRun κ f x y) (fun o =>
    S.dec κ o.pp o.sk x o.ct ≠
      some (S.embed κ o.pp (C.eval κ (S.cprm κ o.pp) f x y))) ≤ ε κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Bounded correctness is the displayed probability inequality for every input and key.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem correctExcept_iff (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : S.CorrectExcept ε ↔
    ∀ κ f x y, ProbComp.prob (S.honestRun κ f x y) (fun o =>
      S.dec κ o.pp o.sk x o.ct ≠
        some (S.embed κ o.pp (C.eval κ (S.cprm κ o.pp) f x y))) ≤ ε κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Perfect correctness implies correctness with error zero [GJLS21, Definition 4.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem Correct.correctExcept_zero (h : S.Correct) : S.CorrectExcept 0

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
An efficient public-key functional-encryption scheme carries uniform efficiency for
public-parameter generation, setup, encryption, key generation, and decryption
[GJLS21, Definition 4.1].

The group-description generator is already uniformly efficient. The `pubGen_eff` field covers
the subsequent nonidentity-generator draw, conditional on the description. This keeps public
generation as sequential dependent draws without constructing a product sampler.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure FEScheme (C : FnClass) extends FEScheme.Raw C where
  /-- Uniformly sample and attach the public generator after the group description. -/
  pubGen_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (d : GroupDescription G κ) => d.val)
    (fun κ d (g : GeneratorDraw G κ d) => List.ofFn ((G.group κ d.val).encG g.val))
    (fun κ _ (pp : PublicParams G κ) => pp.encode) (publicParamsCore G)
  /-- Uniformly sample the complete setup draw and compute the encoded key pair. -/
  setup_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (pp : PublicParams G κ) => pp.encode) encSetupDraw
    (fun κ pp (k : MPK κ pp × MSK κ pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (encMPK κ pp k.1)) (List.ofFn (encMSK κ pp k.2))) setupCore
  /-- Uniformly sample encryption randomness with all other inputs on the parameter word. -/
  enc_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (π : Σ pp : PublicParams G κ,
        MPK κ pp × (Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) × (Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool)) =>
      pairEncode π.1.encode (pairEncode (List.ofFn (encMPK κ π.1 π.2.1))
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn π.2.2.1) (List.ofFn π.2.2.2))))
    (fun κ π => encEncDraw κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2.1 π.2.2.2)
    (fun κ π (c : CT κ π.1) => List.ofFn (encCT κ π.1 c))
    (fun κ π => encCore κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2.1 π.2.2.2)
  /-- Uniformly sample key randomness with the master key and function on the input. -/
  keyGen_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (π : Σ pp : PublicParams G κ, MSK κ pp × (Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)) =>
      pairEncode π.1.encode
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn (encMSK κ π.1 π.2.1)) (List.ofFn π.2.2)))
    (fun κ π => encKeyDraw κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2)
    (fun κ π (k : SK κ π.1) => List.ofFn (encSK κ π.1 k))
    (fun κ π => keyCore κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2)
  /-- One polynomial-time decryption function works for every security and public parameter. -/
  dec_eff : ∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
    ∀ κ (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : SK κ pp)
      (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (ct : CT κ pp),
      a (NUPPT.advInput κ (pairEncode pp.encode
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn (encSK κ pp sk))
          (pairEncode (List.ofFn x) (List.ofFn (encCT κ pp ct)))))) =
        match dec κ pp sk x ct with
        | none => [false]
        | some o => true :: List.ofFn (encDecOut κ pp o)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the public group generator.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_G : S.toRaw.G = S.G

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the class-parameter interpretation.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_cprm : S.toRaw.cprm = S.cprm

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the master public-key family.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_MPK : S.toRaw.MPK = S.MPK

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the master secret-key family.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_MSK : S.toRaw.MSK = S.MSK

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the functional-key family.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_SK : S.toRaw.SK = S.SK

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the ciphertext family.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_CT : S.toRaw.CT = S.CT

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the successful decryption-output family.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_DecOut : S.toRaw.DecOut = S.DecOut

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the interpretation of class values in the output group.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_embed : S.toRaw.embed = S.embed

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the deterministic setup core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_setupCore : S.toRaw.setupCore = S.setupCore

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the deterministic encryption core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_encCore : S.toRaw.encCore = S.encCore

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the deterministic key-generation core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_keyCore : S.toRaw.keyCore = S.keyCore

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves deterministic decryption, including its failure result.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_dec : S.toRaw.dec = S.dec

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the master public-key encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_encMPK : S.toRaw.encMPK = S.encMPK

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the functional-key encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_encSK : S.toRaw.encSK = S.encSK

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the ciphertext encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_encCT : S.toRaw.encCT = S.encCT

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A function class has a public input, a private input, a function description, and an
evaluation map into its parameter-dependent output type [GJLS21, Section 4, p. 18].

The inputs and descriptions use fixed-width bit strings. The parameter and output type remain
arbitrary; in partially hiding encryption the parameter is the drawn group's order, and the
evaluation occurs in the exponent before the scheme embeds the value into the target group.
This separates scalar simulator leakage from the decryption codomain.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure FnClass where
  /-- The width of the public input. -/
  pubLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of the private input. -/
  privLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of a function description. -/
  fnLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The class parameter at each security parameter. -/
  Prm : ℕ → Type
  /-- The evaluation codomain before the scheme's output embedding. -/
  Out : (κ : ℕ) → Prm κ → Type
  /-- A canonical wire encoding for a function value supplied to a simulator. -/
  encValue : (κ : ℕ) → (π : Prm κ) → Out κ π → List Bool
  /-- The value encoding preserves the simulator's allowed value. -/
  encValue_injective : ∀ κ π, Function.Injective (encValue κ π)
  /-- Evaluation of a function on the public and private inputs. -/
  eval : (κ : ℕ) → (π : Prm κ) → (Fin (fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) →
    (Fin (pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → (Fin (privLen.eval κ) → Bool) → Out κ π

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The raw syntax of public-key functional encryption consists of deterministic cores and
finite exact draws, with deterministic decryption [GJLS21, Definition 4.1].

All key and ciphertext types depend on the public parameters so group-valued objects retain
their drawn group. Inputs and function descriptions use the function class's fixed-width
wire types. The output embedding is injective and fixed by the public parameters; it may map
scalar function values into the target group. Efficiency is added by `FEScheme`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure FEScheme.Raw (C : FnClass) where
  /-- The uniform group-description generator. -/
  G : BilinearGen
  /-- The class parameter fixed by public parameters. -/
  cprm : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → C.Prm κ
  /-- The width of an encoded master public key. -/
  mpkLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of an encoded master secret key. -/
  mskLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of an encoded function key. -/
  skLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of the ciphertext excluding its separately public input. -/
  ctLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of a successful decryption output. -/
  decOutLen : PolyExpr
  /-- Master public keys over the drawn group. -/
  MPK : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Master secret keys over the drawn group. -/
  MSK : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Functional decryption keys over the drawn group. -/
  SK : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Ciphertexts over the drawn group. -/
  CT : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- The decryption codomain, before the optional failure marker. -/
  DecOut : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Interpret a function value in the decryption codomain. -/
  embed : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → C.Out κ (cprm κ pp) → DecOut κ pp
  /-- The embedding loses no information about the function value. -/
  embed_injective : ∀ κ pp, Function.Injective (embed κ pp)
  /-- The single draw type of setup. -/
  SetupDraw : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Setup draws have a finite uniform law. -/
  [setupDrawFintype : ∀ κ pp, Fintype (SetupDraw κ pp)]
  /-- Setup draws are nonempty. -/
  [setupDrawNonempty : ∀ κ pp, Nonempty (SetupDraw κ pp)]
  /-- The deterministic setup core. -/
  setupCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → SetupDraw κ pp → MPK κ pp × MSK κ pp
  /-- The single draw type of encryption. -/
  EncDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → MPK κ pp →
    (Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → (Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) → Type
  /-- Encryption draws have a finite uniform law. -/
  [encDrawFintype : ∀ κ pp pk x y, Fintype (EncDraw κ pp pk x y)]
  /-- Encryption draws are nonempty. -/
  [encDrawNonempty : ∀ κ pp pk x y, Nonempty (EncDraw κ pp pk x y)]
  /-- The deterministic encryption core, with both public and private inputs. -/
  encCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → (pk : MPK κ pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) →
    EncDraw κ pp pk x y → CT κ pp
  /-- The single draw type of key generation. -/
  KeyDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → MSK κ pp →
    (Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) → Type
  /-- Key-generation draws have a finite uniform law. -/
  [keyDrawFintype : ∀ κ pp msk f, Fintype (KeyDraw κ pp msk f)]
  /-- Key-generation draws are nonempty. -/
  [keyDrawNonempty : ∀ κ pp msk f, Nonempty (KeyDraw κ pp msk f)]
  /-- The deterministic key-generation core. -/
  keyCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → (msk : MSK κ pp) →
    (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) → KeyDraw κ pp msk f → SK κ pp
  /-- Deterministic decryption, including the public input and an optional failure result. -/
  dec : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → SK κ pp →
    (Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → CT κ pp → Option (DecOut κ pp)
  /-- The master public key's fixed-width encoding. -/
  encMPK : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → MPK κ pp → Fin (mpkLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The master secret key's fixed-width encoding, used by efficiency specifications. -/
  encMSK : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → MSK κ pp → Fin (mskLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The functional key's fixed-width encoding. -/
  encSK : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → SK κ pp → Fin (skLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The ciphertext's fixed-width encoding. -/
  encCT : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → CT κ pp → Fin (ctLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The successful output's fixed-width encoding. -/
  encDecOut : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → DecOut κ pp →
    Fin (decOutLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The encoding of the complete setup draw. -/
  encSetupDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → SetupDraw κ pp → List Bool
  /-- The encoding of the complete encryption draw. -/
  encEncDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → (pk : MPK κ pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) →
    EncDraw κ pp pk x y → List Bool
  /-- The encoding of the complete key-generation draw. -/
  encKeyDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → (msk : MSK κ pp) →
    (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) → KeyDraw κ pp msk f → List Bool
  /-- Public-key encodings distinguish every possible setup output at fixed parameters. -/
  encMPK_inj : ∀ κ pp (r r' : SetupDraw κ pp),
    encMPK κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 = encMPK κ pp (setupCore κ pp r').1 →
      (setupCore κ pp r).1 = (setupCore κ pp r').1
  /-- Function-key encodings distinguish possible keys under one master secret key. -/
  encSK_inj : ∀ κ pp (r : SetupDraw κ pp) f f'
    (t : KeyDraw κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f)
    (t' : KeyDraw κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f'),
    encSK κ pp (keyCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f t) =
      encSK κ pp (keyCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f' t') →
    keyCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f t = keyCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f' t'
  /-- Ciphertext encodings distinguish possible ciphertexts under one public key. -/
  encCT_inj : ∀ κ pp (r : SetupDraw κ pp) x y x' y'
    (t : EncDraw κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x y)
    (t' : EncDraw κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x' y'),
    encCT κ pp (encCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x y t) =
      encCT κ pp (encCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x' y' t') →
    encCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x y t = encCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x' y' t'
  /-- Successful decryption values have lossless encodings. -/
  encDecOut_injective : ∀ κ pp, Function.Injective (encDecOut κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Setup uses the finite draw instance carried by the raw bundle.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
instance instFintypeSetupDraw (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    Fintype (S.SetupDraw κ pp) := S.setupDrawFintype κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Setup uses the nonempty draw instance carried by the raw bundle.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
instance instNonemptySetupDraw (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    Nonempty (S.SetupDraw κ pp) := S.setupDrawNonempty κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encryption uses the finite draw instance carried by the raw bundle.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
instance instFintypeEncDraw (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (pk : S.MPK κ pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    Fintype (S.EncDraw κ pp pk x y) := S.encDrawFintype κ pp pk x y

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encryption uses the nonempty draw instance carried by the raw bundle.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
instance instNonemptyEncDraw (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (pk : S.MPK κ pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    Nonempty (S.EncDraw κ pp pk x y) := S.encDrawNonempty κ pp pk x y

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Key generation uses the finite draw instance carried by the raw bundle.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
instance instFintypeKeyDraw (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (msk : S.MSK κ pp)
    (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    Fintype (S.KeyDraw κ pp msk f) := S.keyDrawFintype κ pp msk f

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Key generation uses the nonempty draw instance carried by the raw bundle.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
instance instNonemptyKeyDraw (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (msk : S.MSK κ pp)
    (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    Nonempty (S.KeyDraw κ pp msk f) := S.keyDrawNonempty κ pp msk f

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The simulator's information consists of the public input and the ordered functions
with their values [GJLS21, Definition 4.3, at epsilon one]. Values are supplied before the
scheme's decryption embedding, as in Theorem 9.2's Hybrid 1, printed p. 61. This records
the scalar-value reading, rather than silently replacing the literal target-group values.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure Omega (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) where
  /-- The number of committed function keys. -/
  count : ℕ
  /-- The public input. -/
  publicInput : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The committed functions, in their original order. -/
  functions : Fin count → Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- Their allowed values on the challenge. -/
  values : Fin count → C.Out κ (S.cprm κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The simulator information is encoded by its count, public input, and ordered pairs.
This is encoding glue for the stateful simulator of [GJLS21, Definition 4.3].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def encode {κ : ℕ} {pp : PublicParams S.G κ} (ω : S.Omega κ pp) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size ω.count) ω.count)
    (pairEncode (List.ofFn ω.publicInput)
      ((List.ofFn fun j => pairEncode (List.ofFn (ω.functions j))
        (C.encValue κ (S.cprm κ pp) (ω.values j))).foldr pairEncode []))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The information encoding is the displayed nested pair in commitment order.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encode_eq {κ : ℕ} {pp : PublicParams S.G κ} (ω : S.Omega κ pp) :
    ω.encode = pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size ω.count) ω.count)
      (pairEncode (List.ofFn ω.publicInput)
        ((List.ofFn fun j => pairEncode (List.ofFn (ω.functions j))
          (C.encValue κ (S.cprm κ pp) (ω.values j))).foldr pairEncode []))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A raw simulator has stateful setup, ciphertext simulation and key simulation
[GJLS21, Definition 4.3]. Key simulation takes a valid commitment index; its function and
value are already in `Omega`. The index identifies the committed order, which a stateful
simulator can track, and avoids an unspecified out-of-range default.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure Simulator.Raw where
  /-- The simulator's private state. -/
  St : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams S.G κ → Type
  /-- A canonical encoding of the private state. -/
  encSt : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → St κ pp → List Bool
  /-- Equal state words retain equal states. -/
  encSt_injective : ∀ κ pp, Function.Injective (encSt κ pp)
  /-- The complete setup draw. -/
  SetupDraw : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams S.G κ → Type
  /-- Setup draws are finite. -/
  [setupFinite : ∀ κ pp, Fintype (SetupDraw κ pp)]
  /-- Setup draws are nonempty. -/
  [setupNonempty : ∀ κ pp, Nonempty (SetupDraw κ pp)]
  /-- Simulated setup returns a public key and private state. -/
  setupCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → SetupDraw κ pp → S.MPK κ pp × St κ pp
  /-- The complete ciphertext-simulation draw, depending on its other inputs. -/
  EncDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → St κ pp → S.Omega κ pp → Type
  /-- Ciphertext-simulation draws are finite. -/
  [encFinite : ∀ κ pp st ω, Fintype (EncDraw κ pp st ω)]
  /-- Ciphertext-simulation draws are nonempty. -/
  [encNonempty : ∀ κ pp st ω, Nonempty (EncDraw κ pp st ω)]
  /-- Ciphertext simulation returns the ciphertext and updated private state. -/
  encCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → (st : St κ pp) → (ω : S.Omega κ pp) →
    EncDraw κ pp st ω → S.CT κ pp × St κ pp
  /-- The complete draw of one indexed key-simulation query. -/
  KeyDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → St κ pp →
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) → Fin ω.count → Type
  /-- Key-simulation draws are finite. -/
  [keyFinite : ∀ κ pp st ω j, Fintype (KeyDraw κ pp st ω j)]
  /-- Key-simulation draws are nonempty. -/
  [keyNonempty : ∀ κ pp st ω j, Nonempty (KeyDraw κ pp st ω j)]
  /-- Key simulation returns the functional key and updated private state. -/
  keyCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → (st : St κ pp) →
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) → (j : Fin ω.count) → KeyDraw κ pp st ω j → S.SK κ pp × St κ pp
  /-- Encode a complete setup draw. -/
  encSetupDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → SetupDraw κ pp → List Bool
  /-- Encode a complete ciphertext-simulation draw. -/
  encEncDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → (st : St κ pp) → (ω : S.Omega κ pp) →
    EncDraw κ pp st ω → List Bool
  /-- Encode a complete key-simulation draw. -/
  encKeyDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → (st : St κ pp) →
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) → (j : Fin ω.count) → KeyDraw κ pp st ω j → List Bool

instance instSetupFinite (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    Fintype (Sim.SetupDraw κ pp) := Sim.setupFinite κ pp

instance instSetupNonempty (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    Nonempty (Sim.SetupDraw κ pp) := Sim.setupNonempty κ pp

instance instEncFinite (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (st : Sim.St κ pp)
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) : Fintype (Sim.EncDraw κ pp st ω) := Sim.encFinite κ pp st ω

instance instEncNonempty (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (st : Sim.St κ pp)
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) : Nonempty (Sim.EncDraw κ pp st ω) := Sim.encNonempty κ pp st ω

instance instKeyFinite (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (st : Sim.St κ pp)
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) (j : Fin ω.count) :
    Fintype (Sim.KeyDraw κ pp st ω j) := Sim.keyFinite κ pp st ω j

instance instKeyNonempty (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (st : Sim.St κ pp)
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) (j : Fin ω.count) :
    Nonempty (Sim.KeyDraw κ pp st ω j) := Sim.keyNonempty κ pp st ω j

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: One ciphertext-simulation input retains its public parameters, state and information.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure EncInput (κ : ℕ) where
  /-- The public parameters. -/
  pp : PublicParams S.G κ
  /-- The current private state. -/
  state : Sim.St κ pp
  /-- The allowed simulator information. -/
  omega : S.Omega κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: One key-simulation input also retains its valid commitment index.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure KeyInput (κ : ℕ) where
  /-- The public parameters. -/
  pp : PublicParams S.G κ
  /-- The current private state. -/
  state : Sim.St κ pp
  /-- The allowed simulator information. -/
  omega : S.Omega κ pp
  /-- The requested function's position in the commitment. -/
  index : Fin omega.count

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The ciphertext-simulation word contains pp, the state and the allowed information.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def encInputWord (κ : ℕ) (π : Sim.EncInput κ) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode π.pp.encode (pairEncode (Sim.encSt κ π.pp π.state) π.omega.encode)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The ciphertext-simulation input has the displayed nested-pair encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encInputWord_eq (κ : ℕ) (π : Sim.EncInput κ) :
    Sim.encInputWord κ π =
      pairEncode π.pp.encode (pairEncode (Sim.encSt κ π.pp π.state) π.omega.encode)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key-simulation word additionally encodes the valid query index.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def keyInputWord (κ : ℕ) (π : Sim.KeyInput κ) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode π.pp.encode (pairEncode (Sim.encSt κ π.pp π.state)
    (pairEncode π.omega.encode
      (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size π.omega.count) π.index.val)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key-simulation input has the displayed nested-pair encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyInputWord_eq (κ : ℕ) (π : Sim.KeyInput κ) :
    Sim.keyInputWord κ π = pairEncode π.pp.encode (pairEncode (Sim.encSt κ π.pp π.state)
      (pairEncode π.omega.encode
        (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size π.omega.count) π.index.val)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulated setup is its exact complete draw followed by its deterministic core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def setup (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    ProbComp (S.MPK κ pp × Sim.St κ pp) :=
  Sim.setupCore κ pp <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.SetupDraw κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The simulated setup law is the displayed pushforward.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setup_eq (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) : Sim.setup κ pp =
    Sim.setupCore κ pp <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.SetupDraw κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulated encryption threads its state through the exact complete draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def enc (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (st : Sim.St κ pp)
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) : ProbComp (S.CT κ pp × Sim.St κ pp) :=
  Sim.encCore κ pp st ω <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.EncDraw κ pp st ω)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The simulated ciphertext law is the displayed pushforward.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem enc_eq (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (st : Sim.St κ pp) (ω : S.Omega κ pp) :
    Sim.enc κ pp st ω =
      Sim.encCore κ pp st ω <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.EncDraw κ pp st ω)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulated key generation threads its state through the exact indexed draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def key (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (st : Sim.St κ pp)
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) (j : Fin ω.count) : ProbComp (S.SK κ pp × Sim.St κ pp) :=
  Sim.keyCore κ pp st ω j <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.KeyDraw κ pp st ω j)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The simulated key law is the displayed pushforward.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem key_eq (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (st : Sim.St κ pp)
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) (j : Fin ω.count) : Sim.key κ pp st ω j =
    Sim.keyCore κ pp st ω j <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.KeyDraw κ pp st ω j)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A stateful simulation interface carries uniform efficiency for all three algorithms
[GJLS21, Definition 4.3]. Every witness precedes the security parameter and all inputs.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure Simulator extends Simulator.Raw S where
  /-- Setup sampling and its state/output encoding are uniformly efficient. -/
  setup_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) => pp.encode) encSetupDraw
    (fun κ pp (o : S.MPK κ pp × St κ pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encMPK κ pp o.1)) (encSt κ pp o.2)) setupCore
  /-- Ciphertext simulation is uniformly efficient with its state and information on input. -/
  enc_eff : SamplesEfficiently toRaw.encInputWord
    (fun κ π => encEncDraw κ π.pp π.state π.omega)
    (fun κ π (o : S.CT κ π.pp × St κ π.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encCT κ π.pp o.1)) (encSt κ π.pp o.2))
    (fun κ π => encCore κ π.pp π.state π.omega)
  /-- Indexed key simulation is uniformly efficient with all other inputs on its word. -/
  key_eff : SamplesEfficiently toRaw.keyInputWord
    (fun κ π => encKeyDraw κ π.pp π.state π.omega π.index)
    (fun κ π (o : S.SK κ π.pp × St κ π.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encSK κ π.pp o.1)) (encSt κ π.pp o.2))
    (fun κ π => keyCore κ π.pp π.state π.omega π.index)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the committed simulator's private-state family.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_St : Sim.toRaw.St = Sim.St

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the committed simulator's private-state encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_encSt : Sim.toRaw.encSt = Sim.encSt

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the committed simulator's deterministic setup core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_setupCore : Sim.toRaw.setupCore = Sim.setupCore

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the committed simulator's deterministic ciphertext core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_encCore : Sim.toRaw.encCore = Sim.encCore

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the committed simulator's indexed deterministic key core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_keyCore : Sim.toRaw.keyCore = Sim.keyCore

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The public-input tensor is `x ⊗ I`, with its singleton column index removed.
This is the tensor in [AGW20, Appendix A, (32), p.38].

The public-input tensor has entry `x i` on matching node coordinates and zero
otherwise: `publicTensor x (i,u) v = x i * (if u=v then 1 else 0)`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem publicTensor_apply (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (i : Fin l) (u v : M) :
    publicTensor x (i, u) v = x i * (if u = v then 1 else 0)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The real partial garbling is `(z − last(t), tᵀ(L1(x ⊗ I) + L0))`.
[AGW20, Lemma 2, p.12; Appendix A, (31)–(32), p.38]. The printed L0/L1 shapes
in Lemma 2 are read with the correction forced by (32).
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def pgbCore
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : (Fin n ⊕ M) → ZMod (p : ℕ) :=
  Sum.elim (fun j => z j - t (Sum.inr j))
    (Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The real garbling is the displayed concatenation of the masked private input
and the matrix product.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pgbCore_eq
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    pgbCore L1 L0 x z t = Sum.elim (fun j => z j - t (Sum.inr j))
      (Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The real garbling's first block is the private input masked by the last draw
coordinates: `pgbCore L1 L0 x z t (inl j) = z j − t (inr j)`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pgbCore_inl
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (j : Fin n) :
    pgbCore L1 L0 x z t (Sum.inl j) = z j - t (Sum.inr j)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The real garbling's second block is `tᵀ(L1(x ⊗ I) + L0)`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pgbCore_inr
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (u : M) :
    pgbCore L1 L0 x z t (Sum.inr u) =
      Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0) u

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The simulated partial garbling replaces the first block by `−last(t)` and
adds the allowed value at the distinguished second-block coordinate.
[AGW20, Lemma 2, p.12; Appendix A, (30)–(32), pp.37–38].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def pgbStarCore
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ))) (m0 : M)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : (Fin n ⊕ M) → ZMod (p : ℕ) :=
  Sum.elim (fun j => -t (Sum.inr j))
    (fun u => Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0) u + if u = m0 then mu else 0)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The simulated garbling is the canonical masked block followed by the matrix
product with the allowed value added at `m0`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pgbStarCore_eq
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ))) (m0 : M)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    pgbStarCore L1 L0 m0 x mu t = Sum.elim (fun j => -t (Sum.inr j))
      (fun u => Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0) u +
        if u = m0 then mu else 0)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The simulated garbling's first block is `−last(t)`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pgbStarCore_inl
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ))) (m0 : M)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (j : Fin n) :
    pgbStarCore L1 L0 m0 x mu t (Sum.inl j) = -t (Sum.inr j)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The simulated garbling's second block is the matrix product with the allowed
value added at `m0`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pgbStarCore_inr
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ))) (m0 : M)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (u : M) :
    pgbStarCore L1 L0 m0 x mu t (Sum.inr u) =
      Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0) u + if u = m0 then mu else 0

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The public parameter word contains binary numerals of the positive modulus,
public-input dimension, and output dimension. Each numeral has its canonical
binary width; the modulus is supplied as input rather than computed from κ.
This is encoding glue for the algorithms of [AGW20, Lemma 2, p.12].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def paramWord (l n : PolyExpr) (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size (p : ℕ)) (p : ℕ))
    (pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size (l.eval kappa)) (l.eval kappa))
      (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size (n.eval kappa)) (n.eval kappa)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The public parameter word is the nested pair of the three binary numerals.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem paramWord_eq (l n : PolyExpr) (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) :
    paramWord l n kappa p =
      pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size (p : ℕ)) (p : ℕ))
        (pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size (l.eval kappa)) (l.eval kappa))
          (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size (n.eval kappa)) (n.eval kappa)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A raw family of partial-garbling algorithms has the corrected matrix syntax,
reconstruction for every draw, and exact privacy.
[AGW20, Lemma 2, p.12; Appendix A, (28)–(32), pp.37–38; IW14, Definition 1, pp.6–7].
The matrix dimensions use the correction forced by (32). Index equivalences fix
all finite-coordinate encodings. The family ranges over every positive modulus
so that uniform efficiency can choose a program before κ and the modulus.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure Raw (l n : PolyExpr) (Fn : (kappa : ℕ) → ℕ+ → Type) where
  /-- Non-output coordinates, including the distinguished source coordinate. -/
  MIdx : (kappa : ℕ) → (p : ℕ+) → Fn kappa p → Type
  /-- Auxiliary draw coordinates; output coordinates form the final draw block. -/
  TIdx : (kappa : ℕ) → (p : ℕ+) → Fn kappa p → Type
  /-- Each non-output coordinate type is finite. -/
  [mFinite : ∀ kappa p f, Fintype (MIdx kappa p f)]
  /-- Each auxiliary draw-coordinate type is finite. -/
  [tFinite : ∀ kappa p f, Fintype (TIdx kappa p f)]
  /-- Equality of non-output coordinates is decidable. -/
  [mDecEq : ∀ kappa p f, DecidableEq (MIdx kappa p f)]
  /-- Equality of auxiliary draw coordinates is decidable. -/
  [tDecEq : ∀ kappa p f, DecidableEq (TIdx kappa p f)]
  /-- The number of non-output coordinates. -/
  mCount : (kappa : ℕ) → (p : ℕ+) → Fn kappa p → ℕ
  /-- A polynomial bound on the non-output dimension, fixed by the function class
  independently of the modulus and adaptively chosen function. This is the size
  bound in [AGW20, Lemma 2, p.12], not an algorithm-efficiency hypothesis. -/
  mBound : PolyExpr
  /-- Every represented function uses at most the fixed polynomial node bound. -/
  mCount_le_mBound : ∀ kappa p f, mCount kappa p f ≤ mBound.eval kappa
  /-- The number of auxiliary draw coordinates. -/
  auxCount : (kappa : ℕ) → (p : ℕ+) → Fn kappa p → ℕ
  /-- Explicit non-output coordinates in the order used on machine inputs. -/
  mCoord : ∀ kappa p f, MIdx kappa p f ≃ Fin (mCount kappa p f)
  /-- Explicit auxiliary coordinates in the order used on machine inputs. -/
  tCoord : ∀ kappa p f, TIdx kappa p f ≃ Fin (auxCount kappa p f)
  /-- There is one fewer auxiliary coordinate than non-output coordinates. -/
  auxCount_add_one : ∀ kappa p f, auxCount kappa p f + 1 = mCount kappa p f
  /-- The distinguished coordinate receiving the simulated allowed value. -/
  m0 : ∀ kappa p f, MIdx kappa p f
  /-- The distinguished coordinate is the first encoded non-output coordinate. -/
  m0_coord : ∀ kappa p f, (mCoord kappa p f (m0 kappa p f)).val = 0
  /-- The width of a function's binary description. -/
  fnLen : ℕ → ℕ+ → ℕ
  /-- The fixed-width encoding of a function. -/
  encFn : ∀ kappa p, Fn kappa p → Fin (fnLen kappa p) → Bool
  /-- Equal function descriptions represent equal functions of the family. -/
  encFn_inj : ∀ kappa p, Function.Injective (encFn kappa p)
  /-- Evaluation of the represented polynomial vector at the public input. -/
  eval : ∀ kappa p, Fn kappa p → (Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) →
    Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)
  /-- The public-variable coefficient matrix, with corrected shape t×(ℓm). -/
  L1 : ∀ kappa p f,
    Matrix (TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa))
      (Fin (l.eval kappa) × MIdx kappa p f) (ZMod (p : ℕ))
  /-- The constant coefficient matrix, with corrected shape t×m. -/
  L0 : ∀ kappa p f,
    Matrix (TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) (MIdx kappa p f) (ZMod (p : ℕ))
  /-- The reconstruction vector, with output coordinates followed by non-output ones. -/
  recVec : ∀ (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p), (Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) →
    (Fin (n.eval kappa) ⊕ MIdx kappa p f) → ZMod (p : ℕ)
  /-- Every draw reconstructs the allowed scalar by the displayed dot product. -/
  rec_spec : ∀ kappa p f x z t,
    dotProduct (pgbCore (L1 kappa p f) (L0 kappa p f) x z t) (recVec kappa p f x) =
      dotProduct z (eval kappa p f x)
  /-- Real and simulated garblings have exactly equal expectations for every test. -/
  privacy : ∀ kappa p f x z
    (test : ((Fin (n.eval kappa) ⊕ MIdx kappa p f) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) → ℝ),
    ProbComp.expect
        (ProbComp.sample ((TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (pgbCore (L1 kappa p f) (L0 kappa p f) x z t)) =
      ProbComp.expect
        (ProbComp.sample ((TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (pgbStarCore (L1 kappa p f) (L0 kappa p f) (m0 kappa p f)
          x (dotProduct z (eval kappa p f x)) t))

instance instFintypeM (S : Raw l n Fn) (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    Fintype (S.MIdx kappa p f) := S.mFinite kappa p f

instance instFintypeT (S : Raw l n Fn) (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    Fintype (S.TIdx kappa p f) := S.tFinite kappa p f

instance instDecidableEqM (S : Raw l n Fn) (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    DecidableEq (S.MIdx kappa p f) := S.mDecEq kappa p f

instance instDecidableEqT (S : Raw l n Fn) (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    DecidableEq (S.TIdx kappa p f) := S.tDecEq kappa p f

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The real partial garbling of a raw family is defined from its two matrices.
[AGW20, Lemma 2, p.12, corrected by Appendix A, (32), p.38].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def pgb (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    (Fin (n.eval kappa) ⊕ S.MIdx kappa p f) → ZMod (p : ℕ) :=
  pgbCore (S.L1 kappa p f) (S.L0 kappa p f) x z t

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The real garbling is `pgbCore` of the raw family's matrices.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pgb_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    S.pgb kappa p f x z t = pgbCore (S.L1 kappa p f) (S.L0 kappa p f) x z t

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The simulated partial garbling is defined from the raw matrices and its
first non-output coordinate. [AGW20, Lemma 2, p.12; Appendix A, p.38].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def pgbStar (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    (Fin (n.eval kappa) ⊕ S.MIdx kappa p f) → ZMod (p : ℕ) :=
  pgbStarCore (S.L1 kappa p f) (S.L0 kappa p f) (S.m0 kappa p f) x mu t

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The simulated garbling is `pgbStarCore` of the raw matrices and distinguished
coordinate.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pgbStar_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    S.pgbStar kappa p f x mu t =
      pgbStarCore (S.L1 kappa p f) (S.L0 kappa p f) (S.m0 kappa p f) x mu t

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Every canonical real garbling reconstructs the allowed scalar, for every draw.
[AGW20, Lemma 2, p.12].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem reconstruct (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    dotProduct (S.pgb kappa p f x z t) (S.recVec kappa p f x) =
      dotProduct z (S.eval kappa p f x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Real and simulated canonical garblings have identical laws, expressed by
expectation equality for every real-valued test. [IW14, Definition 1, p.6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem exactPrivacy (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (test : ((Fin (n.eval kappa) ⊕ S.MIdx kappa p f) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) → ℝ) :
    ProbComp.expect
        (ProbComp.sample ((S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (S.pgb kappa p f x z t)) =
      ProbComp.expect
        (ProbComp.sample ((S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (S.pgbStar kappa p f x (dotProduct z (S.eval kappa p f x)) t))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Draw rows are ordered with auxiliary coordinates first, followed by the last
n output coordinates, exactly as in [AGW20, Appendix A, (31), p.38].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def rowCoord (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    (S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) ≃
      Fin (S.auxCount kappa p f + n.eval kappa) :=
  (Equiv.sumCongr (S.tCoord kappa p f) (Equiv.refl _)).trans finSumFinEquiv

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The draw-row coordinate equivalence is the sum of the supplied auxiliary
coordinate equivalence and the identity, followed by `finSumFinEquiv`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem rowCoord_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    S.rowCoord kappa p f =
      (Equiv.sumCongr (S.tCoord kappa p f) (Equiv.refl _)).trans finSumFinEquiv

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
L1 columns are ordered by public-variable coordinate and then non-output
coordinate. This is the block ordering in [AGW20, Appendix A, (32), p.38].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def l1ColCoord (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    (Fin (l.eval kappa) × S.MIdx kappa p f) ≃
      Fin (l.eval kappa * S.mCount kappa p f) :=
  (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl _) (S.mCoord kappa p f)).trans finProdFinEquiv
