    S.SASimSecure ↔ ∃ Sim : SASimulator S, S.SASimSecureWith Sim.toRaw

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A specified raw simulator has one positive subexponential exponent before
all machines and query budgets. [JLS26, §1.1; Wee20, §2.2, p.5].
The common exponent precedes both the machine and query-budget quantifiers.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem subexpSASimSecureWith_iff (Sim : SASimulator.Raw S) :
    S.SubexpSASimSecureWith Sim ↔
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ A : NUPPT, ∀ q : PolyExpr,
        SubexpSmall c (S.saSimAdv Sim (toSAAdv (S := S) A q))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Subexponential semi-adaptive security uses one efficient universal simulator.
[JLS26, §1.1; Wee20, §2.2, p.5].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def SubexpSASimSecure : Prop :=
  ∃ Sim : SASimulator S, S.SubexpSASimSecureWith Sim.toRaw

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The public subexponential notion quantifies over efficient simulators.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem subexpSASimSecure_iff :
    S.SubexpSASimSecure ↔ ∃ Sim : SASimulator S, S.SubexpSASimSecureWith Sim.toRaw

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A positive common subexponential exponent implies negligible raw advantage.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem SubexpSASimSecureWith.saSimSecureWith {Sim : SASimulator.Raw S}
    (h : S.SubexpSASimSecureWith Sim) : S.SASimSecureWith Sim

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A raw semi-adaptive simulator has stateful setup, public-input-only ciphertext
simulation, and key simulation from each allowed scalar. [Wee20, §2.2, p.5].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure SASimulator.Raw where
  /-- The simulator state over the drawn public parameters. -/
  St : (kappa : ℕ) → PublicParams S.G kappa → Type
  /-- The canonical state word used by uniform efficiency. -/
  encSt : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → St kappa pp → List Bool
  /-- State encodings lose no information. -/
  encSt_injective : ∀ kappa pp, Function.Injective (encSt kappa pp)
  /-- The complete setup draw. -/
  SetupDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → PublicParams S.G kappa → Type
  /-- Setup draws are finite. -/
  [setupFinite : ∀ kappa pp, Fintype (SetupDraw kappa pp)]
  /-- Setup draws are nonempty. -/
  [setupNonempty : ∀ kappa pp, Nonempty (SetupDraw kappa pp)]
  /-- Setup generates the simulated public key and initial private state. -/
  setupCore : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → SetupDraw kappa pp →
    S.MPK kappa pp × St kappa pp
  /-- The complete ciphertext draw depends on the state and public input only. -/
  EncDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → St kappa pp →
    (Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → Type
  /-- Ciphertext draws are finite. -/
  [encFinite : ∀ kappa pp st x, Fintype (EncDraw kappa pp st x)]
  /-- Ciphertext draws are nonempty. -/
  [encNonempty : ∀ kappa pp st x, Nonempty (EncDraw kappa pp st x)]
  /-- Ciphertext simulation never receives the private challenge input. -/
  encCore : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → (st : St kappa pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → EncDraw kappa pp st x →
    S.CT kappa pp × St kappa pp
  /-- One key's complete draw depends on its state, public input, function and value. -/
  KeyDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → St kappa pp →
    (Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → (Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool) →
    C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp) → Type
  /-- Key-simulation draws are finite. -/
  [keyFinite : ∀ kappa pp st x f mu, Fintype (KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu)]
  /-- Key-simulation draws are nonempty. -/
  [keyNonempty : ∀ kappa pp st x f mu, Nonempty (KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu)]
  /-- Key simulation receives exactly the public input, function and allowed scalar. -/
  keyCore : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → (st : St kappa pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool) →
    (mu : C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp)) → KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu →
    S.SK kappa pp × St kappa pp
  /-- Encode a complete setup draw. -/
  encSetupDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → SetupDraw kappa pp → List Bool
  /-- Encode a complete ciphertext-simulation draw. -/
  encEncDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → (st : St kappa pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → EncDraw kappa pp st x → List Bool
  /-- Encode a complete key-simulation draw. -/
  encKeyDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → (st : St kappa pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool) →
    (mu : C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp)) → KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu → List Bool

instance instSetupFinite (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) :
    Fintype (Sim.SetupDraw kappa pp) := Sim.setupFinite kappa pp

instance instSetupNonempty (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) :
    Nonempty (Sim.SetupDraw kappa pp) := Sim.setupNonempty kappa pp

instance instEncFinite (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) (st : Sim.St kappa pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) : Fintype (Sim.EncDraw kappa pp st x) :=
  Sim.encFinite kappa pp st x

instance instEncNonempty (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) (st : Sim.St kappa pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) : Nonempty (Sim.EncDraw kappa pp st x) :=
  Sim.encNonempty kappa pp st x

instance instKeyFinite (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) (st : Sim.St kappa pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (mu : C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp)) : Fintype (Sim.KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu) :=
  Sim.keyFinite kappa pp st x f mu

instance instKeyNonempty (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) (st : Sim.St kappa pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (mu : C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp)) : Nonempty (Sim.KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu) :=
  Sim.keyNonempty kappa pp st x f mu

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A ciphertext-simulation input contains pp, the private state and public input.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure EncInput (kappa : ℕ) where
  /-- The public parameters. -/
  pp : PublicParams S.G kappa
  /-- The current simulator state. -/
  state : Sim.St kappa pp
  /-- The public challenge input. -/
  publicInput : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A key-simulation input additionally contains the requested function and allowed scalar.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure KeyInput (kappa : ℕ) where
  /-- The public parameters. -/
  pp : PublicParams S.G kappa
  /-- The current simulator state. -/
  state : Sim.St kappa pp
  /-- The public challenge input. -/
  publicInput : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool
  /-- The requested function. -/
  function : Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool
  /-- The allowed scalar, before target-group embedding. -/
  value : C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The ciphertext-simulation parameter word excludes the private input.
The ciphertext parameter word has exactly the displayed public information.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encInputWord_eq (kappa : ℕ) (pi : Sim.EncInput kappa) :
    Sim.encInputWord kappa pi = pairEncode pi.pp.encode
      (pairEncode (Sim.encSt kappa pi.pp pi.state) (List.ofFn pi.publicInput))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key-simulation word encodes the state, public input, function and scalar.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def keyInputWord (kappa : ℕ) (pi : Sim.KeyInput kappa) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode pi.pp.encode (pairEncode (Sim.encSt kappa pi.pp pi.state)
    (pairEncode (List.ofFn pi.publicInput)
      (pairEncode (List.ofFn pi.function) (C.encValue kappa (S.cprm kappa pi.pp) pi.value))))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key-simulation word has the displayed nested-pair encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyInputWord_eq (kappa : ℕ) (pi : Sim.KeyInput kappa) :
    Sim.keyInputWord kappa pi = pairEncode pi.pp.encode
      (pairEncode (Sim.encSt kappa pi.pp pi.state)
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn pi.publicInput)
          (pairEncode (List.ofFn pi.function)
            (C.encValue kappa (S.cprm kappa pi.pp) pi.value))))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulated setup applies its deterministic core to one exact complete draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def setup (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) :
    ProbComp (S.MPK kappa pp × Sim.St kappa pp) :=
  Sim.setupCore kappa pp <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.SetupDraw kappa pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The setup law is the displayed pushforward of its complete draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setup_eq (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) :
    Sim.setup kappa pp = Sim.setupCore kappa pp <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.SetupDraw kappa pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Ciphertext simulation sees only the public input and threads its state.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def enc (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) (st : Sim.St kappa pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) : ProbComp (S.CT kappa pp × Sim.St kappa pp) :=
  Sim.encCore kappa pp st x <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.EncDraw kappa pp st x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The ciphertext law is the displayed pushforward of its complete draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem enc_eq (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) (st : Sim.St kappa pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) : Sim.enc kappa pp st x =
    Sim.encCore kappa pp st x <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.EncDraw kappa pp st x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Key simulation sees the queried function and its allowed scalar and threads state.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def key (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) (st : Sim.St kappa pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (mu : C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp)) : ProbComp (S.SK kappa pp × Sim.St kappa pp) :=
  Sim.keyCore kappa pp st x f mu <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key law is the displayed pushforward of its complete draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem key_eq (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) (st : Sim.St kappa pp)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (mu : C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp)) : Sim.key kappa pp st x f mu =
    Sim.keyCore kappa pp st x f mu <$> ProbComp.sample (Sim.KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A semi-adaptive simulation interface carries uniform efficiency for all three
samplers. [Wee20, §2.2, p.5; AGW20, §4.1, pp.11–12]. The shared contract chooses
one sampler/core witness before kappa and every public input.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure SASimulator extends SASimulator.Raw S where
  /-- Setup and its encoded public key/state output are uniformly efficient. -/
  setup_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun kappa (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) => pp.encode) encSetupDraw
    (fun kappa pp (o : S.MPK kappa pp × St kappa pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encMPK kappa pp o.1)) (encSt kappa pp o.2)) setupCore
  /-- Public-input-only ciphertext simulation is uniformly efficient. -/
  enc_eff : SamplesEfficiently toRaw.encInputWord
    (fun kappa pi => encEncDraw kappa pi.pp pi.state pi.publicInput)
    (fun kappa pi (o : S.CT kappa pi.pp × St kappa pi.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encCT kappa pi.pp o.1)) (encSt kappa pi.pp o.2))
    (fun kappa pi => encCore kappa pi.pp pi.state pi.publicInput)
  /-- Key simulation is uniformly efficient with all permitted inputs on its word. -/
  key_eff : SamplesEfficiently toRaw.keyInputWord
    (fun kappa pi => encKeyDraw kappa pi.pp pi.state pi.publicInput pi.function pi.value)
    (fun kappa pi (o : S.SK kappa pi.pp × St kappa pi.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encSK kappa pi.pp o.1)) (encSt kappa pi.pp o.2))
    (fun kappa pi => keyCore kappa pi.pp pi.state pi.publicInput pi.function pi.value)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the semi-adaptive simulator's private-state family.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_St : Sim.toRaw.St = Sim.St

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the semi-adaptive simulator's private-state encoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_encSt : Sim.toRaw.encSt = Sim.encSt

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the semi-adaptive simulator's deterministic setup core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_setupCore : Sim.toRaw.setupCore = Sim.setupCore

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves the public-input-only deterministic ciphertext core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_encCore : Sim.toRaw.encCore = Sim.encCore

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw projection preserves key simulation from its function and allowed scalar.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem toRaw_keyCore : Sim.toRaw.keyCore = Sim.keyCore

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Encode an already represented public view, retaining the committed key order.
This shared word constructor permits a wire adversary to retain answers without decoding
arbitrary scheme objects [GJLS21, Definition 4.3].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def viewWordBits {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ} (a : Commitment C q κ)
    (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (pk : Fin (S.mpkLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (keys : List (Fin (S.skLen.eval κ) → Bool))
    (ct : Fin (S.ctLen.eval κ) → Bool) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode a.state (pairEncode pp.encode
    (pairEncode (List.ofFn pk)
      (pairEncode ((keys.map List.ofFn).foldr pairEncode [])
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn a.publicInput) (List.ofFn ct)))))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The represented view has the displayed nested encoding in committed key order.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem viewWordBits_eq {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ} (a : Commitment C q κ)
    (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (pk : Fin (S.mpkLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (keys : List (Fin (S.skLen.eval κ) → Bool))
    (ct : Fin (S.ctLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    S.viewWordBits a pp pk keys ct = pairEncode a.state (pairEncode pp.encode
      (pairEncode (List.ofFn pk)
        (pairEncode ((keys.map List.ofFn).foldr pairEncode [])
          (pairEncode (List.ofFn a.publicInput) (List.ofFn ct)))))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Encode the first-stage state and the view `(pp, pk, keys, x, ct)` supplied to the
second machine [GJLS21, Definition 4.3, at epsilon one; Remark 4.6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def viewWord {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ} (a : Commitment C q κ)
    (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (pk : S.MPK κ pp) (keys : List (S.SK κ pp))
    (ct : S.CT κ pp) : List Bool :=
  S.viewWordBits a pp (S.encMPK κ pp pk) (keys.map (S.encSK κ pp))
    (S.encCT κ pp ct)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The second-stage word is the displayed nested pair in committed key order.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem viewWord_eq {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ} (a : Commitment C q κ)
    (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (pk : S.MPK κ pp) (keys : List (S.SK κ pp))
    (ct : S.CT κ pp) :
    S.viewWord a pp pk keys ct = pairEncode a.state (pairEncode pp.encode
      (pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encMPK κ pp pk))
        (pairEncode ((keys.map fun sk => List.ofFn (S.encSK κ pp sk)).foldr pairEncode [])
          (pairEncode (List.ofFn a.publicInput) (List.ofFn (S.encCT κ pp ct))))))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encoding the typed view applies the shared represented-view constructor to its encodings.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem viewWord_eq_viewWordBits {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ} (a : Commitment C q κ)
    (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) (pk : S.MPK κ pp) (keys : List (S.SK κ pp))
    (ct : S.CT κ pp) :
    S.viewWord a pp pk keys ct = S.viewWordBits a pp (S.encMPK κ pp pk)
      (keys.map (S.encSK κ pp)) (S.encCT κ pp ct)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Produce the real view after the commitment is fixed. Keys are sampled in increasing
committed order using the shared monadic list traversal [GJLS21, Definition 4.3].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def realView {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ} (a : Commitment C q κ) :
    ProbComp (List Bool) :=
  (S.pubGen κ).bind fun pp =>
  (S.setup κ pp).bind fun k =>
  (S.enc κ pp k.1 a.publicInput a.privateInput).bind fun ct =>
  (List.mapM (fun j => S.keyGen κ pp k.2 (a.functions j))
    (List.finRange (q.eval κ))).bind fun keys =>
      .pure (S.viewWord a pp k.1 keys ct)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The real view is exactly the displayed sequential experiment.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem realView_eq {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ} (a : Commitment C q κ) :
    S.realView a =
      (S.pubGen κ).bind fun pp =>
      (S.setup κ pp).bind fun k =>
      (S.enc κ pp k.1 a.publicInput a.privateInput).bind fun ct =>
      (List.mapM (fun j => S.keyGen κ pp k.2 (a.functions j))
        (List.finRange (q.eval κ))).bind fun keys =>
          .pure (S.viewWord a pp k.1 keys ct)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Produce the ideal view from the allowed information. State is threaded through
ciphertext simulation and then all committed keys [GJLS21, Definition 4.3].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def idealView (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ}
    (a : Commitment C q κ) : ProbComp (List Bool) :=
  (S.pubGen κ).bind fun pp =>
  (Sim.setup κ pp).bind fun k =>
  (Sim.enc κ pp k.2 (a.omega S pp)).bind fun cst =>
  (List.mapM (m := StateT (Sim.St κ pp) ProbComp)
    (fun j st => Sim.key κ pp st (a.omega S pp) j)
    (List.finRange (q.eval κ)) cst.2).bind fun keys =>
      .pure (S.viewWord a pp k.1 keys.1 cst.1)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The ideal view is exactly the displayed state-threaded experiment.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem idealView_eq (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ}
    (a : Commitment C q κ) : S.idealView Sim a =
      (S.pubGen κ).bind fun pp =>
      (Sim.setup κ pp).bind fun k =>
      (Sim.enc κ pp k.2 (a.omega S pp)).bind fun cst =>
      (List.mapM (m := StateT (Sim.St κ pp) ProbComp)
        (fun j st => Sim.key κ pp st (a.omega S pp) j)
        (List.finRange (q.eval κ)) cst.2).bind fun keys =>
          .pure (S.viewWord a pp k.1 keys.1 cst.1)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The committed simulation game draws first-stage coins before pp, then gives the
chosen public view to the second machine with independent coins
[GJLS21, Definition 4.3, epsilon one; Remark 4.6]. The Boolean flag selects real when true.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def simGame (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) (A : TwoStage)
    (q : PolyExpr) (real : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : ProbComp Bool :=
  (ProbComp.sample (A.first.Coins κ)).bind fun r₁ =>
    let a := Commitment.decode C q κ (A.first.runAt κ [] r₁)
    (if real then S.realView a else S.idealView Sim a).bind fun v =>
    (ProbComp.sample (A.second.Coins κ)).bind fun r₂ =>
      .pure (A.second.distinguisherL κ v r₂)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The simulation game is the displayed two-stage machine experiment.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simGame_eq (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) (A : TwoStage)
    (q : PolyExpr) (real : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : S.simGame Sim A q real κ =
      (ProbComp.sample (A.first.Coins κ)).bind fun r₁ =>
        let a

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Simulation advantage is the absolute difference of real and ideal acceptance
probabilities [GJLS21, Definition 4.3, epsilon one].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def simAdv (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) (A : TwoStage) (q : PolyExpr)
    (κ : ℕ) : ℝ := advantage (S.simGame Sim A q true κ) (S.simGame Sim A q false κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulation advantage uses the common two-experiment convention.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simAdv_eq (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) (A : TwoStage) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) :
    S.simAdv Sim A q κ = advantage (S.simGame Sim A q true κ)
      (S.simGame Sim A q false κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A specified raw simulator gives negligible advantage against every pair of non-uniform
PPT machines and every polynomial key count [GJLS21, Definition 4.3; Remark 4.6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def SimSecureWith (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : TwoStage, ∀ q : PolyExpr, Negligible (S.simAdv Sim A q)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Raw simulation security is negligible advantage for every machine pair and key count.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simSecureWith_iff (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) :
    S.SimSecureWith Sim ↔ ∀ A : TwoStage, ∀ q : PolyExpr, Negligible (S.simAdv Sim A q)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Public-key simulation security has one efficient, stateful simulator before all
adversaries and key counts [GJLS21, Definition 4.3, epsilon one; Remark 4.6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: def SimSecure : Prop := ∃ Sim : Simulator S, S.SimSecureWith Sim.toRaw

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulation security quantifies over the efficient simulator interface.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simSecure_iff :
    S.SimSecure ↔ ∃ Sim : Simulator S, S.SimSecureWith Sim.toRaw

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A specified raw simulator has one positive subexponential exponent before every
adversary and polynomial key count [JLS26, Section 1.1; GJLS21, Definition 4.3].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def SubexpSimSecureWith (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ A : TwoStage, ∀ q : PolyExpr, SubexpSmall c (S.simAdv Sim A q)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The subexponential exponent precedes the adversaries and the key count.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem subexpSimSecureWith_iff (Sim : Simulator.Raw S) :
    S.SubexpSimSecureWith Sim ↔
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ A : TwoStage, ∀ q : PolyExpr, SubexpSmall c (S.simAdv Sim A q)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Subexponential simulation security has one efficient universal simulator and one
positive common security exponent [JLS26, Section 1.1; GJLS21, Definition 4.3].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: def SubexpSimSecure : Prop := ∃ Sim : Simulator S, S.SubexpSimSecureWith Sim.toRaw

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Subexponential security quantifies over an efficient simulator.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem subexpSimSecure_iff :
    S.SubexpSimSecure ↔ ∃ Sim : Simulator S, S.SubexpSimSecureWith Sim.toRaw

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Subexponential raw simulation security implies negligible raw simulation security.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem SubexpSimSecureWith.simSecureWith {Sim : Simulator.Raw S}
    (h : S.SubexpSimSecureWith Sim) : S.SimSecureWith Sim

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A two-stage adversary is a pair of non-uniform PPT machines. The first commits before
public parameters, and the second distinguishes the resulting public view
[GJLS21, Definition 4.3, at epsilon one; Remark 4.6, many keys].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure TwoStage where
  /-- The commitment machine. -/
  first : NUPPT
  /-- The final distinguishing machine. -/
  second : NUPPT

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A commitment contains both inputs, the ordered function descriptions, and arbitrary
first-stage state [GJLS21, Definition 4.3]. The key count is the polynomial budget.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure Commitment (C : FnClass) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) where
  /-- The public challenge input. -/
  publicInput : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The private challenge input. -/
  privateInput : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- All committed function descriptions. -/
  functions : Fin (q.eval κ) → Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The first machine's retained state. -/
  state : List Bool

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Decode successive public, private and function windows, followed by an arbitrary state
suffix. Missing input bits are false. This total parser imposes no validity restriction on
non-uniform adversaries [GJLS21, Definition 4.3].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def decode (C : FnClass) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : Commitment C q κ where
  publicInput i := w.getD i.val false
  privateInput i := w.getD (C.pubLen.eval κ + i.val) false
  functions j i := w.getD
    (C.pubLen.eval κ + C.privLen.eval κ + j.val * C.fnLen.eval κ + i.val) false
  state := w.drop (C.pubLen.eval κ + C.privLen.eval κ + q.eval κ * C.fnLen.eval κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The commitment parser reads the displayed windows and retains their remaining suffix.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decode_eq (C : FnClass) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (w : List Bool) :
    decode C q κ w =
      ⟨(fun i => w.getD i.val false),
        (fun i => w.getD (C.pubLen.eval κ + i.val) false),
        (fun j i => w.getD
          (C.pubLen.eval κ + C.privLen.eval κ + j.val * C.fnLen.eval κ + i.val) false),
        w.drop (C.pubLen.eval κ + C.privLen.eval κ + q.eval κ * C.fnLen.eval κ)⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Derive the simulator's allowed public input and ordered function/value pairs from a
commitment [GJLS21, Definition 4.3; Theorem 9.2 proof, Hybrid 1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def omega (a : Commitment C q κ) (S : FEScheme.Raw C) (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    S.Omega κ pp where
  count := q.eval κ
  publicInput := a.publicInput
  functions := a.functions
  values j := C.eval κ (S.cprm κ pp) (a.functions j) a.publicInput a.privateInput

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Allowed information retains the committed functions and evaluates them on the input.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem omega_eq (a : Commitment C q κ) (S : FEScheme.Raw C)
    (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    a.omega S pp = ⟨q.eval κ, a.publicInput, a.functions,
      fun j => C.eval κ (S.cprm κ pp) (a.functions j) a.publicInput a.privateInput⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Π's public key holds `[A]`, `[AW]`, `[AU]` and `[AV]`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Setup].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure MPK (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The two-by-three implicit matrix. -/
  A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 3) pp.group.G
  /-- The implicit private-input mask. -/
  AW : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The implicit public-variable mask. -/
  AU : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) pp.group.G
  /-- The implicit constant mask. -/
  AV : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) pp.group.G

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Π's master secret consists of its three scalar masking matrices
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Setup].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure MSK (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The private-input masking matrix. -/
  W : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The public-variable masking matrix. -/
  U : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The constant masking matrix. -/
  V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Π's ciphertext has its three source-group blocks, with the public input supplied
separately to decryption [Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Enc].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure CT (G : BilinearGen) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The three-coordinate mask `[sA]`. -/
  c0 : Fin 3 → pp.group.G
  /-- The masked private input. -/
  c1 : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → pp.group.G
  /-- The two-coordinate public-input mask. -/
  c2 : Fin 2 → pp.group.G

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A function key contains the three garbling blocks and `[R]`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, KeyGen]. The function and its group matrix are explicit key metadata.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure Key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) where
  /-- The three-by-output first block. -/
  K1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The public-variable garbling block. -/
  K2 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) pp.group.G
  /-- The constant garbling block. -/
  K3 : Matrix (Fin 3) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) pp.group.G
  /-- The two-row reconstruction mask. -/
  R : Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) pp.group.G

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Setup's single draw contains independent uniform `A,W,U,V`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Setup].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev SetupDraw (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :=
  Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 3) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The setup draw type is exactly its four scalar matrices.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setupDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp =
      (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 3) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encryption draws its two scalar coefficients [Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Enc].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev EncDraw (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :=
  Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encryption randomness is a two-coordinate scalar vector.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    EncDraw G κ pp = (Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Key generation draws `T` and `R` in the function's actual garbling coordinates
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, KeyGen]. The last block of `T` has output length `n'`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev KeyDraw (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :=
  Matrix (Fin 3) (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) (ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key draw type is the product of the `T` and `R` matrix types.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    KeyDraw G PG κ pp f =
      (Matrix (Fin 3) (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ))
          (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) (ZMod pp.group.order))

instance instSetupDrawFinite (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ z : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    Fintype (SetupDraw G ℓ z κ pp) := inferInstance

instance instSetupDrawNonempty (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ z : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    Nonempty (SetupDraw G ℓ z κ pp) := inferInstance

instance instEncDrawFinite (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    Fintype (EncDraw G κ pp) := inferInstance

instance instEncDrawNonempty (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    Nonempty (EncDraw G κ pp) := inferInstance

instance instKeyDrawFinite (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    Fintype (KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) := inferInstance

instance instKeyDrawNonempty (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    Nonempty (KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) := inferInstance

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Setup exponentiates the four public matrices and retains `W,U,V`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Setup].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def setupCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp) : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp × MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp :=
  let A := ω.1
  let W := ω.2.1
  let U := ω.2.2.1
  let V := ω.2.2.2
  (⟨pp.group.expMat pp.generator A, pp.group.expMat pp.generator (A * W),
    pp.group.expMat pp.generator (A * U), pp.group.expMat pp.generator (A * V)⟩,
    ⟨W, U, V⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Setup's core is the displayed public exponentiation and secret-matrix tuple.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setupCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ω : SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp ω =
      (⟨pp.group.expMat pp.generator ω.1,
        pp.group.expMat pp.generator (ω.1 * ω.2.1),
        pp.group.expMat pp.generator (ω.1 * ω.2.2.1),
        pp.group.expMat pp.generator (ω.1 * ω.2.2.2)⟩, ⟨ω.2.1, ω.2.2.1, ω.2.2.2⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Encryption forms the three group ciphertext blocks from a group-valued private input
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Enc]. Only products and powers by known scalars are used.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def encCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → pp.group.G) (s : EncDraw G κ pp) : CT G zDim κ pp :=
  ⟨groupVecMul s pk.A, z * groupVecMul s pk.AW,
    groupVecMul s (groupMatMul pk.AU
      (PartialGarbling.publicTensor (p := pp.orderParam) (M := Fin 2) x)) *
      groupVecMul s pk.AV⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The encryption core uses the canonical public tensor and the three public-key blocks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → pp.group.G)
    (s : EncDraw G κ pp) :
    encCore G ℓ zDim κ pp pk x z s =
      ⟨groupVecMul s pk.A, z * groupVecMul s pk.AW,
        groupVecMul s (groupMatMul pk.AU
          (PartialGarbling.publicTensor (p := pp.orderParam) (M := Fin 2) x)) *
          groupVecMul s pk.AV⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Key generation computes `[T̲+WM]`, `[TL1+U(I⊗R)]`, `[TL0+VR]`, `[R]`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, KeyGen]. The matrix `M` is supplied only in the source group.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def keyCore (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (ω : KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) : Key G PG κ pp f :=
  let T := ω.1
  let R := ω.2
  let Tbar := fun i j => T i (Sum.inr j)
  let tensorR := Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a * b)
    (1 : Matrix (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)) R
  ⟨pp.group.expMat pp.generator Tbar ⊙ matMulGroup msk.W M,
    pp.group.expMat pp.generator (T * (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PG.L1 κ
      pp.orderParam f) + msk.U * tensorR),
    pp.group.expMat pp.generator (T * (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PG.L0 κ
      pp.orderParam f) + msk.V * R),
    pp.group.expMat pp.generator R⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Key generation is the displayed scalar garbling arithmetic and group matrix action.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (ω : KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    keyCore G PG zDim κ pp msk f M ω =
      let tensorR

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Decryption's first block is `e(c1,M)/e(c0,K1)`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, (6)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def decFirst (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (sk : Key G PG κ pp f) (ct : CT G zDim κ pp) : Fin (n'.eval κ) → pp.group.GT :=
  fun j => pp.group.pairVec ct.c1 (fun a => M a j) *
    (pp.group.pairVec ct.c0 (fun i => sk.K1 i j))⁻¹

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Each first-block coordinate is its two vector-pairing factors.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decFirst_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (sk : Key G PG κ pp f) (ct : CT G zDim κ pp) :
    decFirst G PG zDim κ pp f M sk ct = fun j =>
      pp.group.pairVec ct.c1 (fun a => M a j) *
        (pp.group.pairVec ct.c0 (fun i => sk.K1 i j))⁻¹

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Decryption's second block cancels the public-input mask by pairings
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, (7)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def decSecond (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (sk : Key G PG κ pp f) (ct : CT G zDim κ pp) : PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f → pp.group.GT :=
  let K := groupMatMul sk.K2
    (PartialGarbling.publicTensor (p := pp.orderParam) (M := PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) x)
  fun u => pp.group.pairVec ct.c0 (fun i => K i u * sk.K3 i u) *
    (pp.group.pairVec ct.c2 (fun i => sk.R i u))⁻¹

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The second block uses the canonical public tensor on the function's garbling nodes.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decSecond_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (sk : Key G PG κ pp f) (ct : CT G zDim κ pp) :
    decSecond G PG zDim κ pp f x sk ct =
      let K

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Decryption applies the scalar reconstruction vector to the paired garbling blocks
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, (8)]. It returns the result in the target group.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def dec (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (sk : Key G PG κ pp f)
    (ct : CT G zDim κ pp) : pp.group.GT :=
  groupDot (Sum.elim (decFirst G PG zDim κ pp f M sk ct)
    (decSecond G PG zDim κ pp f x sk ct)) (PG.recVec κ pp.orderParam f x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Decryption is the known-power product specified by the reconstruction vector.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem dec_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (sk : Key G PG κ pp f)
    (ct : CT G zDim κ pp) :
    dec G PG zDim κ pp f M x sk ct =
      groupDot (Sum.elim (decFirst G PG zDim κ pp f M sk ct)
        (decSecond G PG zDim κ pp f x sk ct)) (PG.recVec κ pp.orderParam f x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Compute `[z M f(x)^T]` from an arbitrary group matrix and the known scalar input and
function value [Wee20, §4, p. 8]. This is Π's simulator leakage.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def leak (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) : pp.group.G :=
  groupDot (groupMulVec M (PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x)) z

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The leakage uses only known powers of the supplied group matrix.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem leak_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    leak G PG zDim κ pp f M x z =
      groupDot (groupMulVec M (PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x)) z

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Honest setup is uniform sampling of its one draw type followed by the core
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def setup (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : ProbComp (MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp × MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) :=
  (setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp <$> (ProbComp.sample (SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Honest setup has the displayed core-plus-draw law.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setup_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    setup G ℓ zDim κ pp =
      (setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp <$> (ProbComp.sample (SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Honest encryption samples its two scalars and applies the core [Wee20, §4.2, p. 9].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def enc (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → pp.group.G) : ProbComp (CT G zDim κ pp) :=
  (encCore G ℓ zDim κ pp pk x z <$> (ProbComp.sample (EncDraw G κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Honest encryption has the displayed core-plus-draw law.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem enc_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → pp.group.G) :
    enc G ℓ zDim κ pp pk x z =
      (encCore G ℓ zDim κ pp pk x z <$> (ProbComp.sample (EncDraw G κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Honest key generation samples its actual function-dependent matrices and applies the
core [Wee20, §4.2, p. 9]. This is one draw, not a product-sampler construction.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def keyGen (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G) :
    ProbComp (Key G PG κ pp f) :=
  (keyCore G PG zDim κ pp msk f M <$> (ProbComp.sample (KeyDraw G PG κ pp f)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Honest key generation has the displayed core-plus-draw law.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyGen_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G) :
    keyGen G PG zDim κ pp msk f M =
      (keyCore G PG zDim κ pp msk f M <$> (ProbComp.sample (KeyDraw G PG κ pp f)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Π is an internal raw bundle of cores, with efficiency supplied only through the outer
construction's targets [Wee20, §4.2, pp. 9–10].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure RawAlgorithms (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- Honest setup core. -/
  setupCore : SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp → MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp × MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp
  /-- Honest encryption core on a source-group private vector. -/
  encCore : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp → (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) →
    (Fin (zDim.eval κ) → pp.group.G) → EncDraw G κ pp → CT G zDim κ pp
  /-- Honest function-dependent key-generation core. -/
  keyCore : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp → (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) →
    Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G →
    KeyDraw G PG κ pp f → Key G PG κ pp f
  /-- Deterministic decryption in the target group. -/
  dec : (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) →
    Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G →
    (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) → Key G PG κ pp f → CT G zDim κ pp → pp.group.GT

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Assemble the four explicit cores into Π's internal raw bundle
[Wee20, §4.2, pp. 9–10]. No efficient interface is instantiated here.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def scheme_raw (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    RawAlgorithms G PG zDim κ pp :=
  ⟨setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp, encCore G ℓ zDim κ pp,
    keyCore G PG zDim κ pp, dec G PG zDim κ pp⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw bundle contains exactly the four explicitly defined cores.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem scheme_raw_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    scheme_raw G PG zDim κ pp =
      ⟨setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp, encCore G ℓ zDim κ pp,
        keyCore G PG zDim κ pp, dec G PG zDim κ pp⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The output part of reconstruction equals the function value. This is coefficient glue
from the reconstruction law [AGW20, Lemma 2, p. 12].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem rec_output_eq_eval (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (j : Fin (n'.eval κ)) :
    PG.recVec κ pp.orderParam f x (Sum.inl j) = PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x j

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The reconstruction vector cancels every garbling-draw coordinate. This is coefficient
form of the reconstruction law [AGW20, Lemma 2, p. 12; Appendix A, (29), p. 37].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem rec_matrix_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    ((show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PG.L1 κ pp.orderParam f) *
        (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PartialGarbling.publicTensor (p :=
          pp.orderParam) (M := PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) x) +
      (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PG.L0 κ pp.orderParam f)) *ᵥ (fun u => PG.recVec κ
        pp.orderParam f x (Sum.inr u)) =
        Sum.elim (fun _ => 0) (PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The leakage is the product of the supplied group-matrix entries raised to the known
coefficients `z_a f_b(x)` [Wee20, §4, p. 8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem leak_product (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    leak G PG zDim κ pp f M x z =
      ∏ a, ∏ b, M a b ^ (z a * (show ZMod pp.group.order from PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x b)).val

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The first decryption block is the group-valued allowed input mask minus the last
coordinates of `sAT` [Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, (9)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decFirst_correct (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (a : SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp) (s : EncDraw G κ pp) (t : KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    decFirst G PG zDim κ pp f M
        (keyCore G PG zDim κ pp (setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp a).2 f M t)
        (encCore G ℓ zDim κ pp (setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp a).1 x
          (pp.group.expVec pp.generator z) s) =
      fun j => pp.group.pair pp.generator (groupVecMul z M j) *
        (pp.group.pair pp.generator pp.generator) ^
          (-(Matrix.vecMul (Matrix.vecMul s a.1) t.1 (Sum.inr j))).val

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The second decryption block is the second partial-garbling block at coins `sAT`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, (10)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decSecond_correct (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (a : SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp) (s : EncDraw G κ pp) (t : KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    decSecond G PG zDim κ pp f x
        (keyCore G PG zDim κ pp (setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp a).2 f M t)
        (encCore G ℓ zDim κ pp (setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp a).1 x
          (pp.group.expVec pp.generator z) s) =
      pp.group.expVecT (pp.group.pair pp.generator pp.generator)
        (Matrix.vecMul (Matrix.vecMul (Matrix.vecMul s a.1) t.1)
          ((show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PG.L1 κ pp.orderParam f) *
              (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PartialGarbling.publicTensor (p :=
                pp.orderParam)
                (M := PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) x) + (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from
                  PG.L0 κ pp.orderParam f)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Π decrypts to `e(g,[zMf(x)^T])` for every honest draw and an arbitrary source-group
matrix `M` [Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, (11)]. This is perfect correctness in the exponent.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem pi_dec_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (a : SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp) (s : EncDraw G κ pp) (t : KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    dec G PG zDim κ pp f M x
        (keyCore G PG zDim κ pp (setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp a).2 f M t)
        (encCore G ℓ zDim κ pp (setupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp a).1 x
          (pp.group.expVec pp.generator z) s) =
      pp.group.pair pp.generator (leak G PG zDim κ pp f M x z)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The internal raw algorithm bundle inherits perfect correctness for all its draws
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, (11)]. It has no efficiency hypothesis.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem scheme_raw_correct (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (a : SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp) (s : EncDraw G κ pp) (t : KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    let S

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The single challenge commits to scalar public and private inputs
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev Challenge (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :=
  (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) × (Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The challenge type is its pair of scalar input vectors.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem challenge_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp =
      ((Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        (Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Each adaptive key query specifies a function and a GROUP matrix
[Wee20, §4, p. 8]. No group-word-to-exponent decoder is introduced.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure KeyQuery (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The queried function. -/
  fn : Fn κ pp.orderParam
  /-- The group matrix specified by that key. -/
  matrix : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
An answer retains its function index alongside its typed key. This dependent pair is
DATA only; no finite-type instance or sampler on the pair is constructed.
A packed answer is a function index and a key at that index.

The challenge oracle is `false`; the adaptive-key oracle is `true`
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5; §4, p. 8]. Rejected requests return none.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev saSpec (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    OracleSpec Bool where
  dom := fun | false => Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp | true => KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp
  rng := fun | false => Option (CT G zDim κ pp) | true => Option (KeyPack G PG κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The oracle specification has its two displayed typed query and response families.

A typed semi-adaptive adversary fixes one coin polynomial, a TOTAL call budget, and
next moves after seeing the public key [Wee20, §2.2, p. 5].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure SAAdv (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) where
  /-- Coins shared by the whole adaptive interaction. -/
  coins : PolyExpr
  /-- Total oracle-call budget, including the challenge call. -/
  budget : PolyExpr
  /-- The next move after the current typed history. -/
  next : ∀ κ (pp : PublicParams G κ), MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp → List Bool →
    QueryLog (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp) → Move (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp) Bool

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Run the typed next-move adversary through the shared bounded oracle computation.
The budget is total, so no challenge call is added [Wee20, §2.2, p. 5].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def SAAdv.run (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (r : List Bool) :
    OracleComp (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp) Bool :=
  buildComp (A.next κ pp pk r) false (A.budget.eval κ) []

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The typed run uses exactly the shared buildComp next-move interpreter.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem SAAdv.run_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (r : List Bool) :
    SAAdv.run G PG zDim A κ pp pk r =
      buildComp (A.next κ pp pk r) false (A.budget.eval κ) []

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The protocol retains the one committed challenge and the accepted-key count
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure SAState (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- No key is answered before this challenge is committed. -/
  challenge : Option (Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp)
  /-- The next unused per-key tape block. -/
  used : ℕ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A deterministic stateful protocol refuses repeated challenges, keys before the
challenge, and keys exceeding the total call budget. Technical oracle glue.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def protocolHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → CT G zDim κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp → KeyPack G PG κ pp) :
    ∀ i, (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp).dom i → SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp →
      (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp).rng i × SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp
  | false, msg, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => (some (makeCT msg), ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)
    | some _ => (none, st)
  | true, query, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => (none, st)
    | some msg => if st.used < q then
        (some (makeKey st.used msg query), ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)
      else (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The challenge branch either commits once or returns none without changing state.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem protocolHandler_challenge (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → CT G zDim κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp → KeyPack G PG κ pp)
    (msg : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp) (st : SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    protocolHandler G PG zDim q κ pp makeCT makeKey false msg st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => (some (makeCT msg), ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)
      | some _ => (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key branch answers only after a challenge and within the accepted-key cap.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem protocolHandler_key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → CT G zDim κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp → KeyPack G PG κ pp)
    (query : KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp) (st : SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    protocolHandler G PG zDim q κ pp makeCT makeKey true query st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => (none, st)
      | some msg => if st.used < q then
          (some (makeKey st.used msg query), ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)
        else (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The fixed scalar tape allocates setup blocks followed by padded per-key blocks.
This is exact-law bookkeeping for [Wee20, Appendix B, pp. 12–14].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def securityCount {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) : PolyExpr :=
  (((PolyExpr.const 19).add ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul zDim)).add ((PolyExpr.const 8).mul ℓ)).add
    (q.mul ((((PolyExpr.const 6).add ℓ).mul PG.mBound).add ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul n')))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The scalar-tape count has its displayed setup and per-query polynomial terms.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem securityCount_eq {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) :
    securityCount PG zDim q =
      (((PolyExpr.const 19).add ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul zDim)).add ((PolyExpr.const 8).mul ℓ)).add
        (q.mul ((((PolyExpr.const 6).add ℓ).mul PG.mBound).add ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul n')))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: One uniform scalar tape supplies all game randomness, with no dependent-sum sampler.
The draw type is the displayed finite scalar vector.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem securityDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp =
      (Fin ((securityCount PG zDim q).eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A total tape read returns zero outside the allocated array. Actual accepted-query
coordinates lie within their padded blocks by the supplied uniform garbling bound.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def securityAt (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) (i : ℕ) : ZMod pp.group.order :=
  if h : i < (securityCount PG zDim q).eval κ then ω ⟨i, h⟩ else 0

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The tape lookup is the in-bounds coordinate or its zero default.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem securityAt_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) (i : ℕ) :
    securityAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω i =
      if h : i < (securityCount PG zDim q).eval κ then ω ⟨i, h⟩ else 0

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The four per-query blocks start after setup, then T, R, and uhat respectively.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def securityOffsets {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) : Fin 4 → ℕ :=
  let base := 19 + 4 * zDim.eval κ + 8 * ℓ.eval κ
  let T := 3 * q.eval κ * (PG.mBound.eval κ + n'.eval κ)
  let R := 2 * q.eval κ * PG.mBound.eval κ
  let U := q.eval κ * ℓ.eval κ * PG.mBound.eval κ
  ![base, base + T, base + T + R, base + T + R + U]

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The block offsets are their displayed prefix sums.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem securityOffsets_eq {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) :
    securityOffsets PG zDim q κ =
      let base

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Read the simulator-compatible setup draw A,c,W,U,V,w,v from the fixed tape.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def setupAt (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) : SimSetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp :=
  let getScalar := securityAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω
  let z := zDim.eval κ
  let l := ℓ.eval κ
  ⟨(fun i j => getScalar (2 * i.val + j.val)), (fun i => getScalar (6 + i.val)),
    (fun i j => getScalar (9 + i.val * z + j.val)),
    (fun i j => getScalar (9 + 3 * z + i.val * (2 * l) + 2 * j.1.val + j.2.val)),
    (fun i j => getScalar (9 + 3 * z + 6 * l + 2 * i.val + j.val)),
    (fun j => getScalar (15 + 3 * z + 6 * l + j.val)),
    (fun j => getScalar (15 + 4 * z + 6 * l + j.val))⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The setup lookup exposes its exact coordinate formulas.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setupAt_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) :
    setupAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω =
      let getScalar

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Read the honest encryption seed from its separate two-scalar block.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def seedAt (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) : EncDraw G κ pp :=
  fun i => securityAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω (17 + 4 * zDim.eval κ + 8 * ℓ.eval κ + i.val)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The honest seed uses the two coordinates immediately before the key tapes.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem seedAt_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) :
    seedAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω = fun i =>
      securityAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω (17 + 4 * zDim.eval κ + 8 * ℓ.eval κ + i.val)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Read the global hidden public-variable row used in the third game.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def globalUAt (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) : (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) → ZMod pp.group.order :=
  fun i => securityAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω
    (17 + 4 * zDim.eval κ + 6 * ℓ.eval κ + 2 * i.1.val + i.2.val)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The hidden global row is its displayed setup block.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem globalUAt_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) :
    globalUAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω = fun i => securityAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω
      (17 + 4 * zDim.eval κ + 6 * ℓ.eval κ + 2 * i.1.val + i.2.val)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Actual draw coordinates embed auxiliary indices before a padded final output block.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def paddedDrawIndex {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn κ p) :
    (PG.TIdx κ p f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) → ℕ :=
  Sum.elim (fun i => (PG.tCoord κ p f i).val) (fun j => PG.mBound.eval κ + j.val)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The padded index uses the supplied auxiliary coordinates and the final output offset.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem paddedDrawIndex_eq {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn κ p) :
    paddedDrawIndex PG κ p f =
      Sum.elim (fun i => (PG.tCoord κ p f i).val) (fun j => PG.mBound.eval κ + j.val)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Read one actual function-dependent key draw from the padded T/R tapes.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def keyAt (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) (j : ℕ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) : KeyDraw G PG κ pp f :=
  let getScalar := securityAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω
  let off := securityOffsets PG zDim q κ
  let b := PG.mBound.eval κ
  let n := n'.eval κ
  ⟨(fun i u => getScalar (off 0 + j * (3 * (b + n)) + i.val * (b + n) +
      paddedDrawIndex PG κ pp.orderParam f u)),
    (fun i u => getScalar (off 1 + j * (2 * b) + i.val * b + (PG.mCoord κ pp.orderParam f u).val))⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The actual key draw is the displayed padded T/R restriction.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyAt_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) (j : ℕ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    keyAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω j f =
      let getScalar

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Read the T,uhat,R,partial-garbling draw used by the ideal and intermediate games.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def simKeyAt (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) (j : ℕ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f :=
  let kr := keyAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω j f
  let getScalar := securityAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω
  let off := securityOffsets PG zDim q κ
  let b := PG.mBound.eval κ
  let n := n'.eval κ
  ⟨kr.1, (fun u => getScalar (off 2 + j * (ℓ.eval κ * b) + u.1.val * b +
      (PG.mCoord κ pp.orderParam f u.2).val)), kr.2,
    (fun u => getScalar (off 3 + j * (b + n) + paddedDrawIndex PG κ pp.orderParam f u))⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The ideal key draw uses the displayed four padded blocks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simKeyAt_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) (j : ℕ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    simKeyAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω j f =
      let kr

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Both unfiltered padded endpoints have EXACTLY the acceptance laws of actual fresh
setup, encryption and adaptive key generation [Wee20, §4.2, pp. 9–10]. This is a fresh-law
coupling statement, not a relabelling of the two padded endpoint definitions.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem saGame_eq_freshSaGame (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) (ideal : Bool) (κ : ℕ) :
    accept (saGame G PG zDim A ideal κ) = accept (freshSaGame G PG zDim A ideal κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The padded and actual fresh raw simulation advantages coincide
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5; Appendix B, Theorem 1, p. 12].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem saSimAdv_eq_freshSaSimAdv (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) (κ : ℕ) :
    saSimAdv G PG zDim A κ = freshSaSimAdv G PG zDim A κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Every typed adversary against the ACTUAL fresh raw laws has one advice family for
which every pair of realising machines satisfies the two-MDDH bound with one exact rank
loss [Wee20, Appendix B, Theorem 1, pp. 12–14].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem linear_freshSaSimAdv_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) :
    ∃ ω : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Advice PG zDim A.budget p κ, ∀ D : Fin 2 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (red0 G PG zDim p hp A (ω 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (red1 G PG zDim p hp A (ω 1)) →
      ∀ κ, freshSaSimAdv G PG zDim A κ ≤
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) (D 0) κ +
        G.mddhAdv ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget) (D 1) κ + linearSlack G κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The real oracle calls the actual honest laws with fresh randomness at each accepted
query [Wee20, §2.2, p. 5; §4.2, p. 9]. Refusals sample nothing and preserve state.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def freshRealHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    QueryImpl (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp) (SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) unifSpec
  | false, msg, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => ((fun ct => (some ct, ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)) <$> (enc G ℓ zDim κ pp pk msg.1
      (pp.group.expVec pp.generator msg.2)))
    | some _ => .pure (none, st)
  | true, query, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => .pure (none, st)
    | some _ => if st.used < q.eval κ then
        ((fun key => (some ⟨query.fn, key⟩, ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)) <$> (keyGen G PG zDim κ pp
          msk query.fn query.matrix))
      else .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The fresh real challenge law encrypts its scalar private input in the source group.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshRealHandler_challenge (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (msg : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (st : SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    freshRealHandler G PG zDim q κ pp pk msk false msg st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => ((fun ct => (some ct, ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)) <$> (enc G ℓ zDim κ pp pk msg.1
        (pp.group.expVec pp.generator msg.2)))
      | some _ => .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The fresh real key law samples its actual function-dependent draw after acceptance.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshRealHandler_key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (query : KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp)
    (st : SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    freshRealHandler G PG zDim q κ pp pk msk true query st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => .pure (none, st)
      | some _ => if st.used < q.eval κ then
          ((fun key => (some ⟨query.fn, key⟩, ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)) <$> (keyGen G PG zDim κ
            pp msk query.fn query.matrix))
        else .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The ideal oracle calls the actual simulator laws at each accepted query
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5; §4.2, p. 10]. Its setup state persists, and the protocol state retains
x,z so every later key receives precisely its allowed source-group leakage.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def freshIdealHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sim : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    QueryImpl (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp) (SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) unifSpec
  | false, msg, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => ((fun ct => (some ct, ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)) <$> (simEnc G ℓ zDim κ pp sim msg.1))
    | some _ => .pure (none, st)
  | true, query, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => .pure (none, st)
    | some msg => if st.used < q.eval κ then
        ((fun key => (some ⟨query.fn, key⟩, ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)) <$> (simKey G PG zDim κ pp
          sim query.fn query.matrix msg.1
          (leak G PG zDim κ pp query.fn query.matrix msg.1 msg.2)))
      else .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The fresh ideal ciphertext law is the actual simulator encryption law.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshIdealHandler_challenge (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sim : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (msg : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp) (st : SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    freshIdealHandler G PG zDim q κ pp sim false msg st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => ((fun ct => (some ct, ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)) <$> (simEnc G ℓ zDim κ pp sim msg.1))
      | some _ => .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The fresh ideal key law uses the supplied matrix and its exact scalar-input leakage.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshIdealHandler_key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sim : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (query : KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp) (st : SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    freshIdealHandler G PG zDim q κ pp sim true query st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => .pure (none, st)
      | some msg => if st.used < q.eval κ then
          ((fun key => (some ⟨query.fn, key⟩, ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)) <$> (simKey G PG zDim κ
            pp sim query.fn query.matrix msg.1
            (leak G PG zDim κ pp query.fn query.matrix msg.1 msg.2)))
        else .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The raw semi-adaptive experiment samples the ACTUAL setup law and invokes the ACTUAL
fresh encryption/key laws through the shared stateful simulator
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5; §4.2, pp. 9–10]. No basis filter is applied at either endpoint.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def freshSaGame (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) (ideal : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : ProbComp Bool :=
  (publicParamsGen G κ).bind fun pp =>
