  (ProbComp.sample (Fin (A.coins.eval κ) → Bool)).bind fun r =>
  if ideal then (simSetup G ℓ zDim κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
    ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshIdealHandler G PG zDim A.budget κ pp ctx.2)
      (SAAdv.run G PG zDim A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r)) ⟨none, 0⟩))
  else (setup G ℓ zDim κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
    ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshRealHandler G PG zDim A.budget κ pp ctx.1 ctx.2)
      (SAAdv.run G PG zDim A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r)) ⟨none, 0⟩))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The fresh experiment is the displayed setup and stateful simulation of its raw laws.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:

    (ideal : Bool) (κ : ℕ) :

      (publicParamsGen G κ).bind fun pp =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin (A.coins.eval κ) → Bool)).bind fun r =>
      if ideal then (simSetup G ℓ zDim κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
        ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshIdealHandler G PG zDim A.budget κ pp ctx.2)
          (SAAdv.run G PG zDim A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r)) ⟨none, 0⟩))
      else (setup G ℓ zDim κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
        ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshRealHandler G PG zDim A.budget κ pp ctx.1 ctx.2)
          (SAAdv.run G PG zDim A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r)) ⟨none, 0⟩))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The actual six handlers implement honest keys, the basis decomposition, the two
middle key formulas, and the ideal group-leakage simulator in that order
[Wee20, Appendix B, pp. 12–14, Games 0–5].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def gameHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (mode : Fin 6)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) :
    ∀ i, (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp).dom i → SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp →
      (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp).rng i × SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp :=
  protocolHandler G PG zDim (q.eval κ) κ pp
    (fun msg => if mode.val ≤ 2 then
      let c := if mode.val = 0 then
          pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul (seedAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω) st.Aᵀ)
        else pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.c
      maskedCipher G ℓ zDim κ pp ⟨st.W, st.U, st.V⟩ c msg
    else simEncCore G ℓ zDim κ pp st msg.1)
    (fun j msg query =>
      let kr := keyAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω j query.fn
      let sr := simKeyAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω j query.fn
      ⟨query.fn,
        if mode.val ≤ 1 then keyCore G PG zDim κ pp ⟨st.W, st.U, st.V⟩ query.fn query.matrix kr
        else if mode.val = 2 then decomposedKey G PG zDim κ pp st query kr
        else if mode.val = 3 then
          let tensorR := Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a * b)
            (1 : Matrix (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)) sr.2.2.1
          semiKey G PG zDim κ pp st msg query sr.1 sr.2.2.2
            (pp.group.expMat pp.generator sr.2.2.1)
            (pp.group.expVec pp.generator
              (Matrix.vecMul (globalUAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω) tensorR))
        else if mode.val = 4 then semiKey G PG zDim κ pp st msg query sr.1 sr.2.2.2
          (pp.group.expMat pp.generator sr.2.2.1) (pp.group.expVec pp.generator sr.2.1)
        else simKeyCore G PG zDim κ pp st query.fn query.matrix msg.1
          (leak G PG zDim κ pp query.fn query.matrix msg.1 msg.2) sr⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The game handler is the displayed protocol with the six explicit source formulas.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem gameHandler_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (mode : Fin 6)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp) :
    gameHandler G PG zDim q mode κ pp st ω =
      protocolHandler G PG zDim (q.eval κ) κ pp
        (fun msg => if mode.val ≤ 2 then
          let c := if mode.val = 0 then
              pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul (seedAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω) st.Aᵀ)
            else pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.c
          maskedCipher G ℓ zDim κ pp ⟨st.W, st.U, st.V⟩ c msg
        else simEncCore G ℓ zDim κ pp st msg.1)
        (fun j msg query =>
          let kr := keyAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω j query.fn
          let sr := simKeyAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω j query.fn
          ⟨query.fn,
            if mode.val ≤ 1 then
              keyCore G PG zDim κ pp ⟨st.W, st.U, st.V⟩ query.fn query.matrix kr
            else if mode.val = 2 then decomposedKey G PG zDim κ pp st query kr
            else if mode.val = 3 then
              let tensorR := Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a * b)
                (1 : Matrix (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)) sr.2.2.1
              semiKey G PG zDim κ pp st msg query sr.1 sr.2.2.2
                (pp.group.expMat pp.generator sr.2.2.1)
                (pp.group.expVec pp.generator
                  (Matrix.vecMul (globalUAt G PG zDim q κ pp ω) tensorR))
            else if mode.val = 4 then semiKey G PG zDim κ pp st msg query sr.1 sr.2.2.2
              (pp.group.expMat pp.generator sr.2.2.1) (pp.group.expVec pp.generator sr.2.1)
            else simKeyCore G PG zDim κ pp st query.fn query.matrix msg.1
              (leak G PG zDim κ pp query.fn query.matrix msg.1 msg.2) sr⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Run the adversary with exactly its TOTAL call budget. Intermediate games are filtered
on the known scalar basis; singular cases return false before any next move is run.
This is the good-event form of [Wee20, Appendix B, Games 2–5, p. 13].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def runGameDet (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim)
    (mode : Fin 6) (filtered : Bool) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim A.budget κ pp) (r : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let ctx := simSetupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp (setupAt G PG zDim A.budget κ pp ω)
  if filtered && decide (2 ≤ mode.val) &&
      decide ((basisMatrix G κ pp ctx.2.A ctx.2.c).det = 0) then false
  else (runDet (A.next κ pp ctx.1 r) false
    (gameHandler G PG zDim A.budget mode κ pp ctx.2 ω)
    (A.budget.eval κ) [] ⟨none, 0⟩).1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Form the masked ciphertext at any supplied GROUP first block
[Wee20, Appendix B, p. 12, Game 1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def maskedCipher (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (c : Fin 3 → pp.group.G)
    (msg : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp) : CT G zDim κ pp :=
  ⟨c, pp.group.expVec pp.generator msg.2 * groupMatMul (fun _ : Fin 1 => c) st.W 0,
    groupMatMul (fun _ : Fin 1 => c)
      (st.U * (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PartialGarbling.publicTensor (p :=
        pp.orderParam) (M := Fin 2) msg.1) + st.V) 0⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The masked ciphertext is its displayed group row action and known-input mask.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskedCipher_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (st : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (c : Fin 3 → pp.group.G)
    (msg : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    maskedCipher G ℓ zDim κ pp st c msg =
      ⟨c, pp.group.expVec pp.generator msg.2 * groupMatMul (fun _ : Fin 1 => c) st.W 0,
        groupMatMul (fun _ : Fin 1 => c)
          (st.U * (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PartialGarbling.publicTensor (p :=
            pp.orderParam) (M := Fin 2) msg.1) + st.V)
          0⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The public projected part of a key consists of its three two-row blocks
[Wee20, Appendix B, p. 13, Game 2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure ProjectedKey (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) where
  /-- The output block. -/
  K1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The public-variable block. -/
  K2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) pp.group.G
  /-- The constant block. -/
  K3 : Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) pp.group.G

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Compute the projected rows from known T and GROUP R
[Wee20, Appendix B, p. 13, Games 3–4]. This form is usable by the MDDH reduction.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def projectedKey (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) (query : KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp)
    (T : Matrix (Fin 3) (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam query.fn ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ))
      (ZMod pp.group.order))
    (R : Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam query.fn) pp.group.G) :
    ProjectedKey G PG κ pp query.fn :=
  let A := st.Aᵀ
  let tensorR := Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => b ^ a.val)
    (1 : Matrix (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)) R
  ⟨pp.group.expMat pp.generator (A * (show Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)
    from
      fun i j => T i (Sum.inr j))) ⊙
      matMulGroup (A * st.W) query.matrix,
    pp.group.expMat pp.generator ((A * T) * (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PG.L1 κ
      pp.orderParam query.fn)) ⊙
      matMulGroup (A * st.U) tensorR,
    pp.group.expMat pp.generator ((A * T) * (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PG.L0 κ
      pp.orderParam query.fn)) ⊙
      matMulGroup (A * st.V) R⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Projected key rows use known scalar coefficients and the supplied group matrix R.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem projectedKey_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}

    (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) (query : KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp)
    (T : Matrix (Fin 3) (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam query.fn ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ))
      (ZMod pp.group.order))
    (R : Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam query.fn) pp.group.G) :
    projectedKey G PG zDim κ pp st query T R =
      let A

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The middle key formula accepts GROUP R and GROUP uhat, allowing the two MDDH challenge
branches to answer the same adaptive queries [Wee20, Appendix B, p. 13, Games 3–4].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def semiKey (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) (msg : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (query : KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp)
    (T : Matrix (Fin 3) (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam query.fn ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ))
      (ZMod pp.group.order))
    (t : (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam query.fn ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (R : Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam query.fn) pp.group.G)
    (uhat : (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam query.fn) → pp.group.G) :
    Key G PG κ pp query.fn :=
  let high := projectedKey G PG zDim κ pp st query T R
  let X := PartialGarbling.publicTensor (p := pp.orderParam)
    (M := PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam query.fn) msg.1
  let low1 := pp.group.expVec pp.generator (fun j => t (Sum.inr j)) *
    groupVecMul (st.w - msg.2) query.matrix
  let low2 := pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul t ((show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order)
    from PG.L1 κ pp.orderParam query.fn))) *
    uhat
  let low3 := fun u => pp.generator ^ (Matrix.vecMul t ((show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from
    PG.L0 κ pp.orderParam query.fn)) u).val *
    (groupDot uhat (fun i => X i u))⁻¹ * groupVecMul st.v R u
  let C := fun i j => st.basisInv i (Fin.castSucc j)
  let a := fun i => st.basisInv i (Fin.last 2)
  ⟨combineRows G κ pp C a high.K1 low1, combineRows G κ pp C a high.K2 low2,
    combineRows G κ pp C a high.K3 low3, R⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The middle key is its exact projected part and displayed hidden-row formulas.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem semiKey_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Fixed-schedule advice stores all scalar tape coordinates, before the group draw.
It contains no group elements or sampled response [Wee20, Appendix B, Lemmas 2 and 4].
Advice is exactly its fixed-schedule scalar vector.
The all-zero tape inhabits advice at every parameter. Technical glue.
Advice is finite by the shared prime-schedule reader, without an extra nonzero premise.

Transport known advice scalars through the actual public-order equality. This is the
shared Mathlib ring equivalence, not a new scalar extraction primitive.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def adviceDraw (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : Advice PG zDim q p κ) : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ pp :=
  fun i => ZMod.ringEquivCongr (order_eq_of_publicParams G p hp κ pp).symm (ω i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The advice cast is coordinatewise `ZMod.ringEquivCongr`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem adviceDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}

    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : Advice PG zDim q p κ) :
    adviceDraw G PG zDim q p hp κ pp ω =
      fun i => ZMod.ringEquivCongr (order_eq_of_publicParams G p hp κ pp).symm (ω i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Public advice metadata explicitly supplies κ,ℓ,n',zDim,q and the uniform node bound.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def adviceMeta {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) : List Bool :=
  let num := fun n => Candidates.natToList (Nat.size n) n
  pairEncode (List.replicate κ true) (pairEncode (num (ℓ.eval κ))
    (pairEncode (num (n'.eval κ)) (pairEncode (num (zDim.eval κ))
      (pairEncode (num (q.eval κ)) (num (PG.mBound.eval κ))))))

    adviceMeta PG zDim q κ =

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encode advice with public dimension headers and the existing modular-vector encoder.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def adviceEnc (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (ω : Advice PG zDim q p κ) : List Bool :=
  letI : NeZero (p κ) := orderSchedule_neZero G p hp κ
  pairEncode (adviceMeta PG zDim q κ) (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (G.wG.eval κ) ω)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A polynomial bounds public headers and all scalar advice bits. Technical glue.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def adviceLen (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) : PolyExpr :=
  (((((((PolyExpr.var.mul (PolyExpr.const 4)).add ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul ℓ)).add ((PolyExpr.const
    4).mul n')).add
    ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul zDim)).add ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul q)).add ((PolyExpr.const 2).mul
      PG.mBound)).add
    (PolyExpr.const 40)).add ((securityCount PG zDim q).mul G.wG)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The advice-length polynomial is its displayed header and scalar-block bound.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem adviceLen_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) :
    adviceLen G PG zDim q =
      (((((((PolyExpr.var.mul (PolyExpr.const 4)).add ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul ℓ)).add
        ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul n')).add
        ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul zDim)).add ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul q)).add ((PolyExpr.const 2).mul
          PG.mBound)).add
        (PolyExpr.const 40)).add ((securityCount PG zDim q).mul G.wG)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The first reduction's public key uses only GROUP A and known scalar masks
[Wee20, Appendix B, p. 12, Lemma 2].
The public-key computation is its displayed known-scalar group matrix actions.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem publicFromGroupA_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 3) pp.group.G)
    (st : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    publicFromGroupA G ℓ zDim κ pp A st =
      ⟨A, groupMatMul A st.W, groupMatMul A st.U, groupMatMul A st.V⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The first L2 handler uses the challenge's GROUP c and hardwired W,U,V,T,R. It answers
adaptive key queries honestly and never samples [Wee20, Appendix B, Lemma 2, p. 13].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def red0Handler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ c.pp) :
    ∀ i, (saSpec G PG zDim κ c.pp).dom i → SAState G ℓ zDim κ c.pp →
      (saSpec G PG zDim κ c.pp).rng i × SAState G ℓ zDim κ c.pp :=
  let ss := setupAt G PG zDim q κ c.pp ω
  let msk : MSK G ℓ zDim κ c.pp := ⟨ss.2.2.1, ss.2.2.2.1, ss.2.2.2.2.1⟩
  protocolHandler G PG zDim (q.eval κ) κ c.pp
    (maskedCipher G ℓ zDim κ c.pp msk (fun i => c.response i (0 : Fin 1)))
    (fun j _ query => ⟨query.fn,
      keyCore G PG zDim κ c.pp msk query.fn query.matrix (keyAt G PG zDim q κ c.pp ω j query.fn)⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The first handler is the displayed closed deterministic protocol.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem red0Handler_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ c.pp) :
    red0Handler G PG zDim q κ c ω =
      let ss

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The first L2 reduction runs the typed adversary on the MDDH¹_{2,3} challenge with
hardwired answers. It contributes exactly the Game0-to-Game1 gap, with no statistical
slack [Wee20, Appendix B, Lemma 2, p. 13].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def red0 (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim)
    (ω : ∀ κ, Advice PG zDim A.budget p κ) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) κ) (r : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  let tape := adviceDraw G PG zDim A.budget p hp κ c.pp (ω κ)
  let ss := setupAt G PG zDim A.budget κ c.pp tape
  let msk : MSK G ℓ zDim κ c.pp := ⟨ss.2.2.1, ss.2.2.2.1, ss.2.2.2.2.1⟩
  let pk := publicFromGroupA G ℓ zDim κ c.pp c.matrixᵀ msk
  [(runDet (A.next κ c.pp pk r) false (red0Handler G PG zDim A.budget κ c tape)
    (A.budget.eval κ) [] ⟨none, 0⟩).1]

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The first reduction is exactly the displayed deterministic run, with A's original coins.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem red0_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim)
    (ω : ∀ κ, Advice PG zDim A.budget p κ) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) κ) (r : List Bool) :
    red0 G PG zDim p hp A ω κ c r =
      let tape

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Read the query's R block from the MDDH base matrix. Rows are ordered by node then query;
out-of-range inputs return the identity. Accepted queries satisfy the published size bound.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def challengeR (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge ℓ (PG.mBound.mul q) κ) (j : ℕ) (f : Fn κ c.pp.orderParam) :
    Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ c.pp.orderParam f) c.pp.group.G :=
  fun i u =>
    let row := (PG.mCoord κ c.pp.orderParam f u).val * q.eval κ + j
    if h : row < (PG.mBound.mul q).eval κ then c.matrix ⟨row, h⟩ i else 1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The group R lookup is exactly the displayed interleaved block extraction.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem challengeR_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge ℓ (PG.mBound.mul q) κ) (j : ℕ) (f : Fn κ c.pp.orderParam) :
    challengeR G PG q κ c j f = fun i u =>
      let row

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Read uhat from the SAME query/node rows of the MDDH response matrix. In the real branch
this is the hidden global row times R; in the random branch it is independently uniform.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def challengeUhat (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge ℓ (PG.mBound.mul q) κ) (j : ℕ) (f : Fn κ c.pp.orderParam) :
    (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × PG.MIdx κ c.pp.orderParam f) → c.pp.group.G :=
  fun u =>
    let row := (PG.mCoord κ c.pp.orderParam f u.2).val * q.eval κ + j
    if h : row < (PG.mBound.mul q).eval κ then c.response ⟨row, h⟩ u.1 else 1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The hidden-row lookup is the displayed response block on the matching R rows.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem challengeUhat_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge ℓ (PG.mBound.mul q) κ) (j : ℕ) (f : Fn κ c.pp.orderParam) :
    challengeUhat G PG q κ c j f = fun u =>
      let row

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The second L2 handler answers with GROUP R and GROUP uhat from the MDDH challenge,
using all other coefficients from advice [Wee20, Appendix B, Lemma 4, p. 14].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def red1Handler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge ℓ (PG.mBound.mul q) κ) (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ c.pp)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ c.pp) :
    ∀ i, (saSpec G PG zDim κ c.pp).dom i → SAState G ℓ zDim κ c.pp →
      (saSpec G PG zDim κ c.pp).rng i × SAState G ℓ zDim κ c.pp :=
  protocolHandler G PG zDim (q.eval κ) κ c.pp (fun msg => simEncCore G ℓ zDim κ c.pp st msg.1)
    (fun j msg query =>
      let sr := simKeyAt G PG zDim q κ c.pp ω j query.fn
      ⟨query.fn, semiKey G PG zDim κ c.pp st msg query sr.1 sr.2.2.2
        (challengeR G PG q κ c j query.fn) (challengeUhat G PG q κ c j query.fn)⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The second handler is its displayed deterministic middle-game oracle.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem red1Handler_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge ℓ (PG.mBound.mul q) κ) (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ c.pp)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim q κ c.pp) :
    red1Handler G PG zDim q κ c st ω =
      protocolHandler G PG zDim (q.eval κ) κ c.pp (fun msg => simEncCore G ℓ zDim κ c.pp st msg.1)
        (fun j msg query =>
          let sr := simKeyAt G PG zDim q κ c.pp ω j query.fn
          ⟨query.fn, semiKey G PG zDim κ c.pp st msg query sr.1 sr.2.2.2
            (challengeR G PG q κ c j query.fn) (challengeUhat G PG q κ c j query.fn)⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The second L2 reduction filters singular known bases, then runs the adversary against
its deterministic MDDH-block answers. It contributes the Game3-to-Game4 gap with no further
slack [Wee20, Appendix B, Lemma 4, p. 14]. No response exponent is recovered.
The second reduction is exactly its displayed good-filtered deterministic run.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem red1_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}

    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim)
    (ω : ∀ κ, Advice PG zDim A.budget p κ) (κ : ℕ)
    (c : G.MDDHChallenge ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget) κ) (r : List Bool) :
    red1 G PG zDim p hp A ω κ c r =
      let tape

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The exact rank correction is nonnegative for every drawn prime-order group.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem rankSlack_nonneg {G : BilinearGen} {κ : ℕ} (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    0 ≤ rankSlack pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The exact three-by-three rank correction is at most 3/p.
This coarse upper bound preserves the exact loss in the core inequality.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem rankSlack_le_three_div {G : BilinearGen} {κ : ℕ} (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    rankSlack pp ≤ 3 / (pp.group.order : ℝ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Averaging the nonnegative exact rank correction preserves nonnegativity.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem linearSlack_nonneg (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) : 0 ≤ linearSlack G κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Every fixed prime schedule bounds the averaged correction by 3/p(κ).
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem linearSlack_le_fixedOrder (G : BilinearGen) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) :
    linearSlack G κ ≤ 3 / (p κ : ℝ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Exponential order growth makes the exact rank correction subexponentially small at
any positive exponent below one [JLS26, Section 1.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem linearSlack_subexpSmall (G : BilinearGen) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (hpb : ∀ κ, 2 ^ κ ≤ p κ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c) (hc₁ : c < 1) : SubexpSmall c (linearSlack G)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Exponential order growth makes the exact rank correction negligible.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem linearSlack_negligible (G : BilinearGen) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (hpb : ∀ κ, 2 ^ κ ≤ p κ) :
    Negligible (linearSlack G)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Advice encoding has its explicit polynomial bound, uniformly over all scalar tapes.
This is fixed-advice reduction glue.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem length_adviceEnc_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}

    (adviceEnc G PG zDim q p hp κ ω).length ≤ (adviceLen G PG zDim q).eval κ

theorem adviceEnc_injective (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
