TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Padded garbling draw coordinates fit the tape block. Technical size glue.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem paddedDrawIndex_lt {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn κ p)
    (u : PG.TIdx κ p f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) :
    paddedDrawIndex PG κ p f u < PG.mBound.eval κ + n'.eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Every accepted key's group-challenge row is in bounds, even when its function-dependent
node count is below the padded maximum. Technical size glue.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem challengeRow_lt {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn κ p)
    (u : PG.MIdx κ p f) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q.eval κ) :
    (PG.mCoord κ p f u).val * q.eval κ + j < (PG.mBound.mul q).eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Simulation of the typed bounded run by any deterministic handler has the shared
runDet form. This is the handler-machine hypothesis shape, without constructing a machine.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simulate_saRun_det {ι' σ : Type} {spec' : OracleSpec ι'}
    (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp) (r : List Bool)
    (h : ∀ i, (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp).dom i → σ →
      (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp).rng i × σ) (s : σ) :
    simulate (detImpl (spec' := spec') h) (SAAdv.run G PG zDim A κ pp pk r) s =
      .pure (runDet (A.next κ pp pk r) false h (A.budget.eval κ) [] s)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The two unfiltered padded real endpoint presentations coincide
[Wee20, Appendix B, Game 0, p. 12]. The substantive connection to the actual fresh raw
experiment is saGame_eq_freshSaGame in LinearSecurity.Endpoint.

One MDDH¹_{2,3} realiser bounds the unfiltered ciphertext hop
[Wee20, Appendix B, Lemma 2, p. 13]. The shared predicate constrains only encoded
challenges and layout-length coin strings, which suffices for this bound.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem game0_game1_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) :
    ∃ ω : ∀ κ, Advice PG zDim A.budget p κ, ∀ D : NUPPT,
      D.RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins (red0 G PG zDim p hp A
        ω) →
      ∀ κ, advantage (game G PG zDim A 0 κ) (game G PG zDim A 1 κ) ≤
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) D κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The basis decomposition changes no good-event transcript
[Wee20, Appendix B, Game 2, p. 13].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem game1_good_eq_game2 (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim A.budget κ pp)
    (r : List Bool) :
    (if (basisMatrix G κ pp
          (setupAt G PG zDim A.budget κ pp ω).1
          (setupAt G PG zDim A.budget κ pp ω).2.1).det = 0 then false
      else runGameDet G PG zDim A 1 false κ pp ω r) =
      runGameDet G PG zDim A 2 true κ pp ω r

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The adaptive third-game change of variables is exact on the good basis event
[Wee20, Appendix B, Lemma 3, pp. 13–14]. This replaces the paper's guessing argument.

One MDDH^ℓ_{2,mBound*q} realiser bounds the filtered adaptive-key hop
[Wee20, Appendix B, Lemma 4, p. 14]. The shared predicate constrains only encoded
challenges and layout-length coin strings, which suffices for this bound.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem game3_game4_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) :
    ∃ ω : ∀ κ, Advice PG zDim A.budget p κ, ∀ D : NUPPT,
      D.RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (red1 G PG zDim p hp A ω) →
      ∀ κ, advantage (game G PG zDim A 3 κ) (game G PG zDim A 4 κ) ≤
        G.mddhAdv ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget) D κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The final partial-garbling hop has EXACT privacy, including adaptive group-matrix keys
[Wee20, Appendix B, Lemma 5, p. 14; AGW20, Appendix A, (30), p. 37].

Splitting the TWO unfiltered endpoint laws by their common good event charges the
rank failure ONCE [Wee20, Appendix B, Theorem 1, p. 12, with exact rank accounting].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem endpoint_good_comparison (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) (κ : ℕ) :
    saSimAdv G PG zDim A κ ≤
      advantage (game G PG zDim A 0 κ) (game G PG zDim A 1 κ) +
      advantage (game G PG zDim A 2 κ) (game G PG zDim A 5 κ) + linearSlack G κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
For every typed semi-adaptive adversary there is fixed scalar advice such that EVERY
pair of realising MDDH machines satisfies Π's explicit simulation bound at every parameter
[Wee20, Appendix B, Theorem 1, p. 12 and Lemmas 2–5]. The shared realisation predicate
constrains only encoded challenges and layout-length coin strings, which suffices here.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem linear_saSimAdv_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) :
    ∃ ω : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Advice PG zDim A.budget p κ, ∀ D : Fin 2 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (red0 G PG zDim p hp A (ω 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (red1 G PG zDim p hp A (ω 1)) →
      ∀ κ, saSimAdv G PG zDim A κ ≤
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) (D 0) κ +
        G.mddhAdv ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget) (D 1) κ + linearSlack G κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Compute simulated partial garbling from the source-group allowed value. Start with
scalar value zero and multiply the allowed value at `m0`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, KeyGen*; AGW20, Appendix A, (30)–(32), pp. 37–38].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def groupPGStar (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (mu : pp.group.G)
    (t : (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    (Fin (n'.eval κ) ⊕ PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) → pp.group.G :=
  let p0 := PG.pgbStar κ pp.orderParam f x 0 t
  Sum.elim (fun j => pp.generator ^ (p0 (Sum.inl j)).val)
    (fun u => pp.generator ^ (p0 (Sum.inr u)).val *
      if u = PG.m0 κ pp.orderParam f then mu else 1)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The group garbling has the canonical zero-value exponents and one allowed-value factor.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem groupPGStar_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (mu : pp.group.G)
    (t : (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    groupPGStar G PG κ pp f x mu t =
      let p0

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
With a known scalar allowed value, group partial garbling is precisely its implicit
representation [Wee20, §4.2, p. 10; AGW20, Appendix A, (30), p. 37].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem groupPGStar_lift (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (mu : ZMod pp.group.order)
    (t : (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    groupPGStar G PG κ pp f x (pp.generator ^ mu.val) t =
      pp.group.expVec pp.generator (PG.pgbStar κ pp.orderParam f x mu t)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The simulator's basis matrix is `(A|c)^T` with the final row supplied by `c`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Setup*].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def basisMatrix (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order))
    (c : Fin 3 → ZMod pp.group.order) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (ZMod pp.group.order) :=
  fun i j => Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ZMod pp.group.order) (fun a : Fin 2 => A j a) (c j) i

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Each column of the transposed augmentation appends its `c` entry after the two `A` entries.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem basisMatrix_eq (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)) (c : Fin 3 → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    basisMatrix G κ pp A c = fun i j => Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ZMod pp.group.order) (fun a : Fin 2
      => A j a) (c j) i

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Π's simulator retains the scalar public-key masks, ideal ciphertext masks and inverse
basis [Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Setup*]. The inverse is total, including singular setups.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure SimState (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The three-by-two public-key basis. -/
  A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The private-input mask. -/
  W : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The public-variable mask. -/
  U : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The constant mask. -/
  V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The ideal three-coordinate ciphertext mask. -/
  c : Fin 3 → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- The ideal private-input ciphertext mask. -/
  w : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- The ideal public-input ciphertext mask. -/
  v : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- The total inverse of the transposed augmentation. -/
  basisInv : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Simulator setup draws `A,c,W,U,V,w,v` independently and uniformly
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Setup*].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev SimSetupDraw (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :=
  Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    (Fin 3 → ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    (Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) × (Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The simulator draw is exactly its seven independent scalar blocks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simSetupDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    SimSetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp =
      (Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        (Fin 3 → ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        (Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) × (Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order))

instance instSimSetupDrawFinite (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ z : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    Fintype (SimSetupDraw G ℓ z κ pp) := inferInstance

instance instSimSetupDrawNonempty (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ z : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
  :
    Nonempty (SimSetupDraw G ℓ z κ pp) := inferInstance

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Simulator setup computes the public key and the total inverse basis
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Setup*]. Unlike the source's implicit full-rank proviso, singular
inputs are defined: Mathlib's inverse is zero when the determinant is not a unit.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def simSetupCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ω : SimSetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp × SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp :=
  let A := ω.1
  let c := ω.2.1
  let W := ω.2.2.1
  let U := ω.2.2.2.1
  let V := ω.2.2.2.2.1
  let w := ω.2.2.2.2.2.1
  let v := ω.2.2.2.2.2.2
  (⟨pp.group.expMat pp.generator Aᵀ, pp.group.expMat pp.generator (Aᵀ * W),
    pp.group.expMat pp.generator (Aᵀ * U), pp.group.expMat pp.generator (Aᵀ * V)⟩,
    ⟨A, W, U, V, c, w, v, (basisMatrix G κ pp A c)⁻¹⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulator setup is the displayed public exponentiation and total inverse construction.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simSetupCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ω : SimSetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    simSetupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp ω =
      let A

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
On a singular setup the simulator explicitly uses a zero inverse basis. This totalizes
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Setup*] without resampling or altering its unconditioned draws.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simSetupCore_singular (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ω : SimSetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (h : ¬ IsUnit (basisMatrix G κ pp ω.1 ω.2.1).det) :
    (simSetupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp ω).2.basisInv = 0

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Simulated encryption reveals only the three preselected group masks
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Enc*]. The public input is accepted but does not affect these masks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def simEncCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) (_x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    CT G zDim κ pp :=
  ⟨pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.c, pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.w,
    pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.v⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The ideal ciphertext is the three implicit masks retained in simulator state.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simEncCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    simEncCore G ℓ zDim κ pp st x =
      ⟨pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.c, pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.w,
        pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.v⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Combine two projected group rows and one hidden row by a known inverse basis
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, (12)]. This uses known scalar powers only.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def combineRows (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) {J : Type}
    (C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)) (a : Fin 3 → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) J pp.group.G) (lo : J → pp.group.G) : Matrix (Fin 3) J pp.group.G :=
  matMulGroup C hi ⊙ (fun i j => lo j ^ (a i).val)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The inverse-basis combination is its known-matrix action times the hidden-row powers.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem combineRows_eq (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) {J : Type}
    (C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)) (a : Fin 3 → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) J pp.group.G) (lo : J → pp.group.G) :
    combineRows G κ pp C a hi lo = matMulGroup C hi ⊙ (fun i j => lo j ^ (a i).val)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A simulated key draws `T`, the independent `uhat`, `R`, and partial-garbling coins
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, KeyGen* and (12)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev SimKeyDraw (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :=
  Matrix (Fin 3) (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    ((Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) → ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    ((PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) → ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulated-key randomness has exactly its four scalar blocks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simKeyDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f =
      (Matrix (Fin 3) (PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ))
          (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        ((Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) → ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        ((PG.TIdx κ pp.orderParam f ⊕ Fin (n'.eval κ)) → ZMod pp.group.order))

instance instSimKeyDrawFinite (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    Fintype (SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f) := inferInstance

instance instSimKeyDrawNonempty (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    Nonempty (SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f) := inferInstance

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Simulated key generation computes equation (12) from the group-valued allowed value
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10]. The rectangular key matrix is used through group actions only.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def simKeyCore (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (mu : pp.group.G)
    (ω : SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f) : Key G PG κ pp f :=
  let T := ω.1
  let uhat := ω.2.1
  let R := ω.2.2.1
  let t := ω.2.2.2
  let A := st.Aᵀ
  let tensorR := Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a * b)
    (1 : Matrix (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)) R
  let X := PartialGarbling.publicTensor (p := pp.orderParam)
    (M := PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) x
  let pstar := groupPGStar G PG κ pp f x mu t
  let high1 := pp.group.expMat pp.generator (A * (show Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) (ZMod
    pp.group.order) from
      fun i j => T i (Sum.inr j))) ⊙
    matMulGroup (A * st.W) M
  let high2 := pp.group.expMat pp.generator
    ((A * T) * (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PG.L1 κ pp.orderParam f) + (A * st.U) *
      tensorR)
  let high3 := pp.group.expMat pp.generator
    ((A * T) * (show Matrix _ _ (ZMod pp.group.order) from PG.L0 κ pp.orderParam f) + (A * st.V) *
      R)
  let low1 := fun j => (pstar (Sum.inl j))⁻¹ * groupVecMul st.w M j
  let low2 := pp.group.expVec pp.generator uhat
  let low3 := fun u => pstar (Sum.inr u) *
    pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul st.v R - Matrix.vecMul uhat X) u
  let C := fun i j => st.basisInv i (Fin.castSucc j)
  let a := fun i => st.basisInv i (Fin.last 2)
  ⟨combineRows G κ pp C a high1 low1, combineRows G κ pp C a high2 low2,
    combineRows G κ pp C a high3 low3, pp.group.expMat pp.generator R⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The simulated key's three blocks have the projected and hidden-row form of (12).
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simKeyCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (mu : pp.group.G)
    (ω : SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    simKeyCore G PG zDim κ pp st f M x mu ω =
      let T

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The simulator's exact setup law uses one uniform draw and the displayed total core
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def simSetup (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : ProbComp (MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp × SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :=
  (simSetupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp <$> (ProbComp.sample (SimSetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulated setup has the displayed core-plus-draw law.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simSetup_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    simSetup G ℓ zDim κ pp =
      (simSetupCore G ℓ zDim κ pp <$> (ProbComp.sample (SimSetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Simulated encryption is deterministic after setup chooses its masks
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Enc*].
Simulated encryption returns its deterministic core output.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simEnc_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    simEnc G ℓ zDim κ pp st x = .pure (simEncCore G ℓ zDim κ pp st x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Simulated key generation samples its one function-dependent draw and runs equation (12)
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def simKey (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (mu : pp.group.G) :
    ProbComp (Key G PG κ pp f) :=
  (simKeyCore G PG zDim κ pp st f M x mu <$> (ProbComp.sample (SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Simulated keys have the displayed core-plus-draw law.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simKey_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : SimState G ℓ zDim κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (mu : pp.group.G) :
    simKey G PG zDim κ pp st f M x mu =
      (simKeyCore G PG zDim κ pp st f M x mu <$> (ProbComp.sample (SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The exact failure probability of an unconditioned uniform three-by-three basis is
one minus its general-linear-group fraction. This replaces the printed `1/p` bound in
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Setup*] for its actual unconditioned draws.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def rankSlack {G : BilinearGen} {κ : ℕ} (pp : PublicParams G κ) : ℝ :=
  1 - (1 - 1 / (pp.group.order : ℝ)) *
    (1 - 1 / (pp.group.order : ℝ) ^ 2) * (1 - 1 / (pp.group.order : ℝ) ^ 3)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The exact rank correction is the displayed three-by-three singular fraction.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem rankSlack_eq {G : BilinearGen} {κ : ℕ} (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    rankSlack pp = 1 - (1 - 1 / (pp.group.order : ℝ)) *
      (1 - 1 / (pp.group.order : ℝ) ^ 2) * (1 - 1 / (pp.group.order : ℝ) ^ 3)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The good basis event has exactly the general-linear-group fraction, with no conditioning
on the first two columns [Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Setup*, exact reading of its draw].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem simSetup_fullRank_prob (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    ProbComp.prob (ProbComp.sample (SimSetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp))
      (fun ω => IsUnit (basisMatrix G κ pp ω.1 ω.2.1).det) = 1 - rankSlack pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Π's statistical correction averages its exact rank failure over sequential public-
parameter generation [Wee20, Appendix B, Theorem 1, p. 12, with exact rank accounting].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def linearSlack (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ProbComp.expect (publicParamsGen G κ) rankSlack

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The linear-layer correction is the expectation of its exact rank failure.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem linearSlack_eq (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) :
    linearSlack G κ = ProbComp.expect (publicParamsGen G κ) rankSlack

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Decode a wire challenge without changing the stored wire word
[GJLS21, Section 9; Wee20, Section 3.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def decodeChallenge (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) (xy : ((S).saSpec κ).dom 0) :
    Quadratic.Challenge G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp) :=
  let msg := (S).saSplitChallenge κ xy
  let z := decodePrivate G ℓ n d κ (params κ pp) msg.2
  (decodePublic G ℓ n d κ (params κ pp) msg.1, z, z)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The decoded challenge uses the same private vector in both typed slots.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodeChallenge_eq (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (xy : ((S).saSpec κ).dom 0) : decodeChallenge G ℓ n d PG κ pp xy =
      let msg

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Package a typed key under its original wire function after checking its tensor index.
This is total adapter glue for [Wee20, Section 3.1]. No function encoding is inverted.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def wrapKey (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) (f : ((S).saSpec κ).dom 1)
    (key : Quadratic.KeyPack G n n PG κ (params κ pp)) : Option ((S).SK κ pp) :=
  let bits := (S).saKeyFunction κ f
  let decoded := decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ (params κ pp) bits
  if h : decoded = key.1 then
    some ((keyEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm ⟨bits, Eq.mp (congrArg (fun f => Quadratic.Key G n n PG κ
      (params κ pp) f) h.symm) key.2⟩)
  else none

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key wrapper's only accepted branch retains the original function word.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wrapKey_eq (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) (f : ((S).saSpec κ).dom 1)
    (key : Quadratic.KeyPack G n n PG κ (params κ pp)) :
    wrapKey G ℓ n d PG κ pp f key =
      let bits

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
One replay step recovers the original next query from the original-bit history.
Its typed query and key index must agree with scalar decoding; inconsistent histories
are rejected. This is adaptive bookkeeping for [Wee20, Section 2.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def replayStep (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (acc : Option (QueryLog ((S).saSpec κ)))
    (entry : Σ i, (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)).dom i ×
      (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)).rng i) :
    Option (QueryLog ((S).saSpec κ)) :=
  acc.bind fun hist =>
    match A.next κ pp ((mpkEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm pk) r hist, entry with
    | .query 0 xy, ⟨false, query, answer⟩ =>
        if decodeChallenge G ℓ n d PG κ pp xy = query then
          some (hist ++ [⟨0, xy, (S).saCTAnswer κ pp
            (answer.map (ctEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm)⟩])
        else none
    | .query 1 f, ⟨true, query, answer⟩ =>
        if decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ (params κ pp) ((S).saKeyFunction κ f) = query then
          let wireAnswer := match answer with
            | none => some ((S).saSKAnswer κ pp none)
            | some key => (wrapKey G ℓ n d PG κ pp f key).map
                (fun sk => (S).saSKAnswer κ pp (some sk))
          wireAnswer.map fun a => hist ++ [⟨1, f, a⟩]
        else none
    | _, _ => none

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The replay step has precisely the displayed checked query and answer branches.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem replayStep_eq (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (acc : Option (QueryLog ((S).saSpec κ)))
    (entry : Σ i, (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)).dom i ×
      (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)).rng i) :
    replayStep G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r acc entry =
      acc.bind fun hist =>
        match A.next κ pp ((mpkEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm pk) r hist, entry with
        | .query 0 xy, ⟨false, query, answer⟩ =>
            if decodeChallenge G ℓ n d PG κ pp xy = query then
              some (hist ++ [⟨0, xy, (S).saCTAnswer κ pp
                (answer.map (ctEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm)⟩])
            else none
        | .query 1 f, ⟨true, query, answer⟩ =>
            if decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ (params κ pp) ((S).saKeyFunction κ f) = query then
              let wireAnswer

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Reconstruct the wire log by the library list fold, never by a new recursion host.
Every accepted entry retains its original query bits [Wee20, Section 2.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def replay (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (hist : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp))) :
    Option (QueryLog ((S).saSpec κ)) :=
  hist.foldl (replayStep G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r) (some [])

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Replay is exactly the displayed fold from the empty wire history.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem replay_eq (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (hist : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp))) :
    replay G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r hist =
      hist.foldl (replayStep G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r) (some [])

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Empty typed history reconstructs the empty original wire history.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem replay_nil (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool) :
    replay G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r [] = some []

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Appending one typed answer is exactly one replay step after the previous replay.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem replay_append (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (hist : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)))
    (entry : Σ i, (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)).dom i ×
      (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)).rng i) :
    replay G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r (hist ++ [entry]) =
      replayStep G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r (replay G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r hist) entry

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The next typed move decodes only the newly replayed wire query
[Wee20, Section 2.2; GJLS21, Section 9]. An inconsistent history terminates with false.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def quadraticNext (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (hist : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp))) :
    Move (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)) Bool :=
  match replay G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r hist with
  | none => .ret false
  | some wire => match A.next κ pp ((mpkEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm pk) r wire with
    | .ret b => .ret b
    | .query 0 xy => .query false (decodeChallenge G ℓ n d PG κ pp xy)
    | .query 1 f => .query true
        (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ (params κ pp) ((S).saKeyFunction κ f))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The typed next move is the displayed replay-and-decode operation.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadraticNext_eq (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (hist : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp))) :
    quadraticNext G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r hist =
      match replay G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r hist with
      | none => .ret false
      | some wire => match A.next κ pp ((mpkEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm pk) r wire with
        | .ret b => .ret b
        | .query 0 xy => .query false (decodeChallenge G ℓ n d PG κ pp xy)
        | .query 1 f => .query true
            (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ (params κ pp) ((S).saKeyFunction κ f))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Transport the replayed move along the public codec's round trip. This explicit
transport keeps foreign public-parameter and key types sealed.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def toQuadraticNext (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ pp) (r : List Bool)
    (hist : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ pp)) :
    Move (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ pp) Bool :=
  let wire := (params κ).symm pp
  let h := (params κ).apply_symm_apply pp
  let key : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ wire) := h.symm ▸ pk
  let log : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ wire)) := h.symm ▸ hist
  h ▸ quadraticNext G ℓ n d PG A κ wire key r log

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The next-move codec transports key, log and result using one public round trip.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem toQuadraticNext_eq (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ pp) (r : List Bool)
    (hist : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ pp)) :
    toQuadraticNext G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r hist =
      let wire

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The explicit typed quadratic adversary preserves the original coins and TOTAL call
budget [Wee20, Section 2.2; GJLS21, Section 9]. It constructs no oracle machine.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def toQuadratic (A : (S).SAAdv) : Quadratic.SAAdv G n n PG where
  coins := A.coins
  budget := A.budget
  next := toQuadraticNext G ℓ n d PG A

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The adapter preserves the original coin layout.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem toQuadratic_coins (A : (S).SAAdv) :
    (toQuadratic G ℓ n d PG A).coins = A.coins

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The adapter preserves the TOTAL query budget without adding a call.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem toQuadratic_budget (A : (S).SAAdv) :
    (toQuadratic G ℓ n d PG A).budget = A.budget

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The adapter uses precisely the published replayed next move.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem toQuadratic_next (A : (S).SAAdv) :
    (toQuadratic G ℓ n d PG A).next = toQuadraticNext G ℓ n d PG A

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The wire and typed fresh experiments have identical laws on both branches
[Wee20, Sections 2.2 and 3.1-3.2; GJLS21, Section 9]. The wire flag is true for real,
whereas the typed fresh flag is true for ideal.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem expect_saGame_eq_fresh (hPG : PGSound PG) (A : (S).SAAdv) (real : Bool)
    (κ : ℕ) (test : Bool → ℝ) :
    ProbComp.expect ((S).saGame (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG) A real κ) test =
      ProbComp.expect
        (Quadratic.freshSaGame G n n PG (toQuadratic G ℓ n d PG A) (!real) κ) test

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Wire PHFE advantage equals the actual fresh typed quadratic advantage, without loss
[Wee20, Section 3, main claim; GJLS21, Section 9].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem saSimAdv_eq_fresh (hPG : PGSound PG) (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) :
    (S).saSimAdv (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG) A κ =
      Quadratic.freshSaSimAdv G n n PG (toQuadratic G ℓ n d PG A) κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The committed raw simulator runs the same stateful algorithms as the semi-adaptive
one, with the allowed information projected from the commitment
[GJLS21, Definition 4.3; Wee20, Section 2.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def wee20Sim_raw (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) :
    FEScheme.Raw.Simulator.Raw (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG) :=
  (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).toSim

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The committed raw simulator is precisely the generic raw conversion.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20Sim_raw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) :
    wee20Sim_raw G ℓ n d PG = (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).toSim

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
PHFE setup is the quadratic setup with equal private-vector dimensions
[Wee20, Section 3.1; GJLS21, Section 9].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def setupCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : Quadratic.SetupDraw G ℓ n n κ pp) :
    Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ pp × Quadratic.MSK G ℓ n n κ pp :=
  Quadratic.setupCore G ℓ n n κ pp ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The setup adapter uses the quadratic core with the two dimensions equal.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setupCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ω : Quadratic.SetupDraw G ℓ n n κ pp) :
    setupCore G ℓ n κ pp ω = Quadratic.setupCore G ℓ n n κ pp ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
PHFE encryption decodes the input modulo the drawn order and uses the private
vector in both quadratic slots [GJLS21, Section 9; Wee20, Section 3.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def encCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ pp)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (y : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).privLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (ω : Quadratic.EncDraw G κ pp) : Quadratic.CT G n n κ pp :=
  let z := decodePrivate G ℓ n d κ pp y
  Quadratic.encCore G ℓ n n κ pp pk (decodePublic G ℓ n d κ pp x) z z ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The encryption adapter supplies the same decoded private vector twice.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ pp)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (y : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).privLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (ω : Quadratic.EncDraw G κ pp) :
    encCore G ℓ n d κ pp pk x y ω =
      let z

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
PHFE key generation retains the original word and generates its typed quadratic key
[Wee20, Section 3.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def keyCore (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (msk : Quadratic.MSK G ℓ n n κ pp)
    (f : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (ω : Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp f)) : Key G PG κ pp :=
  ⟨f, Quadratic.keyCore G n n PG κ pp msk (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp f) ω⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key adapter retains its original function word alongside the quadratic key.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (msk : Quadratic.MSK G ℓ n n κ pp)
    (f : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (ω : Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp f)) :
    keyCore G PG κ pp msk f ω =
      ⟨f, Quadratic.keyCore G n n PG κ pp msk (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp f) ω⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
PHFE decryption decodes its public input and runs quadratic decryption using the
function retained in the key [GJLS21, Definition 4.1; Wee20, Section 3.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def dec (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : Key G PG κ pp)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (ct : Quadratic.CT G n n κ pp) : Option pp.group.GT :=
  some (Quadratic.dec G n n PG κ pp (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp sk.function)
    (decodePublic G ℓ n d κ pp x) sk.quadratic ct)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: PHFE decryption returns the displayed typed quadratic value.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem dec_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : Key G PG κ pp)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (ct : Quadratic.CT G n n κ pp) :
    dec G PG κ pp sk x ct =
      some (Quadratic.dec G n n PG κ pp (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp sk.function)
        (decodePublic G ℓ n d κ pp x) sk.quadratic ct)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The allowed class value is the quadratic scheme's scalar value on the duplicated
private input [GJLS21, Section 9; Wee20, Section 3.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem PHFE.class_eval_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) (hPG : PHFE.PGSound PG)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (y : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    PHFE.valueEquiv G ℓ n d κ pp
        ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).eval κ (PHFE.classParam G ℓ n d κ pp) f x y) =
      Quadratic.value G n n PG κ pp (PHFE.decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp f)
        (PHFE.decodePublic G ℓ n d κ pp x)
        (PHFE.decodePrivate G ℓ n d κ pp y) (PHFE.decodePrivate G ℓ n d κ pp y)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The raw PHFE scheme is perfectly correct for every honest draw, in the target-group
exponent [GJLS21, Definition 4.2; Wee20, Section 3.1, (4)-(5)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_raw_correct (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) (hPG : PHFE.PGSound PG) :
    (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).Correct

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Perfect PHFE correctness implies zero error in GJLS21's bounded-error syntax
[GJLS21, Definition 4.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_raw_correctExcept_zero (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) (hPG : PHFE.PGSound PG) :
    (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).CorrectExcept (fun _ => 0)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The layered raw garbling evaluates the coefficient tensor it represents.
This is the semantic reader needed to instantiate raw PHFE correctness.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem PHFE.layeredPG_sound (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) :
    PHFE.PGSound (layeredPG_raw ℓ (n.mul n) d)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The PHFE function family is a polynomial vector with one output per private pair
[GJLS21, Section 9; Wee20, Section 3.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev TensorFn (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) : Type :=
  PolyTensor p (ℓ.eval κ) (n.eval κ * n.eval κ) d

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The tensor family has the displayed output and monomial coordinates.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem tensorFn_eq (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) :
    TensorFn ℓ n d κ p = PolyTensor p (ℓ.eval κ) (n.eval κ * n.eval κ) d

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A supplied raw garbling computes the intended coefficient tensor evaluation.
This is semantic agreement with the chosen function class, rather than an efficiency
hypothesis [AGW20, Lemma 2, applied to the polynomial vector of GJLS21, Section 9].
Semantic agreement is pointwise equality with the polynomial-vector evaluation.

The class parameter is the public group's order, packaged by the published class codec.
No external prime schedule is evaluated by an honest algorithm [GJLS21, Definition 4.1].
The parameter adapter packages precisely the modulus read from public parameters.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem classParam_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : classParam G ℓ n d κ pp =
      (phfeClassParamEquiv ℓ n G.wG d κ).symm pp.orderParam

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Read a class value at the packaged public modulus as a scalar. This typed codec
exposes the parameter transport without requiring consumers to unfold classParam.
The public-value codec is the class codec at the drawn positive modulus.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem valueEquiv_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : valueEquiv G ℓ n d κ pp =
      phfeClassValueEquiv ℓ n G.wG d κ pp.orderParam

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Packaging a supplied scalar and reading it back preserves it.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem valueEquiv_apply_symm (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (a : ZMod pp.group.order) :
    valueEquiv G ℓ n d κ pp ((valueEquiv G ℓ n d κ pp).symm a) = a

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Embed the allowed scalar value in the target group at the public generator
[GJLS21, Definition 4.2 and Section 9].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def embedValue (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (v : (phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).Out κ (classParam G ℓ n d κ pp)) : pp.group.GT :=
  pp.group.pair pp.generator pp.generator ^
    (valueEquiv G ℓ n d κ pp v).val

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The embedding exponent is the scalar supplied by the published value codec.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem embedValue_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (v : (phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).Out κ (classParam G ℓ n d κ pp)) :
    embedValue G ℓ n d κ pp v = pp.group.pair pp.generator pp.generator ^
      (valueEquiv G ℓ n d κ pp v).val

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The public word contains exactly ℓ residues at the source-group width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem publicWidth (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) :
    (phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ = ℓ.eval κ * G.wG.eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The private word contains exactly n residues at the source-group width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem privateWidth (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) :
    (phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).privLen.eval κ = n.eval κ * G.wG.eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The function word contains all padded tensor coefficients at the public width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem functionWidth (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) :
    (phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).fnLen.eval κ =
      n.eval κ * n.eval κ * (ℓ.eval κ + 1) ^ d * G.wG.eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Decode the public input modulo the drawn order, using its published wire-width reader.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def decodePublic (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order :=
  decodeResidues pp.orderParam (ℓ.eval κ) (G.wG.eval κ)
    (x ∘ (finCongr (publicWidth G ℓ n d κ)).symm)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Public decoding transports the fixed-width word and uses total modular decoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodePublic_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (x : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    decodePublic G ℓ n d κ pp x = decodeResidues pp.orderParam (ℓ.eval κ) (G.wG.eval κ)
      (x ∘ (finCongr (publicWidth G ℓ n d κ)).symm)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Decode the private input once; both quadratic slots receive this same vector.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def decodePrivate (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (y : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    Fin (n.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order :=
  decodeResidues pp.orderParam (n.eval κ) (G.wG.eval κ)
    (y ∘ (finCongr (privateWidth G ℓ n d κ)).symm)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Private decoding transports the fixed-width word and uses total modular decoding.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodePrivate_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (y : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    decodePrivate G ℓ n d κ pp y = decodeResidues pp.orderParam (n.eval κ) (G.wG.eval κ)
      (y ∘ (finCongr (privateWidth G ℓ n d κ)).symm)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Decode the function word as its ordered coefficient tensor modulo the drawn order.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def decodeFunction (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) : TensorFn ℓ n d κ pp.orderParam :=
  decodeTensor pp.orderParam (ℓ.eval κ) (n.eval κ * n.eval κ) d (G.wG.eval κ)
    (f ∘ (finCongr (functionWidth G ℓ n d κ)).symm)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Function decoding transports the word and reads its canonical tensor coordinates.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem decodeFunction_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (f : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp f =
      decodeTensor pp.orderParam (ℓ.eval κ) (n.eval κ * n.eval κ) d (G.wG.eval κ)
        (f ∘ (finCongr (functionWidth G ℓ n d κ)).symm)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A PHFE key retains its original function word and the corresponding typed quadratic key.
Keeping the word makes its fixed-width representation injective even when distinct words
decode to the same residue tensor [GJLS21, Definition 4.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure Key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d))
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The original wire function description. -/
  function : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).fnLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The quadratic key for its decoded coefficient tensor. -/
  quadratic : Quadratic.Key G n n PG κ pp (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp function)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The target-group embedding preserves distinct class values at every public parameter.
This is the prime-order injectivity property, used only as a proof about supplied scalars.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem embedValue_injective (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : Function.Injective (embedValue G ℓ n d κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The public key has its exact polynomial wire width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadraticMPK_length (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ pp) :
    (Wire.quadraticMPK pp pk).length = (mpkLen G ℓ n).eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The master secret has its exact polynomial wire width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadraticMSK_length (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : Quadratic.MSK G ℓ n n κ pp) :
    (Wire.quadraticMSK pp sk).length = (mskLen G ℓ n).eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The ciphertext has exactly `6n+5` source-group entries.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadraticCT_length (G : BilinearGen) (n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ct : Quadratic.CT G n n κ pp) :
    (Wire.quadraticCT pp ct).length = (ctLen G n).eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A function key's word retains the original function bits before the typed key.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def keyWord (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : Key G PG κ pp) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (List.ofFn sk.function) (Wire.quadraticKey pp PG sk.quadratic)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The function-key word is exactly the original function and its quadratic-key word.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyWord_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : Key G PG κ pp) :
    keyWord G PG κ pp sk =
      pairEncode (List.ofFn sk.function) (Wire.quadraticKey pp PG sk.quadratic)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Every function-key word fits the garbling's uniform fixed width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyWord_length_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : Key G PG κ pp) :
    (keyWord G PG κ pp sk).length ≤ (skLen G PG).eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Public-key encoding reads the exact word at its fixed polynomial width.
The public-key encoder is the shared exact-width word adapter.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encMPK_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ pp) :
    encMPK G ℓ n κ pp pk = padFin ((mpkLen G ℓ n).eval κ) (Wire.quadraticMPK pp pk)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Master-secret encoding uses the exact word at its fixed polynomial width.
The master-secret encoder is the shared exact-width word adapter.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encMSK_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : Quadratic.MSK G ℓ n n κ pp) :
    encMSK G ℓ n κ pp sk = padFin ((mskLen G ℓ n).eval κ) (Wire.quadraticMSK pp sk)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Function-key encoding pads the bounded word to its fixed polynomial width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def encSK (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : Key G PG κ pp) : Fin ((skLen G PG).eval κ) → Bool :=
  padFin ((skLen G PG).eval κ) (keyWord G PG κ pp sk)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The function-key encoder is the shared padding adapter at its uniform width.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encSK_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : Key G PG κ pp) :
    encSK G PG κ pp sk = padFin ((skLen G PG).eval κ) (keyWord G PG κ pp sk)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Ciphertext encoding reads the concatenated group word at its exact width.
The ciphertext encoder is the shared exact-width word adapter.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encCT_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ct : Quadratic.CT G n n κ pp) :
    encCT G n κ pp ct = padFin ((ctLen G n).eval κ) (Wire.quadraticCT pp ct)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Public-key encoding is injective on all typed public keys.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encMPK_injective (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : Function.Injective (encMPK G ℓ n κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Master-secret encoding is injective on all typed master secrets.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encMSK_injective (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : Function.Injective (encMSK G ℓ n κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Function-key encoding is injective, including across different original function words.
Ciphertext encoding is injective on all typed ciphertexts.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encCT_injective (G : BilinearGen) (n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : Function.Injective (encCT G n κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The complete private simulator-state word is injective on all typed states.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadraticSimState_injective (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    Function.Injective (Wire.quadraticSimState pp (ℓ := ℓ) (n1 := n) (n2 := n))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The assembled PHFE is perfectly correct in the target-group exponent
[GJLS21, Definition 4.2 and Section 9; Wee20, Section 3.1, (4)-(5)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem wee20PHFE_correct : (P).toRaw.Correct

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Perfect exponent correctness gives zero correctness error in GJLS21's syntax
[GJLS21, Definition 4.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: theorem wee20PHFE_correctExcept_zero : (P).toRaw.CorrectExcept 0

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The assembled primitive has one efficient committed simulator before all machine
pairs and key counts [GJLS21, Definition 4.3, epsilon one; Remark 4.6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_simSecure (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (hpb : ∀ κ, 2 ^ κ ≤ p κ)
    (hR : Wee20Realizable43 G ℓ n d PG p hp) (h : G.DLINAssumption) :
    (P).toRaw.SimSecure

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The assembled primitive has one efficient semi-adaptive simulator before every
oracle NUPPT and TOTAL budget [Wee20, Section 2.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_saSimSecure (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (hpb : ∀ κ, 2 ^ κ ≤ p κ)
    (hR : Wee20RealizableSA G ℓ n d PG p hp) (h : G.DLINAssumption) :
    (P).toRaw.SASimSecure

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
One efficient committed simulator attains a common positive subexponential exponent
[GJLS21, Definition 4.3; the subexponential convention in JLS26, Section 1.1].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_subexpSimSecure (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (hpb : ∀ κ, 2 ^ κ ≤ p κ)
    (hR : Wee20Realizable43 G ℓ n d PG p hp) (h : G.SubexpDLIN) :
    (P).toRaw.SubexpSimSecure

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
One efficient semi-adaptive simulator attains a common positive subexponential
exponent before every oracle machine and budget [Wee20, Section 2.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_subexpSASimSecure (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (hpb : ∀ κ, 2 ^ κ ≤ p κ)
    (hR : Wee20RealizableSA G ℓ n d PG p hp) (h : G.SubexpDLIN) :
    (P).toRaw.SubexpSASimSecure

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The assembled public-key PHFE has zero correctness error, many-key epsilon-one
simulation security and the one uniform linear-encryption target
[GJLS21, Definitions 4.1-4.3 and 4.6, Remark 4.6 and Section 9].
The class is the original private quadratic polynomial class, with outputs embedded in
GT. The simulator receives allowed scalar values via the recorded Theorem 9.2 Hybrid 1
reading. The positive-size linear-time formulation is specified in LinearEfficient.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_gjls21 (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (hpb : ∀ κ, 2 ^ κ ≤ p κ)
    (hR : Wee20Realizable43 G ℓ n d PG p hp) (h : G.DLINAssumption) :
    (P).toRaw.CorrectExcept 0 ∧ (P).toRaw.SimSecure ∧ LinearEfficient G

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The raw public-key PHFE bundle is Wee's quadratic scheme at the duplicated private
input, with values embedded in the target group [GJLS21, Section 9; Wee20, Section 3.1].
A supplied garbling's semantic agreement with the tensor class is a separate correctness
hypothesis; no efficiency target is a hypothesis of raw correctness or security.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def wee20PHFE_raw (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) :
    FEScheme.Raw (phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d) where
  G := G
  cprm := PHFE.classParam G ℓ n d
  mpkLen := PHFE.mpkLen G ℓ n
  mskLen := PHFE.mskLen G ℓ n
  skLen := PHFE.skLen G PG
  ctLen := PHFE.ctLen G n
  decOutLen := G.wT
  MPK := Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n
  MSK := Quadratic.MSK G ℓ n n
  SK := PHFE.Key G PG
  CT := Quadratic.CT G n n
  DecOut := fun _ pp => pp.group.GT
  embed := PHFE.embedValue G ℓ n d
  embed_injective := PHFE.embedValue_injective G ℓ n d
  SetupDraw := Quadratic.SetupDraw G ℓ n n
  setupDrawFintype := fun κ pp => inferInstance
  setupDrawNonempty := fun κ pp => inferInstance
  setupCore := PHFE.setupCore G ℓ n
  EncDraw := fun κ pp _ _ _ => Quadratic.EncDraw G κ pp
  encDrawFintype := fun κ pp _ _ _ => inferInstance
  encDrawNonempty := fun κ pp _ _ _ => inferInstance
  encCore := PHFE.encCore G ℓ n d
  KeyDraw := fun κ pp _ f => Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp (PHFE.decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp f)
  keyDrawFintype := fun κ pp _ f => inferInstance
  keyDrawNonempty := fun κ pp _ f => inferInstance
  keyCore := PHFE.keyCore G PG
  dec := PHFE.dec G PG
  encMPK := PHFE.encMPK G ℓ n
  encMSK := PHFE.encMSK G ℓ n
  encSK := PHFE.encSK G PG
  encCT := PHFE.encCT G n
  encDecOut := fun _ pp => pp.group.encT
  encSetupDraw := fun _ pp => Wire.quadraticSetupDraw pp
  encEncDraw := fun _ pp _ _ _ => Wire.quadraticEncDraw pp
  encKeyDraw := fun _ pp _ _ => Wire.linearKeyDraw pp PG
  encMPK_inj := fun κ pp _ _ h => PHFE.encMPK_injective G ℓ n κ pp h
  encSK_inj := fun κ pp _ _ _ _ _ h => PHFE.encSK_injective G PG κ pp h
  encCT_inj := fun κ pp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h => PHFE.encCT_injective G n κ pp h
  encDecOut_injective := fun _ pp => pp.group.encT_injective

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw PHFE bundle keeps the supplied group-description generator.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_raw_G (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) :
    (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).G = G

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw class parameter is the order read from the public group.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_raw_cprm (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d κ : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d))
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).cprm κ pp = PHFE.classParam G ℓ n d κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Raw PHFE setup is the typed quadratic setup adapter.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_raw_setupCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) :
    (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).setupCore = PHFE.setupCore G ℓ n

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Raw PHFE encryption duplicates the decoded private vector in the quadratic core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_raw_encCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) :
    (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).encCore = PHFE.encCore G ℓ n d

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Raw PHFE key generation retains the original function description.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_raw_keyCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) :
    (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).keyCore = PHFE.keyCore G PG

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Raw PHFE decryption returns the typed quadratic result.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_raw_dec (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) :
    (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).dec = PHFE.dec G PG

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw PHFE ciphertext width has exactly `6n+5` group entries.

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Every typed wire adversary has fixed scalar advice for which EVERY four realising
machines satisfy the actual PHFE bound [Wee20, Section 3, p.6, with Section 3.3].
Only encoded challenges and layout-length coins constrain each shared realiser. The sole
statistical term is the unconditioned basis failure; partial-garbling privacy is exact.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_saSimAdv_le (hPG : PHFE.PGSound PG) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : (S).SAAdv) :
    ∃ φ : ∀ κ, Quadratic.MaskAdvice n n p κ,
    ∃ ωPi : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Linear.Advice PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) A.budget p κ,
    ∃ ωOuter : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Quadratic.Advice n n A.budget PG p κ,
    ∀ D : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (Linear.red0 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q A) φ) (ωPi 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (Linear.red1 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q A) φ) (ωPi 1)) →
      (D 2).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n) A.coins
        (Quadratic.red2 G n n PG p hp (Q A) (ωOuter 0)) →
      (D 3).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n) A.coins
        (Quadratic.red3 G n n PG p hp (Q A) (ωOuter 1)) →
      ∀ κ, (S).saSimAdv (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG) A κ ≤
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) (D 0) κ +
        G.mddhAdv ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget) (D 1) κ +
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) n (D 2) κ + G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) n (D 3) κ +
        Linear.linearSlack G κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Every fixed-advice L2 reduction of a MACHINE-DERIVED adversary has realising machines.
This is the reduction realisability hypothesis for [Wee20, Section 3.3], not an
honest-algorithm efficiency condition. It quantifies only over oracle NUPPTs.
The shared realiser constrains only encoded challenges and layout-length coins.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def Wee20RealizableSA (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : NUPPT) (q : PolyExpr),
    let B := toSAAdv («S» := S) A q
    ∀ φ : ∀ κ, Quadratic.MaskAdvice n n p κ,
    ∀ ωPi : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Linear.Advice PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) B.budget p κ,
    ∀ ωOuter : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Quadratic.Advice n n B.budget PG p κ,
    ∃ D : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      ((D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) B.coins
        (Linear.red0 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q B) φ) (ωPi 0))) ∧
      ((D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul B.budget)) B.coins
        (Linear.red1 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q B) φ) (ωPi 1))) ∧
      ((D 2).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n) B.coins
        (Quadratic.red2 G n n PG p hp (Q B) (ωOuter 0))) ∧
      ((D 3).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n) B.coins
        (Quadratic.red3 G n n PG p hp (Q B) (ωOuter 1)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The raw PHFE bound composes its four explicit L2 reductions with the four L1
canonical-DLIN reductions, retaining one basis failure and all matrix corrections
[Wee20, Sections 2.1 and 3.3]. EVERY realiser is quantified after its scalar advice,
and shared realisers are constrained only on encoded challenges and layout-length coins.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20PHFE_saSimAdv_dlin_le (hPG : PHFE.PGSound PG) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : (S).SAAdv) :
    ∃ φ : ∀ κ, Quadratic.MaskAdvice n n p κ,
    ∃ ωPi : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Linear.Advice PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) A.budget p κ,
    ∃ ωOuter : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Quadratic.Advice n n A.budget PG p κ,
    ∀ D : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (Linear.red0 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q A) φ) (ωPi 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (Linear.red1 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q A) φ) (ωPi 1)) →
      (D 2).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n) A.coins
        (Quadratic.red2 G n n PG p hp (Q A) (ωOuter 0)) →
      (D 3).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n) A.coins
        (Quadratic.red3 G n n PG p hp (Q A) (ωOuter 1)) →
    ∃ η : ∀ i : Fin 4, ∀ κ,
      BilinearGen.MddhAdvice p (Quadratic.hopCols ℓ i)
        (Quadratic.hopRows n n A.budget PG i) κ,
    ∀ B : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (∀ i, (B i).RealizesOn G.dlinEnc (D i).coins
        (G.dlinToMddh p hp (Quadratic.hopCols ℓ i)
          (Quadratic.hopRows n n A.budget PG i) (D i) (η i))) →
      ∀ κ, (S).saSimAdv (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG) A κ ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 4, ((Quadratic.hopCols ℓ i).eval κ : ℝ) * G.dlinAdv (B i) κ) +
        Quadratic.quadraticSlack G ℓ p κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The raw semi-adaptive PHFE simulator is the stateful quadratic simulator with explicit
wire adapters [Wee20, Section 3.2]. Allowed values are scalar class values, following
[GJLS21, Theorem 9.2 proof, Hybrid 1], rather than literal target-group encodings.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def wee20SASim_raw (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) :
    FEScheme.Raw.SASimulator.Raw (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG) where
  St := fun κ pp =>
    Quadratic.SimState G ℓ n n κ (PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp)
  encSt := fun _ pp => Wire.quadraticSimState (PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG _ pp)
  encSt_injective := fun κ pp =>
    PHFE.quadraticSimState_injective G ℓ n κ (PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp)
  SetupDraw := fun κ pp =>
    Quadratic.SimSetupDraw G ℓ n n κ (PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp)
  setupFinite := fun κ pp => inferInstance
  setupNonempty := fun κ pp => inferInstance
  setupCore := fun κ pp ω =>
    let pp' := PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp
    let k := Quadratic.simSetupCore G ℓ n n κ pp' ω
    ((PHFE.mpkEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm k.1, k.2)
  EncDraw := fun κ pp _ _ =>
    Quadratic.SimEncDraw G n n κ (PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp)
  encFinite := fun κ pp _ _ => inferInstance
  encNonempty := fun κ pp _ _ => inferInstance
  encCore := fun κ pp st x ω =>
    let pp' := PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp
    let c := Quadratic.simEncCore G ℓ n n κ pp' st (PHFE.decodePublic G ℓ n d κ pp' x) ω
    ((PHFE.ctEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm c.1, c.2)
  KeyDraw := fun κ pp _ _ f _ =>
    let pp' := PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp
    Linear.SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp' (PHFE.decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp' f)
  keyFinite := fun κ pp _ _ f _ => inferInstance
  keyNonempty := fun κ pp _ _ f _ => inferInstance
  keyCore := fun κ pp st x f mu ω =>
    let pp' := PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp
    let scalar := PHFE.scalarValueEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp mu
    let sk := Quadratic.simKeyCore G n n PG κ pp' st (PHFE.decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ pp' f)
      (PHFE.decodePublic G ℓ n d κ pp' x) (pp'.generator ^ scalar.val) ω
    ((PHFE.keyEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm ⟨f, sk⟩, st)
  encSetupDraw := fun _ pp =>
    Wire.quadraticSimSetupDraw (PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG _ pp)
  encEncDraw := fun _ pp _ _ ω =>
    let pp' := PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG _ pp
    [Wire.scalarVector pp' ω.1, Wire.scalarVector pp' ω.2].foldr pairEncode []
  encKeyDraw := fun _ pp _ _ _ _ =>
    Wire.linearSimKeyDraw (PHFE.publicParamsEquiv G ℓ n d PG _ pp) PG

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Raw simulated setup runs the quadratic simulator and packages its public key.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20SASim_raw_setupCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).G κ)
    (ω : (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).SetupDraw κ pp) :
    (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).setupCore κ pp ω =
      let pp'

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Raw simulated encryption uses only the decoded public input and fresh scalar masks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20SASim_raw_encCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).G κ)
    (st : (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).St κ pp)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (ω : (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).EncDraw κ pp st x) :
    (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).encCore κ pp st x ω =
      let pp'

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Raw simulated keys exponentiate the supplied scalar value and retain the state.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wee20SASim_raw_keyCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ)
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (PHFE.TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams (wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).G κ)
    (st : (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).St κ pp)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (f : Fin ((phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (mu : (phfeClass ℓ n G.wG d).Out κ ((wee20PHFE_raw G ℓ n d PG).cprm κ pp))
    (ω : (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).KeyDraw κ pp st x f mu) :
    (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG).keyCore κ pp st x f mu ω =
      let pp'

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The public key occupies `(16+24n+8ℓ)wG+10` bits in the nested-pair encoding.
This width is linear in the input dimensions [Wee20, Section 3.1].
The public-key width has the displayed numeric evaluation.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem mpkLen_eval (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) :
    (mpkLen G ℓ n).eval κ =
      (16 + 24 * n.eval κ + 8 * ℓ.eval κ) * G.wG.eval κ + 10

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The master secret occupies `(8n³+24n+12ℓ+6)wG+6` bits, including the public
matrix metadata [Wee20, Section 3.1].
The master-secret width has the displayed numeric evaluation.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem mskLen_eval (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) :
    (mskLen G ℓ n).eval κ =
      (8 * n.eval κ ^ 3 + 24 * n.eval κ + 12 * ℓ.eval κ + 6) * G.wG.eval κ + 6

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The fixed function-key width includes the original function word, the public matrix,
and the largest allowed garbling. The original function fixes the actual node dimensions
[Wee20, Sections 3.1 and 4.2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def skLen (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) : PolyExpr :=
  (((PolyExpr.const 2).mul (tensorFnLen ℓ (n.mul n) G.wG d)).add
    (((((PolyExpr.const 8).mul (n.pow 3)).add ((PolyExpr.const 6).mul (n.pow 2))).add
      ((((PolyExpr.const 6).mul ℓ).add (PolyExpr.const 8)).mul PG.mBound)).mul G.wG)).add
        (PolyExpr.const 10)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The function-key width has the displayed polynomial node-bound accounting.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem skLen_eval (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n : PolyExpr} {d : ℕ}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n.mul n) (TensorFn ℓ n d)) (κ : ℕ) :
    (skLen G PG).eval κ =
      2 * (tensorFnLen ℓ (n.mul n) G.wG d).eval κ +
        (8 * n.eval κ ^ 3 + 6 * n.eval κ ^ 2 +
          (6 * ℓ.eval κ + 8) * PG.mBound.eval κ) * G.wG.eval κ + 10

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The ciphertext occupies exactly `(6n+5)wG` bits, independent of ℓ and the
public-polynomial degree [Wee20, Section 3.1; GJLS21, Definition 4.6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def ctLen (G : BilinearGen) (n : PolyExpr) : PolyExpr :=
  (((PolyExpr.const 6).mul n).add (PolyExpr.const 5)).mul G.wG

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The ciphertext width has the displayed numeric evaluation.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem ctLen_eval (G : BilinearGen) (n : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) :
    (ctLen G n).eval κ = (6 * n.eval κ + 5) * G.wG.eval κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Π's private input has length `2*n2+n1*2`, the concatenated cross terms
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Enc, with k=k'=2].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def piDim (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) : PolyExpr :=
  ((PolyExpr.const 2).mul n2).add (n1.mul (PolyExpr.const 2))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The linear private-input dimension is the displayed sum of two product dimensions.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem piDim_eq (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) :
    piDim n1 n2 = ((PolyExpr.const 2).mul n2).add (n1.mul (PolyExpr.const 2))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Signal coordinates order the first tensor block before the second, using the existing
finite-product and finite-sum equivalences [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Enc].
The signal ordering is the canonical finite product/sum ordering.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem signalCoord_eq (n1 n2 : ℕ) :
    signalCoord n1 n2 =
      (Equiv.sumCongr finProdFinEquiv finProdFinEquiv).trans finSumFinEquiv

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The scalar matrix stacks `A1⊗I_n2` over `I_n1⊗A2`
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Setup]. It is used for algebraic statements about sampled setup coins.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def mixScalar {p : ℕ+} {n1 n2 : ℕ}
