    (A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n1) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n2) (ZMod (p : ℕ))) :
    Matrix (Fin (2 * n2 + n1 * 2)) (Fin (n1 * n2)) (ZMod (p : ℕ)) :=
  let top := Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a * b) A1
    (1 : Matrix (Fin n2) (Fin n2) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
  let bottom := Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a * b)
    (1 : Matrix (Fin n1) (Fin n1) (ZMod (p : ℕ))) A2
  fun i j => Sum.elim (fun u => top u (finProdFinEquiv.symm j))
    (fun u => bottom u (finProdFinEquiv.symm j)) ((signalCoord n1 n2).symm i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The scalar mixing matrix is the displayed pair of canonical Kronecker blocks.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem mixScalar_eq {p : ℕ+} {n1 n2 : ℕ}
    (A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n1) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n2) (ZMod (p : ℕ))) :
    mixScalar (p := p) A1 A2 =
      let top

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Compute the fixed group matrix from public group matrices, using known identity-matrix
powers only [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Setup].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def mixGroup (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) pp.group.G) :
    Matrix (Fin ((piDim n1 n2).eval κ)) (Fin ((n1.mul n2).eval κ)) pp.group.G :=
  let top := Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a ^ b.val) A1
    (1 : Matrix (Fin (n2.eval κ)) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order))
  let bottom := Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => b ^ a.val)
    (1 : Matrix (Fin (n1.eval κ)) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)) A2
  fun i j => Sum.elim (fun u => top u (finProdFinEquiv.symm j))
    (fun u => bottom u (finProdFinEquiv.symm j))
    ((signalCoord (n1.eval κ) (n2.eval κ)).symm i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The group matrix is the canonical source-group Kronecker computation.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem mixGroup_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) pp.group.G) :
    mixGroup G n1 n2 κ pp A1 A2 =
      let top

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The scalar cross-term signal concatenates `s1⊗z2` with `y1⊗s2`
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Enc]. This reuses the class's scalar tensor representation.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def signalScalar {p : ℕ+} {n1 n2 : ℕ} (s1 : Fin 2 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (y1 : Fin n1 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (s2 : Fin 2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : Fin (2 * n2 + n1 * 2) → ZMod (p : ℕ) :=
  fun i => Sum.elim
    (fun u => privateTensor (p := p) s1 z2 (finProdFinEquiv u))
    (fun u => privateTensor (p := p) y1 s2 (finProdFinEquiv u)) ((signalCoord n1 n2).symm i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The scalar signal uses the existing private-tensor and product/sum coordinate maps.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem signalScalar_eq {p : ℕ+} {n1 n2 : ℕ} (s1 : Fin 2 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (y1 : Fin n1 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (s2 : Fin 2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    signalScalar (p := p) s1 z2 y1 s2 = fun i => Sum.elim
      (fun u => privateTensor (p := p) s1 z2 (finProdFinEquiv u))
      (fun u => privateTensor (p := p) y1 s2 (finProdFinEquiv u))
      ((signalCoord n1 n2).symm i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Encryption forms its signal from known `s1,z2,s2` and GROUP `y1`
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Enc]. The second block is computed by known powers of `y1`.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def signalGroup (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (s1 : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order) (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (y1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → pp.group.G) (s2 : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    Fin ((piDim n1 n2).eval κ) → pp.group.G :=
  fun i => Sum.elim
    (fun u => pp.group.expVec pp.generator
      (privateTensor (p := pp.orderParam) s1 z2) (finProdFinEquiv u))
    (fun u => y1 u.1 ^ (s2 u.2).val) ((signalCoord (n1.eval κ) (n2.eval κ)).symm i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The actual signal exponentiates its known first block and powers its group second block.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem signalGroup_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (s1 : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (y1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → pp.group.G)
    (s2 : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    signalGroup G n1 n2 κ pp s1 z2 y1 s2 = fun i => Sum.elim
      (fun u => pp.group.expVec pp.generator
        (privateTensor (p := pp.orderParam) s1 z2) (finProdFinEquiv u))
      (fun u => y1 u.1 ^ (s2 u.2).val) ((signalCoord (n1.eval κ) (n2.eval κ)).symm i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The public key stores the two group masking matrices and Π's public key
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Setup]. Source-group copies coincide in the symmetric setting.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure MPK (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The first public group mask. -/
  A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The second public group mask. -/
  A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The linear building block's public key. -/
  linear : Linear.MPK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The master key retains Π's secret key and the fixed PUBLIC group matrix needed by
per-key Π.KeyGen [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6; §4, p. 8, per-key matrix form].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure MSK (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The fixed public group matrix. -/
  matrix : Matrix (Fin ((piDim n1 n2).eval κ)) (Fin ((n1.mul n2).eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The linear master secret key. -/
  linear : Linear.MSK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The ciphertext contains the two group masks and Π's ciphertext
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Enc]. The public input remains separate.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure CT (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The first masked private vector. -/
  y1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → pp.group.G
  /-- The second masked private vector. -/
  y2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → pp.group.G
  /-- The linear ciphertext for the group signal. -/
  linear : Linear.CT G (piDim n1 n2) κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A function key stores the public matrix metadata and the linear function key
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Dec; §4, p. 8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure Key (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) {ℓ : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) where
  /-- The fixed public matrix, needed without a public-key argument to decryption. -/
  matrix : Matrix (Fin ((piDim n1 n2).eval κ)) (Fin ((n1.mul n2).eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The linear key for this function and matrix. -/
  linear : Linear.Key G PG κ pp f

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Setup draws its two scalar public masks and the linear setup randomness
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev SetupDraw (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :=
  Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    Linear.SetupDraw G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The outer setup draw consists of its two masks and Π's setup draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setupDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp =
      (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Linear.SetupDraw G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Encryption draws its two masks and Π's encryption randomness. The unused outer `s0`
printed in [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6] is omitted.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev EncDraw (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :=
  (Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order) × (Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order) × Linear.EncDraw G κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Outer encryption randomness is exactly its two masks and Π's draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    EncDraw G κ pp =
      ((Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order) × (Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Linear.EncDraw G κ pp)

instance instSetupDrawFinite (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
  :
    Fintype (SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) := inferInstance

instance instSetupDrawNonempty (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G
  κ) :
    Nonempty (SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) := inferInstance

instance instEncDrawFinite (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    Fintype (EncDraw G κ pp) := inferInstance

instance instEncDrawNonempty (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    Nonempty (EncDraw G κ pp) := inferInstance

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Setup exponentiates the two masking matrices, computes the fixed group matrix and
runs Π's setup core [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def setupCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp × MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp :=
  let A1 := pp.group.expMat pp.generator ω.1
  let A2 := pp.group.expMat pp.generator ω.2.1
  let linear := Linear.setupCore G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp ω.2.2
  (⟨A1, A2, linear.1⟩, ⟨mixGroup G n1 n2 κ pp A1 A2, linear.2⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Setup's output is the two group masks, fixed group matrix and Π's output.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setupCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ω : SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    setupCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp ω =
      let A1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Encryption computes the group masks and the group-only signal sent to Π
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def encCore (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (ω : EncDraw G κ pp) : CT G n1 n2 κ pp :=
  let y1 := groupVecMul ω.1 pk.A1 * pp.group.expVec pp.generator z1
  let y2 := groupVecMul ω.2.1 pk.A2 * pp.group.expVec pp.generator z2
  ⟨y1, y2, Linear.encCore G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp pk.linear x
    (signalGroup G n1 n2 κ pp ω.1 z2 y1 ω.2.1) ω.2.2⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encryption uses only the two public group masks, known scalars and Π's group input.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem encCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (ω : EncDraw G κ pp) :
    encCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp pk x z1 z2 ω =
      let y1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Key generation forwards its function and fixed group matrix to Π
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6; §4, p. 8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def keyCore (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (ω : Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) : Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f :=
  ⟨msk.matrix, Linear.keyCore G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp msk.linear f msk.matrix ω⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The key stores its public matrix metadata and Π's function key.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (msk : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (ω : Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    keyCore G n1 n2 PG κ pp msk f ω =
      ⟨msk.matrix, Linear.keyCore G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp msk.linear f msk.matrix ω⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Scalar quadratic evaluation uses the existing private tensor and the supplied raw
partial-garbling function evaluation [Wee20, §3, p. 6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def value (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) : ZMod pp.group.order :=
  dotProduct (privateTensor (p := pp.orderParam) z1 z2) (PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The allowed scalar is exactly the tensor/function-vector dot product.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem value_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    value G n1 n2 PG κ pp f x z1 z2 =
      dotProduct (privateTensor (p := pp.orderParam) z1 z2) (PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Decryption pairs the two outer masks, weights by the function value, and divides by
Π's decryption [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Dec and (5)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def dec (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (sk : Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f) (ct : CT G n1 n2 κ pp) : pp.group.GT :=
  groupDot (fun i => pp.group.pairTensor ct.y1 ct.y2 (finProdFinEquiv.symm i))
      (PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x) *
    (Linear.dec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp f sk.matrix x sk.linear ct.linear)⁻¹

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Decryption is the weighted tensor pairing divided by the linear decryption.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem dec_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (sk : Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f) (ct : CT G n1 n2 κ pp) :
    dec G n1 n2 PG κ pp f x sk ct =
      groupDot (fun i => pp.group.pairTensor ct.y1 ct.y2 (finProdFinEquiv.symm i))
          (PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x) *
        (Linear.dec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp f sk.matrix x sk.linear ct.linear)⁻¹

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The exact setup law samples its single product draw and applies the core.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def setup (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : ProbComp (MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp × MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :=
  (setupCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp <$> (ProbComp.sample (SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Setup has the displayed exact core-plus-draw law.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem setup_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    setup G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp =
      (setupCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp <$> (ProbComp.sample (SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The exact encryption law samples its two masks and Π's randomness.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def enc (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) : ProbComp (CT G n1 n2 κ pp) :=
  (encCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp pk x z1 z2 <$> (ProbComp.sample (EncDraw G κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encryption has the displayed exact core-plus-draw law.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem enc_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    enc G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp pk x z1 z2 =
      (encCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp pk x z1 z2 <$> (ProbComp.sample (EncDraw G κ pp)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The exact key law uses Π's function-dependent key draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def keyGen (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (msk : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) : ProbComp (Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f) :=
  (keyCore G n1 n2 PG κ pp msk f <$> (ProbComp.sample (Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp f)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Key generation has the displayed exact core-plus-draw law.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyGen_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (msk : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) :
    keyGen G n1 n2 PG κ pp msk f =
      (keyCore G n1 n2 PG κ pp msk f <$> (ProbComp.sample (Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp f)))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The quadratic construction is an internal raw algorithm bundle
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6]. Uniform efficiency is supplied by the outer targets.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure RawAlgorithms (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- Honest setup core. -/
  setupCore : SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp × MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp
  /-- Honest encryption core. -/
  encCore : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) →
    (Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) → (Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) →
    EncDraw G κ pp → CT G n1 n2 κ pp
  /-- Honest function-key core. -/
  keyCore : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) →
    Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp f → Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f
  /-- Deterministic decryption. -/
  dec : (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) → (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) →
    Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f → CT G n1 n2 κ pp → pp.group.GT

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Assemble the explicit raw quadratic cores [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def scheme_raw (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) : RawAlgorithms G n1 n2 PG κ pp :=
  ⟨setupCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp, encCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp,
    keyCore G n1 n2 PG κ pp, dec G n1 n2 PG κ pp⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The raw quadratic bundle contains exactly the four displayed cores.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem scheme_raw_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    scheme_raw G n1 n2 PG κ pp =
      ⟨setupCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp, encCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp,
        keyCore G n1 n2 PG κ pp, dec G n1 n2 PG κ pp⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The public group mixing matrix is the implicit representation of the two scalar
Kronecker blocks [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Setup].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem mixGroup_exp (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order))
    (A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)) :
    mixGroup G n1 n2 κ pp (pp.group.expMat pp.generator A1)
        (pp.group.expMat pp.generator A2) =
      pp.group.expMat pp.generator (mixScalar (p := pp.orderParam) A1 A2)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
When its group input is a known scalar vector, the encryption signal is exactly the
implicit scalar cross-term signal [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Enc].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem signalGroup_exp (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (s1 s2 : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (y1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) :
    signalGroup G n1 n2 κ pp s1 z2 (pp.group.expVec pp.generator y1) s2 =
      pp.group.expVec pp.generator (signalScalar (p := pp.orderParam) s1 z2 y1 s2)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The two cross terms account for the masked tensor product
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, (4)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem cross_tensor_identity {p : ℕ+} {n1 n2 : ℕ}
    (A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n1) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n2) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (s1 s2 : Fin 2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z1 : Fin n1 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    let y1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Evaluating the cross-term identity isolates the desired private quadratic value
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, (5)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem cross_value_identity {p : ℕ+} {n1 n2 : ℕ}
    (A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n1) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n2) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (s1 s2 : Fin 2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z1 : Fin n1 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (fx : Fin (n1 * n2) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    let y1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The raw quadratic scheme decrypts perfectly to the allowed value in the target group
for every honest setup, encryption and key draw [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, (4)–(5)].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadratic_dec_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (a : SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (s : EncDraw G κ pp)
    (t : Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    dec G n1 n2 PG κ pp f x
        (keyCore G n1 n2 PG κ pp (setupCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp a).2 f t)
        (encCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp (setupCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp a).1 x z1 z2 s) =
      pp.group.pair pp.generator pp.generator ^ (value G n1 n2 PG κ pp f x z1 z2).val

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The internal raw quadratic bundle inherits perfect correctness for every draw
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, (4)–(5)]. No efficiency target is assumed.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem scheme_raw_correct (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (z2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (a : SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (s : EncDraw G κ pp)
    (t : Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    let S

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Outer reduction advice is a scalar tape over the fixed order schedule.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev MaskAdvice (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (κ : ℕ) :=
  Fin ((maskCount n1 n2).eval κ) → ZMod (p κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Outer advice has its displayed fixed-prime function type.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskAdvice_eq (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (κ : ℕ) :
    MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ = (Fin ((maskCount n1 n2).eval κ) → ZMod (p κ))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The zero vector inhabits every outer advice type.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskAdvice_nonempty (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (κ : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Outer advice is finite under the shared fixed-order hypothesis.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskAdvice_finite (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) : Finite (MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Transport known outer advice to the actual public group order using the shared
Mathlib ring equivalence; this never extracts a scalar from a group element.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def maskAdviceDraw (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ) : MaskDraw G n1 n2 κ pp :=
  fun i => ZMod.ringEquivCongr (order_eq_of_publicParams G p hp κ pp).symm (ω i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The outer advice cast is coordinatewise ringEquivCongr.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskAdviceDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ) : maskAdviceDraw G n1 n2 p hp κ pp ω =
      fun i => ZMod.ringEquivCongr (order_eq_of_publicParams G p hp κ pp).symm (ω i)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Full outer reduction advice retains the independent linear tape as well.
Full advice is the displayed pair of scalar tapes.
The pair of zero tapes inhabits full advice.
Full advice is finite without an extra positivity restriction.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem advice_finite (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) : Finite (Advice n1 n2 q PG p κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Cast both known scalar tapes through the shared public-order equality.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def adviceDraw (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : Advice n1 n2 q PG p κ) : SecurityDraw G n1 n2 q PG κ pp :=
  (maskAdviceDraw G n1 n2 p hp κ pp ω.1,
    Linear.adviceDraw G PG (piDim n1 n2) q p hp κ pp ω.2)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The full advice cast is the pair of its published component casts.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem adviceDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : Advice n1 n2 q PG p κ) : adviceDraw G n1 n2 q PG p hp κ pp ω =
      (maskAdviceDraw G n1 n2 p hp κ pp ω.1,
        Linear.adviceDraw G PG (piDim n1 n2) q p hp κ pp ω.2)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Public metadata encodes unary κ and both separate dimension numbers.
Metadata is the displayed unary/binary header.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskAdviceMeta_eq (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) : maskAdviceMeta n1 n2 κ =
    let num

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Encode known outer advice using the existing modular-vector encoder.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def maskAdviceEnc (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (ω : MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ) : List Bool :=
  letI : NeZero (p κ) := orderSchedule_neZero G p hp κ
  pairEncode (maskAdviceMeta n1 n2 κ) (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (G.wG.eval κ) ω)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Outer advice encoding exposes its header and modular vector.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskAdviceEnc_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (ω : MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ) :
    maskAdviceEnc G n1 n2 p hp κ ω =
      letI : NeZero (p κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A polynomial bounds both the explicit dimension header and scalar mask word.
The mask word bound is its displayed polynomial.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskAdviceLen_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) : maskAdviceLen G n1 n2 =
    ((((PolyExpr.const 4).mul PolyExpr.var).add ((PolyExpr.const 4).mul n1)).add
      (((PolyExpr.const 2).mul n2).add (PolyExpr.const 20))).add ((maskCount n1 n2).mul G.wG)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The full advice word pairs the existing outer and linear scalar encodings.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def adviceEnc (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (ω : Advice n1 n2 q PG p κ) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (maskAdviceEnc G n1 n2 p hp κ ω.1)
    (Linear.adviceEnc G PG (piDim n1 n2) q p hp κ ω.2)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The full word is the displayed pair of component encodings.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem adviceEnc_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (κ : ℕ) (ω : Advice n1 n2 q PG p κ) :
    adviceEnc G n1 n2 q PG p hp κ ω = pairEncode (maskAdviceEnc G n1 n2 p hp κ ω.1)
      (Linear.adviceEnc G PG (piDim n1 n2) q p hp κ ω.2)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The pair-length reader gives the full advice polynomial.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def adviceLen (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) : PolyExpr :=
  (((PolyExpr.const 2).mul (maskAdviceLen G n1 n2)).add (PolyExpr.const 2)).add
    (Linear.adviceLen G PG (piDim n1 n2) q)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The full advice bound is twice the left bound plus two plus the right bound.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem adviceLen_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) :
    adviceLen G n1 n2 q PG =
      (((PolyExpr.const 2).mul (maskAdviceLen G n1 n2)).add (PolyExpr.const 2)).add
        (Linear.adviceLen G PG (piDim n1 n2) q)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The four response-column counts are 1,ell,1,1
[Wee20, Appendix B, Lemmas 2/4 and §3.3, pp. 7–8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: def hopCols (ℓ : PolyExpr) (i : Fin 4) : PolyExpr := if i.val = 1 then ℓ else .const 1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The response-column count is ell only for the adaptive Π-key hop.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem hopCols_eq (ℓ : PolyExpr) (i : Fin 4) :
    hopCols ℓ i = if i.val = 1 then ℓ else .const 1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The base-row counts are 3,mBound*q,n1,n2, in core-bound order
[Wee20, Appendix B, Lemmas 2/4 and §3.3, pp. 7–8, with uniform query padding].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def hopRows {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr) {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (i : Fin 4) : PolyExpr :=
  if i.val = 0 then .const 3 else if i.val = 1 then PG.mBound.mul q
    else if i.val = 2 then n1 else n2

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The base-row count is its displayed four-case formula.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem hopRows_eq {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr) {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (i : Fin 4) : hopRows n1 n2 q PG i =
      if i.val = 0 then .const 3 else if i.val = 1 then PG.mBound.mul q
        else if i.val = 2 then n1 else n2

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The combined statistical loss is one exact Π rank failure, three one-column MDDH
losses and one ell-column MDDH loss. The direct canonical JLS reduction includes the
zero-coordinate failure, so no additional DLIN matrix-presentation discrepancy is added.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def quadraticSlack (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (κ : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Linear.linearSlack G κ + 3 * BilinearGen.mddhSlack p (PolyExpr.const 1) κ +
    BilinearGen.mddhSlack p ℓ κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The total correction exposes its single rank term and four matrix losses.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadraticSlack_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (κ : ℕ) :
    quadraticSlack G ℓ p κ = Linear.linearSlack G κ +
      3 * BilinearGen.mddhSlack p (PolyExpr.const 1) κ + BilinearGen.mddhSlack p ℓ κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Four machine MDDH advantages have a simultaneous explicit canonical-DLIN bound.
Each machine's reduction has one fixed-advice family, and EVERY realising DLIN machine
works [Wee20, §2.1, p. 4, explicit polynomial-loss implementation].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem mddh_sum_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (D : Fin 4 → NUPPT) :
    ∃ η : ∀ i : Fin 4, ∀ κ,
      BilinearGen.MddhAdvice p (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 q PG i) κ,
    ∀ B : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (∀ i, (B i).RealizesOn G.dlinEnc (D i).coins
        (G.dlinToMddh p hp (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 q PG i) (D i) (η i))) →
      ∀ κ, (∑ i : Fin 4, G.mddhAdv (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 q PG i) (D i) κ) ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 4, ((hopCols ℓ i).eval κ : ℝ) * G.dlinAdv (B i) κ) +
        3 * BilinearGen.mddhSlack p (PolyExpr.const 1) κ + BilinearGen.mddhSlack p ℓ κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Every typed quadratic adversary has explicit fixed-advice L2 reductions for which
EVERY four realising MDDH machines, and then EVERY four realising canonical-DLIN machines,
satisfy the actual raw simulation bound with ONE rank loss and all four matrix corrections
[Wee20, §3, p. 6, main claim with §3.3, pp. 7–8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem quadratic_saSimAdv_dlin_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) :
    ∃ φ : ∀ κ, MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ,
    ∃ ωPi : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Linear.Advice PG (piDim n1 n2) A.budget p κ,
    ∃ ωOuter : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Advice n1 n2 A.budget PG p κ,
    ∀ D : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (Linear.red0 G PG (piDim n1 n2) p hp (toLinear G n1 n2 PG p hp A φ) (ωPi 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (Linear.red1 G PG (piDim n1 n2) p hp (toLinear G n1 n2 PG p hp A φ) (ωPi 1)) →
      (D 2).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n1) A.coins
        (red2 G n1 n2 PG p hp A (ωOuter 0)) →
      (D 3).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n2) A.coins
        (red3 G n1 n2 PG p hp A (ωOuter 1)) →
    ∃ η : ∀ i : Fin 4, ∀ κ,
      BilinearGen.MddhAdvice p (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 A.budget PG i) κ,
    ∀ B : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (∀ i, (B i).RealizesOn G.dlinEnc (D i).coins
        (G.dlinToMddh p hp (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 A.budget PG i) (D i) (η i))) →
      ∀ κ, freshSaSimAdv G n1 n2 PG A κ ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 4, ((hopCols ℓ i).eval κ : ℝ) * G.dlinAdv (B i) κ) +
        quadraticSlack G ℓ p κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The challenge contains scalar public input and both scalar private blocks
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5; §3.1, p. 6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev Challenge (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :=
  (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) ×
    (Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) × (Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The outer challenge is the displayed triple of scalar vectors.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem challenge_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp =
      ((Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        (Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        (Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A packed function key retains its type index. This dependent pair is data only;
no sampler or finite-type instance on it is constructed.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev KeyPack (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) := Σ f : Fn κ pp.orderParam, Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A packed outer key is a function index paired with its typed key.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem keyPack_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) : KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp =
      (Σ f : Fn κ pp.orderParam, Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
False is the once-only challenge; true queries a function using the fixed public
matrix [Wee20, §2.2, p. 5; §3.1, p. 6]. Refused queries return none.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev saSpec (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) : OracleSpec Bool where
  dom := fun | false => Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp | true => Fn κ pp.orderParam
  rng := fun | false => Option (CT G n1 n2 κ pp) | true => Option (KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The outer query and response families are the displayed two branches.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem saSpec_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) : saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp =
      { dom := fun | false => Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp | true => Fn κ pp.orderParam
        rng := fun
          | false => Option (CT G n1 n2 κ pp)
          | true => Option (KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp) }

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
A typed adversary sees the public key before selecting its challenge and its later
adaptive functions [Wee20, §2.2, p. 5]. Its budget counts every oracle call.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure SAAdv (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) where
  /-- Shared adversary coin length. -/
  coins : PolyExpr
  /-- TOTAL call budget, including the challenge. -/
  budget : PolyExpr
  /-- Next move after the current typed history. -/
  next : ∀ κ (pp : PublicParams G κ), MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → List Bool →
    QueryLog (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) → Move (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) Bool

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Run the outer adversary through the shared bounded interpreter, with no added call
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def SAAdv.run (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (r : List Bool) :
    OracleComp (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) Bool :=
  buildComp (A.next κ pp pk r) false (A.budget.eval κ) []

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The run is exactly buildComp at the total budget.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem SAAdv.run_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (r : List Bool) :
    SAAdv.run G n1 n2 PG A κ pp pk r =
      buildComp (A.next κ pp pk r) false (A.budget.eval κ) []

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The protocol retains the scalar challenge and the next unused accepted-key block
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure SAState (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- Committed challenge, absent until the unique accepted challenge call. -/
  challenge : Option (Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
  /-- Accepted-key counter. -/
  used : ℕ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
This deterministic protocol refuses pre-challenge keys, repeated challenges and keys
beyond the total cap [Wee20, §2.2, p. 5, with explicit total behavior].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def protocolHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → CT G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → Fn κ pp.orderParam → KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp) :
    ∀ i, (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp).dom i → SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp →
      (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp).rng i × SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp
  | false, msg, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => (some (makeCT msg), ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)
    | some _ => (none, st)
  | true, f, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => (none, st)
    | some msg => if st.used < q then
        (some (makeKey st.used msg f), ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)
      else (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A challenge commits once and otherwise leaves state unchanged.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem protocolHandler_challenge (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → CT G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → Fn κ pp.orderParam → KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp)
    (msg : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (st : SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    protocolHandler G n1 n2 PG q κ pp makeCT makeKey false msg st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => (some (makeCT msg), ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)
      | some _ => (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A key consumes a fresh block only after the challenge and below the cap.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem protocolHandler_key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → CT G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → Fn κ pp.orderParam → KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (st : SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    protocolHandler G n1 n2 PG q κ pp makeCT makeKey true f st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => (none, st)
      | some msg => if st.used < q then
          (some (makeKey st.used msg f), ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)
        else (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The outer tape stores A1,A2,s1,s2 and fresh scalar y1,y2
[Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8, Games 0–4].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def maskCount (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) : PolyExpr :=
  ((PolyExpr.const 3).mul n1).add (((PolyExpr.const 3).mul n2).add (PolyExpr.const 4))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The mask tape length is 3*n1+3*n2+4.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskCount_eq (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) : maskCount n1 n2 =
    ((PolyExpr.const 3).mul n1).add (((PolyExpr.const 3).mul n2).add (PolyExpr.const 4))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Outer masks are a uniform finite scalar vector, without a sampler construction.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev MaskDraw (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :=
  Fin ((maskCount n1 n2).eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The outer scalar draw has exactly its displayed vector type.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) : MaskDraw G n1 n2 κ pp =
      (Fin ((maskCount n1 n2).eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The six known scalar blocks used in the proof games [Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure Masks (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- First public mask. -/
  A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- Second public mask. -/
  A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- Honest first encryption seed. -/
  s1 : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- Honest second encryption seed. -/
  s2 : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- Independent first simulated vector. -/
  y1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- Independent second simulated vector. -/
  y2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Total coordinate access defaults to zero beyond the allocated tape. Technical glue.
Mask coordinate access exposes its in-bounds/default split.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskAt_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : MaskDraw G n1 n2 κ pp) (i : ℕ) : maskAt G n1 n2 κ pp ω i =
      if h : i < (maskCount n1 n2).eval κ then ω ⟨i, h⟩ else 0

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Split the outer tape into disjoint row-major mask blocks
[Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8, with explicit finite coordinates].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def masksAt (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : MaskDraw G n1 n2 κ pp) : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp :=
  let getScalar := maskAt G n1 n2 κ pp ω
  let off := 2 * n1.eval κ + 2 * n2.eval κ
  ⟨(fun i j => getScalar (i.val * n1.eval κ + j.val)),
    (fun i j => getScalar (2 * n1.eval κ + i.val * n2.eval κ + j.val)),
    (fun i => getScalar (off + i.val)), (fun i => getScalar (off + 2 + i.val)),
    (fun i => getScalar (off + 4 + i.val)), (fun i => getScalar (off + 4 + n1.eval κ + i.val))⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The mask blocks use the displayed disjoint offsets.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem masksAt_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : MaskDraw G n1 n2 κ pp) : masksAt G n1 n2 κ pp ω =
      let getScalar

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The common game draw combines outer masks with Π's padded scalar tape. Technical glue.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
abbrev SecurityDraw (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :=
  MaskDraw G n1 n2 κ pp × Linear.SecurityDraw G PG (piDim n1 n2) q κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The common draw is exactly the product of the two finite vector tapes.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem securityDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) : SecurityDraw G n1 n2 q PG κ pp =
      (MaskDraw G n1 n2 κ pp × Linear.SecurityDraw G PG (piDim n1 n2) q κ pp)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Translate a Π ciphertext by adjoining the two masks computed from known scalar advice
[Wee20, §3.3, Game 0 to Game 1, p. 7].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def wrapLinearCT (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp) (msg : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (ct : Linear.CT G (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) : CT G n1 n2 κ pp :=
  ⟨pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul m.s1 m.A1 + msg.2.1),
    pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul m.s2 m.A2 + msg.2.2), ct⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Ciphertext translation is exactly the two exponentiated known masks and Π's answer.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wrapLinearCT_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp) (msg : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (ct : Linear.CT G (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) : wrapLinearCT G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp m msg ct =
      ⟨pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul m.s1 m.A1 + msg.2.1),
        pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul m.s2 m.A2 + msg.2.2), ct⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Key translation retains the fixed public GROUP matrix as metadata
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6; §4, p. 8]. The returned function index is data, not compared by a decoder.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def wrapLinearKey (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin ((piDim n1 n2).eval κ)) (Fin ((n1.mul n2).eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (key : Linear.KeyPack G PG κ pp) : KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp :=
  ⟨key.1, ⟨M, key.2⟩⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Key translation is the displayed dependent pair with public metadata.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem wrapLinearKey_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin ((piDim n1 n2).eval κ)) (Fin ((n1.mul n2).eval κ)) pp.group.G)
    (key : Linear.KeyPack G PG κ pp) : wrapLinearKey G n1 n2 PG κ pp M key =
      ⟨key.1, ⟨M, key.2⟩⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Replay the outer adversary to reconstruct its typed log from Π's answers. On the
reachable histories the query payload is exactly the translated outer move; on arbitrary
histories only oracle indices are matched, and impossible continuations return none.
This is total adaptive reduction glue for [Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def replayLinear (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (r : List Bool) :
    QueryLog (Linear.saSpec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) →
      QueryLog (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) → Option (QueryLog (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp))
  | [], h => some h
  | e :: es, h => match A.next κ pp pk r h, e with
    | .query false msg, ⟨false, pair⟩ =>
        let answer := pair.2.map (wrapLinearCT G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp m msg)
        replayLinear G n1 n2 PG A κ pp m pk r es (h ++ [⟨false, msg, answer⟩])
    | .query true f, ⟨true, pair⟩ =>
        let answer := pair.2.map
          (wrapLinearKey G n1 n2 PG κ pp (mixGroup G n1 n2 κ pp pk.A1 pk.A2))
        replayLinear G n1 n2 PG A κ pp m pk r es (h ++ [⟨true, f, answer⟩])
    | _, _ => none

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Empty replay returns the accumulated outer history.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem replayLinear_nil (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (r : List Bool)
    (h : QueryLog (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp)) :
    replayLinear G n1 n2 PG A κ pp m pk r [] h = some h

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Nonempty replay uses the displayed next move and answer translation.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem replayLinear_cons (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (r : List Bool)
    (e : Σ i, (Linear.saSpec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp).dom i ×
      (Linear.saSpec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp).rng i)
    (es : QueryLog (Linear.saSpec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp))
    (h : QueryLog (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp)) :
    replayLinear G n1 n2 PG A κ pp m pk r (e :: es) h =
      match A.next κ pp pk r h, e with
      | .query false msg, ⟨false, pair⟩ =>
          let answer

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Translate the next outer move into Π's typed scalar challenge or group-matrix key
query [Wee20, §3.3, Game 0 to Game 1, p. 7]. Only known mask scalars enter signalScalar.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def derivedNext (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp) (pk : Linear.MPK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) (r : List Bool)
    (h : QueryLog (Linear.saSpec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp)) :
    Move (Linear.saSpec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) Bool :=
  let pub := publicFromMasks G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp m pk
  match replayLinear G n1 n2 PG A κ pp m pub r h [] with
  | none => .ret false
  | some outer => match A.next κ pp pub r outer with
    | .ret b => .ret b
    | .query false msg => .query false (msg.1,
        signalScalar (p := pp.orderParam) m.s1 msg.2.2 (Matrix.vecMul m.s1 m.A1 + msg.2.1) m.s2)
    | .query true f => .query true ⟨f, mixGroup G n1 n2 κ pp pub.A1 pub.A2⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The derived next move is the displayed total replay-and-translation algorithm.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem derivedNext_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp) (pk : Linear.MPK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) (r : List Bool)
    (h : QueryLog (Linear.saSpec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp)) :
    derivedNext G n1 n2 PG A κ pp m pk r h =
      let pub

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The explicit derived Π adversary fixes outer scalar randomness as nonuniform advice
and keeps the original coins and TOTAL budget [Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def toLinear (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG)
    (ω : ∀ κ, MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ) : Linear.SAAdv G PG (piDim n1 n2) where
  coins := A.coins
  budget := A.budget
  next := fun κ pp pk r => derivedNext G n1 n2 PG A κ pp
    (masksAt G n1 n2 κ pp (maskAdviceDraw G n1 n2 p hp κ pp (ω κ))) pk r

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The derived adversary exposes all three fields.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem toLinear_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG)
    (ω : ∀ κ, MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ) : toLinear G n1 n2 PG p hp A ω =
      { coins := A.coins
        budget := A.budget
        next := fun κ pp pk r => derivedNext G n1 n2 PG A κ pp
          (masksAt G n1 n2 κ pp (maskAdviceDraw G n1 n2 p hp κ pp (ω κ))) pk r }

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The derived coin layout is exactly the outer layout.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem toLinear_coins (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG)
    (ω : ∀ κ, MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ) : (toLinear G n1 n2 PG p hp A ω).coins = A.coins

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The derived total call budget is exactly the outer budget.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem toLinear_budget (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG)
    (ω : ∀ κ, MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ) : (toLinear G n1 n2 PG p hp A ω).budget = A.budget

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Honest accepted queries invoke the actual fresh raw laws [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def freshRealHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    QueryImpl (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) (SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) unifSpec
  | false, msg, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => ((fun ct => (some ct, ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)) <$> (enc G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp pk msg.1 msg.2.1
      msg.2.2))
    | some _ => .pure (none, st)
  | true, f, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => .pure (none, st)
    | some _ => if st.used < q.eval κ then
        ((fun key => (some ⟨f, key⟩, ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)) <$> (keyGen G n1 n2 PG κ pp msk
          f))
      else .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: A real challenge samples the actual honest encryption draw exactly once.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshRealHandler_challenge (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (msg : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (st : SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    freshRealHandler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp pk msk false msg st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => ((fun ct => (some ct, ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)) <$> (enc G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp pk msg.1 msg.2.1
        msg.2.2))
      | some _ => .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: An accepted real key samples its actual function-dependent draw.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshRealHandler_key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (st : SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) : freshRealHandler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp pk msk true f st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => .pure (none, st)
      | some _ => if st.used < q.eval κ then
          ((fun key => (some ⟨f, key⟩, ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)) <$> (keyGen G n1 n2 PG κ pp msk
            f))
        else .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The ideal experiment retains both protocol state and the actual updated simulator
state [Wee20, §3.2, p. 7]. The y vectors are saved by its accepted encryption call.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
structure FreshIdealState (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- Challenge and accepted-key counter. -/
  protocol : SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp
  /-- Persistent simulator state. -/
  simulator : SimState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Ideal accepted queries invoke actual stateful simulator calls
[Wee20, §3.2, p. 7]. The key's allowed value is exponentiated from the known scalar
function value; no target-to-source conversion is attempted.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def freshIdealHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    QueryImpl (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) (FreshIdealState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) unifSpec
  | false, msg, st => match st.protocol.challenge with
    | none => ((fun out => (some out.1, ⟨⟨some msg, st.protocol.used⟩, out.2⟩)) <$> (simEnc G ℓ n1
      n2 κ pp st.simulator msg.1))
    | some _ => .pure (none, st)
  | true, f, st => match st.protocol.challenge with
    | none => .pure (none, st)
    | some msg => if st.protocol.used < q.eval κ then
        ((fun key => (some ⟨f, key⟩,
            ⟨⟨st.protocol.challenge, st.protocol.used + 1⟩, st.simulator⟩)) <$> (simKey G n1 n2 PG κ
              pp st.simulator f msg.1
          (pp.generator ^ (value G n1 n2 PG κ pp f msg.1 msg.2.1 msg.2.2).val)))
      else .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Ideal encryption saves precisely the state returned by the actual simulator.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshIdealHandler_challenge (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (msg : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (st : FreshIdealState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    freshIdealHandler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp false msg st =
      match st.protocol.challenge with
      | none => ((fun out => (some out.1, ⟨⟨some msg, st.protocol.used⟩, out.2⟩)) <$> (simEnc G ℓ n1
        n2 κ pp st.simulator msg.1))
      | some _ => .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Ideal keys retain the simulator state and use the exact allowed scalar value.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshIdealHandler_key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (st : FreshIdealState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) : freshIdealHandler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp true f st =
      match st.protocol.challenge with
      | none => .pure (none, st)
      | some msg => if st.protocol.used < q.eval κ then
          ((fun key => (some ⟨f, key⟩,
              ⟨⟨st.protocol.challenge, st.protocol.used + 1⟩, st.simulator⟩)) <$> (simKey G n1 n2 PG
                κ pp st.simulator f msg.1
            (pp.generator ^ (value G n1 n2 PG κ pp f msg.1 msg.2.1 msg.2.2).val)))
        else .pure (none, st)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The actual raw endpoint experiment calls setup or simSetup, then the actual fresh
stateful oracles [Wee20, §2.2, p. 5; §3.1–§3.2, pp. 6–7].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def freshSaGame (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (ideal : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : ProbComp Bool :=
  (publicParamsGen G κ).bind fun pp =>
  (ProbComp.sample (Fin (A.coins.eval κ) → Bool)).bind fun r =>
  if ideal then (simSetup G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
    ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshIdealHandler G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp)
      (SAAdv.run G n1 n2 PG A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r))
      ⟨⟨none, 0⟩, ctx.2⟩))
  else (setup G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
    ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshRealHandler G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp ctx.1 ctx.2)
      (SAAdv.run G n1 n2 PG A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r)) ⟨none, 0⟩))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Fresh endpoint laws expose their actual setup and stateful interaction.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshSaGame_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (ideal : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : freshSaGame G n1 n2 PG A ideal κ =
      (publicParamsGen G κ).bind fun pp =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin (A.coins.eval κ) → Bool)).bind fun r =>
      if ideal then (simSetup G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
        ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshIdealHandler G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp)
          (SAAdv.run G n1 n2 PG A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r))
          ⟨⟨none, 0⟩, ctx.2⟩))
      else (setup G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
        ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshRealHandler G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp ctx.1 ctx.2)
          (SAAdv.run G n1 n2 PG A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r)) ⟨none, 0⟩))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Actual raw simulation advantage compares the two fresh stateful endpoints
[Wee20, §3, p. 6, main claim with §3.3, pp. 7–8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def freshSaSimAdv (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  advantage (freshSaGame G n1 n2 PG A false κ) (freshSaGame G n1 n2 PG A true κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The actual raw advantage is the shared advantage of the two fresh experiments.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem freshSaSimAdv_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) : freshSaSimAdv G n1 n2 PG A κ =
      advantage (freshSaGame G n1 n2 PG A false κ) (freshSaGame G n1 n2 PG A true κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Games 0–2 use both real masks, Game 3 replaces y1, and Game 4 replaces y2 as well
[Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8]. All scalar values here come from explicit scalar draws.
The two scalar mask choices expose the exact thresholds of the outer hybrids.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem maskedVectors_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (mode : Fin 5)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (msg : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) : maskedVectors G ℓ n1 n2 mode κ pp m msg =
      (if 3 ≤ mode.val then m.y1 else Matrix.vecMul m.s1 m.A1 + msg.2.1,
        if 4 ≤ mode.val then m.y2 else Matrix.vecMul m.s2 m.A2 + msg.2.2)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Public outer matrices are exponentiated known setup draws, with the supplied Π key
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def publicFromMasks (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (pk : Linear.MPK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp :=
  ⟨pp.group.expMat pp.generator m.A1, pp.group.expMat pp.generator m.A2, pk⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Public-mask assembly is its two exponentiations and supplied linear public key.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem publicFromMasks_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (pk : Linear.MPK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) : publicFromMasks G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp m pk =
      ⟨pp.group.expMat pp.generator m.A1, pp.group.expMat pp.generator m.A2, pk⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The five handlers use honest Π, simulated Π with actual signal leakage, its equation
(5) rewrite, and two successive uniform-vector replacements [Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8].
The first leakage is computed directly from the fixed GROUP matrix and known signal;
the later leakage is the SOURCE-GROUP quotient. No target-group inversion is used.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def gameHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (mode : Fin 5)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (pk : Linear.MPK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp)
    (st : Linear.SimState G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp)
    (ω : Linear.SecurityDraw G PG (piDim n1 n2) q κ pp) :
    ∀ i, (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp).dom i → SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp →
      (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp).rng i × SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp :=
  let pub := publicFromMasks G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp m pk
  let M := mixGroup G n1 n2 κ pp pub.A1 pub.A2
  protocolHandler G n1 n2 PG (q.eval κ) κ pp
    (fun msg => if mode.val = 0 then encCore G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp pub msg.1 msg.2.1 msg.2.2
      ⟨m.s1, m.s2, Linear.seedAt G PG (piDim n1 n2) q κ pp ω⟩
    else
      let ys := maskedVectors G ℓ n1 n2 mode κ pp m msg
      ⟨pp.group.expVec pp.generator ys.1, pp.group.expVec pp.generator ys.2,
        Linear.simEncCore G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp st msg.1⟩)
    (fun j msg f =>
      let ys := maskedVectors G ℓ n1 n2 mode κ pp m msg
      let sr := Linear.simKeyAt G PG (piDim n1 n2) q κ pp ω j f
      ⟨f, ⟨M, if mode.val = 0 then
          Linear.keyCore G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp ⟨st.W, st.U, st.V⟩ f M
            (Linear.keyAt G PG (piDim n1 n2) q κ pp ω j f)
        else
          let mu := if mode.val = 1 then Linear.leak G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp f M msg.1
              (signalScalar (p := pp.orderParam) m.s1 msg.2.2 ys.1 m.s2)
            else crossLeak G n1 n2 PG κ pp ⟨M, st, ys.1, ys.2⟩ f msg.1
              (pp.generator ^ (value G n1 n2 PG κ pp f msg.1 msg.2.1 msg.2.2).val)
          Linear.simKeyCore G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp st f M msg.1 mu sr⟩⟩)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The handler exposes the five distinct ciphertext and key formulas.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem gameHandler_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (mode : Fin 5)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (pk : Linear.MPK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp)
    (st : Linear.SimState G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp)
    (ω : Linear.SecurityDraw G PG (piDim n1 n2) q κ pp) :
    gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG mode κ pp m pk st ω =
      let pub

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Honest outer encryption and keys [Wee20, §3.3, Game 0, p. 7].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: def game0Handler := gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG 0 κ pp m pk st ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Actual simulated Π with actual group signal leakage [Wee20, §3.3, Game 1, p. 7].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: def game1Handler := gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG 1 κ pp m pk st ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The equivalent difference leakage [Wee20, §3.3, Game 2, p. 7].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: def game2Handler := gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG 2 κ pp m pk st ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The first uniformly replaced vector [Wee20, §3.3, Game 3, p. 8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: def game3Handler := gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG 3 κ pp m pk st ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Both uniformly replaced vectors [Wee20, §3.3, Game 4, p. 8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header: def game4Handler := gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG 4 κ pp m pk st ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Game 0 is its explicit formula.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem game0Handler_eq : game0Handler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp m pk st ω =
    gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG 0 κ pp m pk st ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Game 1 is its explicit formula.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem game1Handler_eq : game1Handler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp m pk st ω =
    gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG 1 κ pp m pk st ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Game 2 is its explicit formula.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem game2Handler_eq : game2Handler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp m pk st ω =
    gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG 2 κ pp m pk st ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Game 3 is its explicit formula.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem game3Handler_eq : game3Handler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp m pk st ω =
    gameHandler G n1 n2 q PG 3 κ pp m pk st ω

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Game 4 is its explicit formula.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem game4Handler_eq : game4Handler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp m pk st ω =

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The pure game fixes both finite tapes and uses the shared interpreter at the TOTAL
budget [Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8]. There is no outer singular-basis filter.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def runGameDet (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (mode : Fin 5) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp) (r : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let m := masksAt G n1 n2 κ pp ω.1
  let ctx := Linear.simSetupCore G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp
    (Linear.setupAt G PG (piDim n1 n2) A.budget κ pp ω.2)
  (runDet (A.next κ pp (publicFromMasks G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp m ctx.1) r) false
    (gameHandler G n1 n2 A.budget PG mode κ pp m ctx.1 ctx.2 ω.2)
    (A.budget.eval κ) [] ⟨none, 0⟩).1

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The pure game is its displayed setup and exact total-budget run.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem runGameDet_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (mode : Fin 5) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : SecurityDraw G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp) (r : List Bool) :
    runGameDet G n1 n2 PG A mode κ pp ω r =
      let m

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Each of the five laws samples public parameters, the complete finite tapes and the
adversary's independent coins [Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def game (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (mode : Fin 5) (κ : ℕ) : ProbComp Bool :=
  (publicParamsGen G κ).bind fun pp =>
  (ProbComp.sample (SecurityDraw G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp)).bind fun ω =>
  (ProbComp.sample (Fin (A.coins.eval κ) → Bool)).bind fun r =>
    .pure (runGameDet G n1 n2 PG A mode κ pp ω (List.ofFn r))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The game law is its exact draw-and-run sequence.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem game_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (mode : Fin 5) (κ : ℕ) : game G n1 n2 PG A mode κ =
      (publicParamsGen G κ).bind fun pp =>
      (ProbComp.sample (SecurityDraw G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp)).bind fun ω =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin (A.coins.eval κ) → Bool)).bind fun r =>
        .pure (runGameDet G n1 n2 PG A mode κ pp ω (List.ofFn r))

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
The endpoint experiment selects honest Game 0 or total ideal Game 4
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5; §3.3, pp. 7–8]. Fresh-law correspondence is stated separately.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def saGame (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (ideal : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : ProbComp Bool :=
  game G n1 n2 PG A (if ideal then 4 else 0) κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The endpoint choice is its displayed indexed game.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem saGame_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (ideal : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : saGame G n1 n2 PG A ideal κ =
      game G n1 n2 PG A (if ideal then 4 else 0) κ

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Simulation advantage compares the two unfiltered outer endpoints
[Wee20, §3, p. 6, main security claim; §3.3, pp. 7–8].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
noncomputable def saSimAdv (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  advantage (saGame G n1 n2 PG A false κ) (saGame G n1 n2 PG A true κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: The outer advantage is the shared two-experiment advantage.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem saSimAdv_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) : saSimAdv G n1 n2 PG A κ =
      advantage (saGame G n1 n2 PG A false κ) (saGame G n1 n2 PG A true κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Compute the tensor leakage with GROUP y1 and known scalar y2, then divide by the
allowed source-group value [Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8, Game 2 to Game 3].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
def crossLeakLeft (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (y1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → pp.group.G) (y2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (mu : pp.group.G) : pp.group.G :=
  groupDot (fun i => let j := finProdFinEquiv.symm i; y1 j.1 ^ (y2 j.2).val)
    (PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x) * mu⁻¹

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose: Left tensor leakage uses only known scalar powers of the supplied group vector.
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
theorem crossLeakLeft_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (y1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → pp.group.G) (y2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (mu : pp.group.G) : crossLeakLeft G n1 n2 PG κ pp f x y1 y2 mu =
      groupDot (fun i => let j := finProdFinEquiv.symm i; y1 j.1 ^ (y2 j.2).val)
        (PG.eval κ pp.orderParam f x) * mu⁻¹

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.prose:
Compute tensor leakage with known scalar y1 and GROUP y2, then divide by the allowed
source-group value [Wee20, §3.3, pp. 7–8, Game 3 to Game 4].
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.F.header:
